title: Medical Coding Audit Manager
description:
Manages the day-to-day operations of the Medical Coding Evaluation team supporting Veradigm's enterprise coding capability. The team reviews the outputs of AI agents against clinical documentation to confirm that codes are supported, billable, and accurate, and its judgments establish the clinical ground truth used to measure how our AI agents perform.
  
  
Owns the scoring guide that defines how agent output is judged, incorporating input from the reviewers who apply it. Adjudicates disagreements between reviewers, measures and reports inter-reviewer agreement, and defines the clinical metrics reported to customers, so that accuracy claims made commercially and under federal transparency requirements are defensible. Builds and develops a distributed team of certified coders, plans capacity across specialties, and extends the team's scope across coding, chart preparation, and clinical note quality as the AI roadmap expands.
  
  
**Essential Functions / Major Job Responsibilities**

* Develops and maintains the scoring guide with clinical experts, updating it as specialties and agent behaviors expand.
* Manages daily operations for the review team, including assignments, priorities, capacity, and throughput.
* Adjudicates dual-review disputes, documenting rationale and identifying reviewer error versus guide ambiguity.
* Tracks inter-reviewer agreement, using low agreement to refine guidance rather than penalize staff.
* Runs calibration rounds across reviewers to set throughput benchmarks and validate scaling readiness.
* Reports clinical metrics, accuracy, claims inclusion, and risk impact, to leadership, product teams, and clients.
* Plans specialty coverage, starting with internal medicine and expanding as scope broadens.
* Expands scope into chart prep and note quality, establishing evaluation criteria for subjective tasks.
* Validates automated scoring through sampling and reports divergences between automated and expert review.
* Coordinates design-partner evaluations to maintain consistent review standards across teams.
* Enforces approved data access boundaries, authorized data tiers, and compliant review tools.

**Job Requirements**

* Bachelor's Degree in Health Information Management, Healthcare Administration, or equivalent technical or business experience
* 8+ years relevant work experience; 2-3 years at the Expert level or equivalent experience - Preferred
* 4 Years ICD-10-CM, CPT, and HCPCS coding across multiple specialties, with strong attention to detail and a high accuracy rate
* 2 Years coding auditing or coding quality review
* 2 Years outpatient or ambulatory coding in a multi-specialty or large group practice setting
* 1 Year developing coding guidelines, audit criteria, or annotation standards that others apply
* 1 Year reviewing output from automated or computer-assisted coding tools, or other structured annotation work
* Medicare Risk Adjustment or HCC coding experience - preferred
* 2-4 years relevant leadership experience, including leading distributed or remote teams - preferred

Certifications
  
  

* CPC, CCS, or CCS-P - AAPC or AHIMA coding certification, active -Required
* CPMA - Certified Professional Medical Auditor - Preferred
* CRC - Certified Risk Adjustment Coder - Preferred

**Knowledge, Skills And Abilities**

* Expert-level knowledge of medical coding, including ICD-10-CM, CPT, HCPCS Level II, modifier application, E/M documentation guidelines, and CMS claims processing rules.
* Ability to write clear, unambiguous evaluation criteria that multiple reviewers can apply to reach the same conclusion on the same record.
* Working understanding of measurement concepts relevant to human review, including inter-rater agreement, sampling, and the difference between reviewer error and ambiguous guidance.
* Ability to explain coding reasoning to engineers and product managers who have no coding background, and to translate their technical questions into coding terms.
* Sound judgment in cases where documentation is incomplete or coding guidance does not clearly apply, and the discipline to distinguish confident conclusions from uncertain ones.
* Proven ability to lead others, including where the next-level leader is not in the same location or time zone.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision in an environment where standards and processes are still being established.
* Working knowledge of HIPAA privacy and security requirements as they apply to handling clinical information and de-identified data.

**Working Arrangements**

* Standard work week or as defined by assignment requirements.
* Primarily works in a standard office environment or remotely.
* Requires periodic overlap with United States time zones to collaborate with Applied Intelligence, product, and engineering teams.

**Travel**

title: Senior Maintenance Supervisor (Electrical)
description:
**About Maxion Wheels**
As the largest manufacturer of wheels for the global marketplace, Maxion Wheels is continually seeking motivated individuals who have what it takes to make a positive impact on our business and our customers. Our long history, and our products, internationally recognized for their quality and innovation, make us one of the most respected OEM suppliers in the automotive industry.
  
  
For our Maintenance Department in Maxion Wheels Aluminum India Pvt. Ltd., Khed, Pune - India, we are looking for a
  
  
Maintenance Supervisor
  
  
Your future role
  
  
Directs emergency repair of machinery and plant equipment in his or her area of responsibility specifically for Machine electrical PM. Manages direct reports to ensure they perform with the highest level of safety, quality of work, and productivity possible. Executes the plant’s preventative maintenance plan in his or her area of responsibility.
  
  

* To attend daily breakdown and update machine history, for all critical machine to support Production priorities.
* Reviews work orders to determine work priorities and assign them to subordinates accordingly.
* Schedules repair, maintenance, and installation of machines, tools, and equipment to ensure machines and equipment are properly running.
* Coordinates activities of workers fabricating or modifying machines, tools, or equipment to repair or upgrade machinery
* To deploy daily P.M & Safety P.M as per schedule of plant machine and Arrange PM check list and material required.
* Assigns preventative maintenance work orders to personnel based on priority and skill level of associates/team leaders
* Audits completed work orders to ensure that work is done properly and equipment is in safe and proper running order.
* Make recommendations to the Maintenance Manager for improvements to specific preventative maintenance instructions and systems.
* Maintains all Maintenance equipment Cleanliness and housekeeping work
* Promotes safe working conditions and habits for all maintenance personnel.
* Maintains the proper discipline of his subordinates and to identify and follow up with employees on cases of poor work performance.
* Assists the Maintenance Manager in evaluating the adequacy of the training programs and make recommendations to fulfill training needs and requirements.
* Conducts daily shift communication meetings with subordinates to discuss safety, reoccurring equipment problems, and to delegate assignments.
* Do all work of TPM /5S /ISO 14K/IATF /LPA/CSR Internal & External audit documentation and preparation work for all equipment and Update CLITA check list.
* Ensures that maintenance personnel return tools, parts, and other equipment to the proper storage place.
* Conducts audits to ensure that maintenance personnel complete proper 5S & all other (ISO14K/IATF/LPA/CSR) internal & external audit activities in their areas of responsibility
* Optimize spare part cost consumption by implementing Kaizen project/White belt project.
* Implement Project to reduce costs and improve working conditions.

Your profile
  
  

* Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical/Eletronics Engineering and related technical filed or the equivalent in technical traning
* 18 years of relevant work experience in relevant filed with advanced equipments
* Utility Maintenance
* Robots, PLC Troubleshooting Maintenance of Robots (Fanuc Robots)
* Strong written & verbal communication skills
* Ability to work in Matrix Organization
* Conflict Management
* Advanced Excel & presentation skills
* Strong analytical and quantitative competencies
* Understands complex concepts and the relationships between issues or problems
* Effectively communicates across organization and is confident in interacting with senior leadership team
* Possesses intellectual agility; readily accepts the challenges of unfamiliar tasks

**Equal Opportunity Statement**
Maxion Wheels maintains a written and widely distributed policy on equal employment opportunity. The Company recruits, hires, trains, promotes, administers policies, bases decisions and conducts all personnel activities without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability (to the extent an undue hardship is not imposed), status as a covered veteran or other legally protected status, in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws.

title: Sr Team Leader – IAM Products, Automation & Identity Platforms
description:
**About Northern Trust**
As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
  
  
With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**
**IAM Product Strategy & Roadmap**

* Define and maintain the multi-year IAM product strategy and modernization roadmap.
* Establish target-state capabilities for workforce IAM, client IAM, privileged access, authorization, machine identities, and identity intelligence.
* Partner with cybersecurity leadership to align IAM capabilities with regulatory requirements, risk management objectives, and business priorities.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends to continuously improve IAM capabilities.
* Create business cases, investment proposals, and strategic recommendations for IAM modernization initiatives.

**Product Ownership & Capability Management**

* Serve as the product owner for one or more strategic IAM platforms and services.
* Define product vision, objectives, roadmaps, and prioritized backlogs.
* Translate business, regulatory, security, and operational requirements into executable product capabilities.
* Partner with engineering teams to ensure successful delivery of roadmap commitments.
* Define adoption targets, value realization metrics, and product success criteria.

**Automation & Engineering Enablement**

* Lead the IAM automation strategy across identity lifecycle management, access governance, certification, auditing, privileged access, authorization, and security operations.
* Identify opportunities to reduce manual processing through workflow automation, orchestration, self-service capabilities, and intelligent controls.
* Drive adoption of automation platforms, governance workflows, and low-code/no-code orchestration capabilities.
* Partner with engineering teams to streamline onboarding, access requests, certifications, JML processes, and control execution.
* Develop automation strategies supporting workforce, client, machine, and AI-driven identities.
* Leverage tools such as Tines, Copilot, and AI Agents to improve operational efficiency and user experience.
* Create resilient, always-on automation capabilities to provide near 24x7 operational support and increase team productivity.

**Identity Governance & Operational Excellence**

* Establish measurable KPIs, KCIs, and KRIs for IAM products and services.
* Drive continual improvement of operational processes and user experience.
* Partner with operations teams to improve service reliability, scalability, and efficiency.
* Develop reporting, dashboards, and executive reporting packages.
* Ensure IAM capabilities maintain strong control effectiveness and audit readiness.

**Strategic Programs & Transformation**

* Lead automation of strategic modernization initiatives involving:

+ Identity Governance & Administration (IGA)
+ Privileged Access Management (PAM)
+ Authentication Modernization
+ Authorization Modernization
+ Role Based Access Control (RBAC)
+ Fine-Grained Authorization
+ Machine Identity Governance
+ Agent and AI Identity Governance
+ SaaS Security Integration
+ Identity Intelligence & Risk Analytics

* Coordinate across engineering, architecture, risk, cybersecurity, operations, and business stakeholders to ensure successful execution.

**Governance, Risk & Regulatory Alignment**

* Ensure IAM products align with enterprise standards, policies, and regulatory expectations.
* Support audits, examinations, and control reviews.
* Partner with Risk, Audit, Architecture, and Security organizations to define and maintain control requirements.
* Translate regulatory requirements into roadmap priorities and product capabilities.
* Maintain accountability for delivery of risk-reducing capabilities and control improvements.

**Areas of Accountability**

* IAM Product Portfolio Management
* IAM Strategy & Roadmaps
* Identity Governance Platforms
* Privileged Access Platforms
* Authentication & Authorization Products
* IAM Automation & Workflow Orchestration
* RBAC & Access Governance
* Identity Analytics & Reporting
* Machine Identity Governance
* AI & Agent Identity Governance
* IAM Metrics, KPIs, KCIs & KRIs
* Regulatory & Audit Readiness
* Continuous Improvement Programs

**Required Experience**

* 7+ years of experience in Identity & Access Management, Cybersecurity, Product Management, Security Engineering, or related technology disciplines.
* 3+ years leading strategic technology initiatives, product portfolios, or transformation programs.
* Experience with IAM platforms such as Saviynt, Okta, Entra ID, CyberArk, SailPoint, Ping, or equivalent technologies.
* Strong understanding of IAM disciplines including:

+ Authentication
+ Authorization
+ Identity Governance
+ Access Lifecycle Management
+ RBAC
+ OAuth/OIDC
+ SAML
+ MFA
+ PAM
+ Machine Identities

* Experience with automation and workflow platforms.
* Familiarity with regulatory frameworks including NIST, FFIEC, ISO 27001, NYDFS, and related financial services requirements.

**Success Measures**

* Successful delivery of IAM strategic roadmap objectives.
* Increased automation and reduction of manual IAM processes.
* Improved control effectiveness and regulatory readiness.
* Reduced operational risk and technical debt.
* Enhanced user and administrator experience.
* Increased adoption of IAM automation solutions, AI agents, Copilot use cases, and workflow platforms such as Tines.
* Increased operational resiliency through near 24x7 automated IAM capabilities.
* Quantifiable improvements in IAM KPIs, KCIs, and KRIs.
* Establishment of a scalable and sustainable identity control plane supporting workforce, client, machine, and AI identities.

**Working with Us**
As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
  
  
Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodation**
Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
  
  
**About Our Pune Office**
The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
  
  
Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

* Stay at the forefront of emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and industry trends.

**What You’ll Bring :**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related quantitative discipline.
* 10-12+ years of experience leading technology, AI, analytics, or digital transformation initiatives within consulting, technology services, or industry environments.
* Proven experience leading client-facing engagements and managing senior stakeholder relationships.
* Strong understanding of Generative AI, Agentic AI, Machine Learning, NLP, Knowledge Retrieval, and modern AI architecture patterns.
* Experience building, deploying, and scaling enterprise AI applications from concept through production.
* Strong knowledge of AI application development, software engineering, cloud architecture, and platform engineering practices.
* Hands-on experience with modern AI and data platforms, including Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Databricks, Dataiku, Snowflake, Vertex AI, or similar ecosystems.
* Experience operationalizing AI through MLOps, LLMOps, model governance, monitoring, evaluation, and lifecycle management.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals, including APIs, microservices, cloud-native architectures, distributed systems, and data engineering.
* Experience delivering solutions on public cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Agile project planning and project management experience
* Team management and skill development experience
* Excellent oral and written communication skills
* Highly motivated, good work ethic and enterprise maturity
* Life science domain knowledge is a plus

**How you’ll grow:**

* Cross-functional skills development & custom learning pathways
* Milestone training programs aligned to career progression opportunities
* Internal mobility paths that empower growth via s-curves, individual contribution and role expansions

**Perks & Benefits:**

title: Principal Engineer/Sr. Principal Engineer - CQV
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
  
  
Your impact
  
  
Design Manager-CQV is responsible for leading and delivering end-to-end commissioning, qualification, and validation (CQV) programs for pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical device projects. This role combines technical subject matter expertise with project leadership, ensuring compliance with global regulatory standards while meeting project timelines, quality, and budget targets.
  
  
The role requires deep experience in GxP environments, risk-based validation, and facility/equipment qualification, along with strong stakeholder and team management skills. The role will require an experienced, energetic, and committed CQV person with broad experience in C&Q, particularly biopharmaceuticals and having experience of >15 years. The person should have experience of leading CQV engineers for big projects and managing the C&Q documentation and execution lifecycle, from SLIA generation through to OQ/ PQ completion. They will work closely with cross-functional teams, including engineering, quality assurance, and manufacturing, to support the successful delivery of projects.
  
  

* Lead and execute CQV activities across multiple CQV projects, ensuring timely execution and compliance with industry regulations.
* Act as an SME for CQV having technical authority for systems such as process equipments, process utilities, automation, HVAC and controlled environments.
* Manage multi-disciplinary teams including CQV engineers, vendors, and contractors.
* Serve as the primary CQV interface with clients, design teams and Quality & regulatory teams.
* Track project deliverables, budgets, risks, and timelines and provide regular project updates and status reports to stakeholders.
* Drive decision-making and resolve escalations with engineering team and client.
* Involve in GMP review of layouts and systems and ensure CQV requirements are embedded early in the design lifecycle.
* Review P&IDs, layouts, URS, FS/DS, equipment specifications and vendor documentation.
* Mentor and guide CQV engineers and junior staff.
* Establish best practices, templates, and standard methodologies.
* Drive continuous improvement and knowledge sharing within the team.
* Prepare C&Q plans in line with the strategic goals of the client and manage timely and compliant delivery of the plan.
* Ensure all commissioning and qualification procedures are implemented and adhered to at office and at site level.
* Complete the development, review and execution of validation plans, URSs/DQ/TMs/FATs/SATs/IQ/OQ protocols/reports.
* Ensure all CQV activities comply with relevant regulatory requirements (e.g., FDA, EMA) and industry standards (e.g., ISPE, ASTM) and meets data integrity (ALOCOA+) principles. Well versed in commissioning and qualifying CIP & SIP systems

Here's what you'll need
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field. Advanced degree preferred. B. Pharm., M. Pharm., B.Tech or BE or MSc.
* 15+ year’s experience in CQV within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, specifically in drug substance manufacturing.

At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.
  
  
Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.
  
  
At Jacobs it’s all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!
  
  
We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.
  
  
Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

title: Business Process Owner - MG Salesforce
description:

If you are offered and accept this position and are actively employed by the Mobility Group when the transaction closes, the new company will provide further details to employees concerning compensation and benefits at that time.**
The Business Process Owner (BPO) - Salesforce is responsible for defining, governing, and continuously improving customer relationship management processes across Mobility through the Salesforce platform. The role serves as the primary business owner for CRM-enabled processes spanning Sales, Service, Warranty, and Customer Management, ensuring alignment between business objectives, process standards, data requirements, and technology capabilities.
  
  
This position acts as a strategic liaison between business stakeholders and IT teams, translating business needs into scalable digital solutions and ensuring successful deployment, adoption, and value realization of Salesforce capabilities. The role drives process standardization, business transformation, data quality, user adoption, and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance customer engagement, operational efficiency, and business performance globally.
  
  
Own and govern Salesforce-enabled business processes across Mobility, including Lead, Account, Contact, Opportunity, Quote, Service, Warranty, and Customer Management processes.
  
  
Define, document, maintain, and continuously improve global CRM process standards, business rules, workflows, and governance frameworks.
  
  
Partner with business leaders to evaluate current processes and identify opportunities for process simplification, standardization, automation, and digital transformation.
  
  
Gather, analyze, prioritize, and translate business requirements into functional designs and implementation roadmaps.
  
  
Collaborate with IT, Sales, Marketing, Customer Service, Warranty, MDM, and other cross-functional teams to deliver scalable CRM solutions.
  
  
Lead business process design workshops, requirement reviews, gap assessments, and solution validation activities.
  
  
Coordinate and execute User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to ensure solutions meet business requirements and expected outcomes.
  
  
Drive successful deployment and adoption of Salesforce capabilities across Mobility business units.
  
  
Develop and deliver training, communication, and change management programs to maximize user adoption and process compliance.
  
  
Establish and govern CRM-related KPIs, performance measures, and adoption metrics to monitor business value realization.
  
  
Partner with Data Governance and Master Data Management teams to ensure data quality, integrity, consistency, and usability.
  
  
Monitor CRM utilization, process effectiveness, user feedback, and enhancement opportunities to drive continuous improvement.
  
  
Manage stakeholder alignment and decision-making across global business functions, regions, and leadership teams.
  
  
Support long-term CRM roadmap execution and ensure alignment with Mobility business priorities and transformation objectives.

* Any Graduate
* 8-15 years of experience in customer relationship management processes and deployment

* Functional expertise in Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and CRM platform capabilities.

* Business Process Management (BPM), process mapping, and process governance methodologies.
* Business requirements gathering, process analysis, and solution design techniques.
* User Acceptance Testing (UAT), test planning, and validation methodologies.
* CRM reporting, dashboard development, and business performance measurement.
* Master Data Management (MDM), data governance, and data quality principles.
* Process documentation, workflow modeling, and business architecture practices.
* Salesforce integration concepts and cross-functional business process alignment.
* Functional design documentation and process standardization approaches.
* Strong stakeholder management and ability to influence decisions without direct authority.
* Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills across business and technology teams.
* Ability to drive consensus and alignment among diverse global stakeholders. Strong business acumen with understanding of commercial, customer service, warranty, and aftermarket operations.
* Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and facilitation skills.
* Strategic thinking with the ability to translate business objectives into process and technology solutions.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and decision-making capabilities.
* Change management and organizational transformation leadership.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic global environment.
* Strong planning, organization, and execution skills with attention to detail.
* Ability to work effectively across global regions, cultures, and time zones.
* Continuous learning mindset with focus on innovation and process excellence.
* Customer-centric approach with focus on delivering measurable business outcomes.
* Ability to act with urgency and make sound decisions in critical business situations.

description:
Job Title - Production Support Manager
  
  
Location - India (Gurugram / Pune)

**For Advertising:**
About FNZ Who we are: FNZ Group is an established and rapidly growing company in the financial technology sector. We partner with the entire industry to make wealth management accessible to more people. Today, we partner with over 650 financial institutions and 12,000 wealth management firms, enabling over 24 million people across all wealth segments to invest in the things they care the most about, on their own terms. We have over 30+ offices globally with 6000+ employees (and growing!). To learn more about us and our journey, check out our careers site.
  
  
Role Description Role Overview As Production Support Manager, you’ll take end-to-end ownership of Production Support outcomes for a regional cluster (e.g., UK / EU / APAC / NAM) delivered from our Global India Hub. You’ll lead talented teams across multiple platforms, set the operational rhythm, and partner closely with global stakeholders to keep our services stable, resilient, and continuously improving. If you enjoy high ownership, fast-paced delivery, and being the calm, decisive leader when it matters most, this role gives you the scope and visibility to make a real impact. Key Responsibilities Regional Ownership & Service Delivery
  
  

* Own Production Support delivery for your region from the India Hub—across platforms, teams, and priorities.
* Set a consistent, ITIL-aligned approach to incident, problem, and change management to protect stability and customer outcomes.
* Track and improve service performance through clear ownership of SLAs, KPIs, incident trends, and operational health.
* Balance demand, capacity, and cost—driving smarter planning, prioritization, and productivity.
* Proactively manage operational risk for the region, bringing visibility and momentum to mitigation and prevention. People Leadership & Team Growth
* Establish and develop regional Production Support teams, covering operating models, onboarding, and capability growth.
* Lead and develop group of analysts, creating a high-performance culture and strong succession pipeline.
* Ensure the right skill mix and shift coverage to meet regional demand—without compromising quality or wellbeing.
* Establish clear expectations and workflows to ensure consistent team delivery. Operational Governance & Continuous Improvement
* Own operational readiness for new platforms, clients, or regions transitioning into BAU support.
* Raise the quality bar for SOPs, runbooks, monitoring, and RCAs—so teams can respond faster and prevent recurrence.
* Partner with Engineering, Architecture, and global teams to reduce repeat incidents and operational toil.
* Use data to prioritize improvements, including automation and tooling uplift that make support more scalable. Stakeholder & Regional Engagement
* Be the trusted India Hub contact for regional stakeholders—providing crisp updates on performance, risks, and progress.
* Drive service reviews and governance forums, ensuring expectations match delivery and supporting effective decisions.
* Influence priorities and challenge constructively on scope and risk—helping teams focus on what matters most. What This Role Is / Is Not This role is:
* Ownership of regional service outcomes—not day-to-day ticket handling.
* A leadership role focused on people, delivery maturity, and operational excellence.
* A chance to scale and strengthen Production Support from India with real influence across the organization. You’ll thrive if you:
* Like leading through ambiguity and bringing structure, pace, and clarity.
* Stay calm under pressure and communicate with confidence during incidents.
* Enjoy building teams, improving systems, and raising the bar on reliability.

**Experience**
required What we are looking for:
  
  

* 10+ years in Production Support, Application Support, or Platform Operations.
* Proven experience to oversee multiple teams or platforms with over 20 members in a production environment.
* Strong understanding of incident, problem, and change management (ITIL-aligned).
* Demonstrated ability to manage regional stakeholders and service expectations.
* Experience leading through metrics, trends, and operational data.
* Strong people-management capability across Leads and senior technical staff.
* Excellent communication and decision-making skills under pressure.

**Experience**
preferred
  
  

* Experience supporting financial services or large-scale transactional platforms.
* Exposure to global operating models with follow-the-sun or regional coverage.
* Experience driving automation, tooling uplift, or operational transformation.

**For Advertising:**
Opportunities What do we offer:
  
  

* We are mission led - work at the heart of a purpose-led organization, where you can be proud of the impact you make, every day. Where you’ll transform the way over 20 million people invest, making wealth management more accessible, sustainable and transparent to more people.
* Rapid career growth - encouraged to take on responsibility, play a part in the evolution of the company and rapidly drive your career development working on real projects that directly impact our clients and their customers.
* Market leading technology - Build, create and evolve innovative solutions for the world’s most trusted brands using the latest technologies to help change the face of investing for the future
* Learning & development – Placing emphasis on a willingness to learn, to think differently, to be creative and to help drive innovation.

inclusion At FNZ, we recognise that diversity, equity and inclusion are important factors contributing to our success. are made in a non-discriminatory manner without regard to gender, ethnicity/race, faith, age, nationality, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, socio-economic background, disability or military veteran status where all applicants and employees are valued and respected. description:
**Company Description**
STAR POWERZ DIGITAL TECHNOLOGIES PVT LTD is a growing financial technology company that enables faster business expansion for channel partners through streamlined loan processing. title: Incident Response and Security Operations Technical Leader (L4)
description:
**About Armor Defense Inc**
At Armor, we are committed to making a meaningful difference in securing cyberspace. Our vision is to be the trusted protector and de facto standard that cloud-centric customers entrust with their risk. We strive to continuously evolve to be the best partner of choice, breaking norms and tirelessly innovating to stay ahead of evolving cyber threats and reshaping how we deliver customer outcomes. We are passionate about making a positive impact in the world, and we’re looking for a highly skilled and experienced talent to join our dynamic team.
  
  
Armor has unique offerings to the market so customers can a) understand their risk b) leverage Armor to co-manage their risk or c) completely outsource their risk to Armor.
  
  
Learn more at: https://www.armor.com
  
  
**Summary**
Armor is seeking an Incident Response and Security Operations Technical Leader to serve as the senior technical authority for our managed security practice in Pune. This role operates at the practice level, cooperating with a US based peer, defining incident response methodology, leading detection strategy, shaping the expanded operational scope of the SOC, and driving the highest-impact customer engagements. The Technical leaders actively leads strategic projects to operationalize new customer-facing capabilities across vulnerability management, control validation, data security, and security technology, and policy management. As the technical apex of the Incident Response and Security Operations (SOC) organization, this role mentors the entire team, influences cross-functional roadmaps, and represents Armor's security expertise to customers, partners, and industry forums.
  
  
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
Additional duties may be assigned as required.
  
  

* Define and continuously evolve incident response methodology, detection strategies, and consultation frameworks across the practice.
* Lead strategic customer engagements requiring senior technical consultation on incident response, threat landscape, and security architecture.
* Actively lead the most complex and highest-impact projects to operationalize new customer-facing SOC capabilities; set delivery standards across the practice.
* Serve as the ultimate technical escalation point for the most complex triage or incident investigations requiring advanced forensic analysis or threat research.
* Architect detection and response capabilities: SIEM optimization, SOAR workflow design, and threat detection use-case strategy.
* Build agentic AI capabilities to automate operations and drive the level of effort of the team towards supporting higher value customer engagement and decision making.
* Consult with customer executives on security strategy, risk posture, and program maturity.
* Evaluate and recommend, considering build vs. buy modalities, emerging technologies including AI/ML-assisted detection, automated response, and cloud-native security capabilities.
* Own the practice-level knowledge management strategy; ensure the SOC's collective knowledge is captured, current, and continuously enriched.
* Define cross-functional handoff standards and escalation protocols between the SOC and Engineering, Product, and Customer Success teams.
* Mentor the entire security operations organization; technical talent development needs and build programs to address them at scale in cooperation with management.
* Champion professional development across the practice; define certification roadmaps and create continuing education structures for all tiers.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with Engineering, Product, and Customer Success to align service capabilities with customer needs and market direction.
* Develop and deliver advanced training on analytical techniques, consultation skills, and emerging threats.
* Represent Armor's technical capabilities to customers, partners, and industry forums.
* Engage customers directly via video, phone, chat, and executive briefings; model the consultative standard for the entire team.

**Required Skills**

* Expert-level incident response expertise, including detection engineering and security architecture.
* Deep cloud security experience across Azure, AWS, and VMware, including cloud-native threat detection and response.
* Hands-on expertise with security platforms, including Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender XDR, QRadar, and other enterprise security tools.
* Advanced threat hunting and forensic analysis skills with experience leading investigations into sophisticated cyber threats.
* Strong scripting skills (Python, PowerShell, and KQL) for automation, detection engineering, and security tooling.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with agentic AI tools (Claude, OpenAI Codex, or equivalent) and AI/ML integration within security operations.
* Experience with additional security technologies such as Microsoft Purview, F5 WAF, and ChaosSearch.
* Expertise in vulnerability management, control validation, security technology management, and policy management.
* Strategic vision for evolving a SOC from reactive incident response to a proactive security consultancy.
* Strong leadership, mentoring, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Strong executive communication and customer consulting skills.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication, including incident reports, presentations, and customer deliverables.

**Education And/Or Experience**

* 8+ years of experience in incident response, security consulting, or detection engineering with progressive technical leadership.
* Required certifications within 12 months: AZ-500, SC-200, SC-300, SC-401
* Certifications required: GCIH and GCFA, or equivalent.
* Certifications preferred: CISSP, GREM, GNFA, OSCP.
* Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or related field required; Master's preferred; equivalent experience accepted.
* Sustained record of growing technical talent and advancing team capabilities through mentoring, training design, and continuing education.

title: Service Engineer
description:

At Barclays, we don't just anticipate the future - we're creating it.

* Administrating Microsoft Azure & M365 platform services
* Administration Of Large-Scale Email Platform.
* Message Hygiene Understanding should know concepts of SPF / DMARC / DKIM mandatory.
* Good Experience of Messaging Products like Proof Point / MDO / MDE / Exchange Hybrid Mode Setup
* Understanding of AD group and access management
* Knowledge of Security & Compliance centre, Azure Graph API & M365
* Hands on knowledge on ITIL framework and its application in a service operations environment
* Powershell Scripting capability, SQL Queries, KQL Queries

* Security, Compliance, and Identity Fundamentals (SC-900,SC-300 & AZ-900,MS-102,103)
* Experience of creating, testing and managing Conditional Access policies
* Experience of Global Relay / Proof Point email hygiene
* Demonstrable experience of managing MDO.

This role is based in Pune office.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To build and maintain infrastructure platforms and products that support applications and data systems, using hardware, software, networks, and cloud computing platforms as required with the aim of ensuring that the infrastructure is reliable, scalable, and secure. Ensure the reliability, availability, and scalability of the systems, platforms, and technology through the application of software engineering techniques, automation, and best practices in incident response.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Build Engineering: Development, delivery, and maintenance of high-quality infrastructure solutions to fulfil business requirements ensuring measurable reliability, performance, availability, and ease of use. Including the identification of the appropriate technologies and solutions to meet business, optimisation, and resourcing requirements.
* Incident Management: Monitoring of IT infrastructure and system performance to measure, identify, address, and resolve any potential issues, vulnerabilities, or outages. Use of data to drive down mean time to resolution.
* Automation: Development and implementation of automated tasks and processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual intervention, utilising software scripting/coding disciplines.
* Security: Implementation of a secure configuration and measures to protect infrastructure against cyber-attacks, vulnerabilities, and other security threats, including protection of hardware, software, and data from unauthorised access.
* Teamwork: Cross-functional collaboration with product managers, architects, and other engineers to define IT Infrastructure requirements, devise solutions, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives via a data driven approach.
* Learning: Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations, and actively contribute to the organization's technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.

**Assistant Vice President Expectations**

* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Head of PBU - Vantage AI
description: About UsHead of Product Business Unit, Anchanto Vantage AIAnchanto | Pune, India | Reports to the Chief Executive Officer | Unit of 10 to 30 people, growing with each bet About AnchantoAnchanto is an e-commerce and supply chain technology company headquartered in Singapore, with offices in twelve countries across Asia Pacific, the Middle East and Europe and its largest engineering center in Pune. Brands, retailers and logistics service providers use our purpose built SaaS products to run and scale their e-commerce and omnichannel operations: Order Management, Warehouse Management, Anchanto Grid with more than 200 ready integrations to marketplaces, carriers and enterprise systems, Parcel Tracking, Control Tower and Operations Experience. Our AI enabled agentic services, launching soon, help customers run their commerce operations with less manual work and faster decisions. More than 360 enterprise customers, including L'OrÃ©al, Panasonic, EstÃ©e Lauder, DKSH, Toll and Bosch, process over 200 million orders a year through Anchanto across more than 700 warehouses. Anchanto is an Asendia portfolio company.THE UNITAnchanto Vantage AI is the data, intelligence and economics business of Anchanto, and the Product Business Unit that builds our new products. Every customer runs their operation on our software, so we hold the most complete operational and financial data they have: orders, inventory, fulfilment events, carrier performance, marketplace performance, settlements and cost to serve, correlated in one place. Vantage AI is built on that asset. It owns the central data layer across every Anchanto product and the products that monetize it: data access for enterprise data and AI teams through MCP, connectors and streaming; operational, business and market insights; Anchanto Settle and Anchanto E-commerce Economics, the financial operations and economics products for e-commerce, starting with marketplace settlement reconciliation and extending to cost to serve, channel contribution and the financial health of the operation; and agentic decisioning for e-commerce and supply chain, where the system sees the stock out, the SLA breach or the margin leak before the customer does and acts or recommends the action.A Product Business Unit (PBU) at Anchanto is Product Management and Engineering for one business, brought together as a single threaded organization with one head, one backlog and one set of priorities. This unit is different from the other PBUs in one respect: it takes bets. It builds more than one new product, runs each through stage gates, and either spins it out as its own PBU or closes it on evidence. The first bet in build is Anchanto Settle and E-commerce Economics; the data foundation and the agentic products follow.THE ROLEYou build a product business from the data Anchanto already holds. You set where each product goes, build it with your own product and engineering team, take it to the first paying customers with the revenue teams, and answer for what it earns. This is not a pure product management role and it is not a data platform role: you lead the engineers who build the data layer and the products on it, you own the technical quality of what ships, and you are measured on outcomes, not activities. It is also not a role that protects its bets. You propose them, you fund them against a gate, and you close the ones that fail.WHAT YOU OWN: STRATEGY, ROADMAP, ENGINEERING, BETS AND RESULTS Product strategy. For each product in the unit you know the market, the buyer and the competitors better than anyone in the company, set the strategy and the positioning ambition with the industry research leaders, and give the CROs your input on pricing, packaging and the entitlement model (included, paid module, download and page level) before anything is built. The portfolio of bets. You propose which products the unit builds, in what order, with what envelope and against what gate. Each bet moves through the same gates: problem validated with named design partners; first paying customer; ten paying customers; gross margin at scale; then spin out as its own PBU or close. You take the close decision yourself and put it in writing with the evidence. The data foundation. The central data lake and pipelines from every Anchanto product, the warehouse model, shard discipline, access and entitlement, and the MCP, connector and streaming layer that gives enterprise customers their data back. Nothing above it works without it, so it is built first and kept to an internal SLA for every other unit that consumes it. Roadmap, decisions and execution. One backlog per bet; what gets built, in what order and how; technical design within the architecture and security guardrails; release decisions; and whether a product can meet a scope and a date. Customer priorities and asks on live products come to you from the Delivery team, your internal customer. The way we build. Specs based, AI assisted engineering from the first line of code. Two pizza teams per bet, forward deployed engineers with design partners, built on Anchanto Grid and the Vantage data layer rather than on new plumbing. A bet does not get its own infrastructure. Results and people. The unit's P&L and the spend envelope of each bet; reliability and customer satisfaction for live products; unit structure, hiring, promotions and the final interview of every person joining the unit. Your people are not a bench for other units; a transfer out of the unit is your decision. CUSTOMERS, DESIGN PARTNERS AND THE REVENUE TEAMSThis is not a sales role and carries no quota. The CROs set market priorities, the go to market and what and how each product is sold; the revenue teams own the customer connect and close every deal. A 0 to 1 unit needs discovery, so the rule here is wider than in the other units: you run design partner and discovery conversations with enterprise data teams, finance teams and operations leaders, with the account owner in the room and informed before and after, and you bring the revenue teams the product story, the demos and the answers. You never price, negotiate or close alone, and you never go around the account owner to reach a customer.How You Manage Your People Every person in the unit has written objectives and two or three KPIs for the quarter, reviewed monthly; nobody is without them thirty days after joining. Everyone in the unit is full time on the unit; nobody works on Vantage on the side of another job. Feedback is direct, factual and given within the week, in writing when it matters. You represent the company to your team, not the team to the company. Management debt, wrong decisions, undelivered feedback and unaddressed interpersonal issues, is fixed within thirty days of knowing about it. Performance is measured against objectives, not effort or tenure. An underperformer gets a written plan and a date; if it passes you take the decision yourself, including exit. People are confirmed and promoted only after a documented assessment and a direct conversation. The unit reports in numbers, weekly in writing and monthly in the outcome review. You talk to your N-1, your N-2 and every individual contributor, with skip level one to ones at least quarterly, and the unit runs on a written meeting cadence you publish in your first thirty days and keep. OWNING CUSTOMER ESCALATIONSAn escalation on a live product of the unit is yours from the moment it is raised until the customer confirms it is closed. You do not trivialize it, and you do not expect the CEO or the CROs to lead it. You own the fix and the communication: first written update within the hour, a fixed written cadence until closed, root cause and corrective action within five working days after. For the data layer, an outage or a data quality failure felt by another unit's customer is your escalation too.How You Are MeasuredYou own outcomes, not activities. Products without customers cannot be judged on retention and margin yet, so the outputs below are built for a unit that takes bets. You run the unit on five to eight controllable input metrics that you propose, prove move the outputs, and review every week. Numbers are baselined in your first month and verified by Finance. Gate progress Each bet against the gate committed in the quarterly plan: design partners signed, first paying customer, ten paying customers, gross margin at scale; bets closed on evidence count as progress, bets kept alive without evidence do not. Time to revenue and ARR per bet Months from start to first paying customer; ARR, net revenue retention and churn per product once live; deals unblocked or lost on product capability. Data foundation Products connected to the central data layer, data freshness and quality, enterprise customers on MCP, connector or streaming access, internal SLA met for the other units. Time to market Weeks from bet approved to a product early adopters can use; weeks from first build to first paying customer; early adopters signed and live with the revenue and account management teams each quarter; planned versus actual on the quarterly plan with variances explained in writing. Reliability and customer satisfaction Availability, incidents and time to resolve, data quality incidents, escalations by count, root cause and time to close, NPS or CSAT on live products. AI leverage and AI first approach Share of work built specs based and AI assisted, automation percentage by activity, and whether every product is designed AI first and agentic rather than as a dashboard. Team EPS and health Team EPS score, attrition and regretted attrition, skills coverage, and whether the unit runs without you in the room.PLANNING AND CADENCEYou write the product plan for the unit as a portfolio: which bets, the thesis and the buyer of each, the envelope, the gate and the date it is reviewed. The annual plan each October is a six page narrative with targets and resource scenarios. Four weeks before each quarter you write a ninety day plan derived from both, presented to and aligned with the leadership team; execution is measured against it. Weekly unit review on the inputs in writing, monthly outcome review with the CEO, quarterly gate review per bet, and a review of the two or three CEO goals for the unit.Skills And Prior ExperienceMust haves for every candidate. Candidates without all of these will not be shortlisted. At least fifteen years of industry experience, and at least one product taken personally from zero to paying customers in B2B SaaS, fintech or commerce technology, with accountability for its results. Global experience. Has worked in, and built or run operations outside India, with customers or teams in more than one country. India only experience does not qualify. Education. Engineering from IIT or NIT, or an MBA from IIM or a top ranked global business school. Data and AI products. Has built or run a product whose value is data, analytics or AI driven decisions, and can sit with an enterprise data team and a finance team in the same week and be credible with both. Domain. E-commerce, marketplaces, logistics or supply chain, or the finance and operations functions they serve. Decides and manages directly. Makes the call quickly, takes the trade off and answers for the outcome; has closed a product or a project of their own on evidence; has set objectives for every person, given hard feedback in time, taken exit decisions personally and owned the communication in a customer crisis. Career paths we are open to. Nobody arrives with product, technology, data and business skills at the same depth, so we hire from four paths and test for the second skill in each. Technology or data leader with product skills. CTO, Director of Engineering, Head of Data or equivalent who has built, released and commercialized data or AI systems, and has also owned a roadmap, met the market and made product trade offs. Product leader with technology depth. Head of Product for a data, analytics, fintech or commerce product in B2B SaaS, who has led or closely directed engineering and has shipped and commercialized what they defined. Operations or finance practitioner from a large 3PL, retailer, brand or marketplace. Has run e-commerce finance, settlements, supply chain or fulfilment operations at scale and has specified, bought or built the data and systems behind it well enough to direct a product team. Consultant or transformation leader. Head of a data, analytics, supply chain or commerce practice who has delivered data platforms, decisioning systems and operating models for clients end to end rather than advised from the side. In every path the second skill must be shown with specific examples. This role is not a data platform lead with a product manager reporting in, a BI or reporting manager, an innovation lab head who demonstrates but does not sell, a product leader who hands execution to someone else, a second sales channel to the customer, or a union leader for the team. Compensation: fixed salary, variable pay tied to the scorecard, and long term incentives; details shared with shortlisted candidates.Benefits Why Join AnchantoAt Anchanto, we believe in creating an environment where people can build meaningful careers, continuously develop their capabilities and gain exposure to a truly global business.Global Exposure: Work with diverse teams, customers and stakeholders across international markets and gain experience in a global B2B SaaS environment.Learning & Development: We invest in our people through sponsored learning, certifications and development opportunities aligned with your professional growth.International & Onsite Opportunities: Client-facing roles may offer opportunities to travel and work onsite with customers across our global markets.Medical Insurance: Comprehensive medical insurance coverage to support your health and well-being.Comprehensive Leave Benefits: Maternity, Paternity, Marriage and Bereavement leave, along with Comp Off and flexibility to support important personal commitments.Recognition for Long-Term Contribution: Tenured employees are eligible for additional monetary benefits, extra paid leave and company-sponsored paid vacations as part of our commitment to recognising long-term contribution.Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: A supportive and flexible work environment that enables employees to manage professional responsibilities alongside personal priorities.Meaningful Career Growth: Take ownership of challenging, high-impact work and contribute to products and solutions that serve global brands, retailers and logistics businesses.

title: Strategic Transformation Lead
description:
Unlock your potential with Dassault Systèmes, a global leader in Scientific Software Engineering as Strategic Transformation Lead in Pune, India!
  
  
**Role Description & Responsibilities**
We are not looking for someone to run a playbook; we are looking for someone to write it. Our Transformation Office operates as an agile, internal consulting group dedicated to helping other departments evolve, optimize, and scale. Because the needs of the business are constantly shifting, there is no pre-planned roadmap or rigid process for what needs transforming.
  
  
We need a proactive visionary who can parachute into any department, diagnose the underlying challenges, and architect a transformation strategy from scratch. This is a rare, highly dynamic role that requires a "unicorn" skill set: the analytical rigor to understand complex systems, the business acumen to align with corporate strategy, and the linguistic dexterity to seamlessly translate between Finance, Sales, and Delivery teams.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Discover & Diagnose: Proactively partner with departmental leaders to identify blind spots, operational bottlenecks, and areas ripe for transformation. You will figure out what needs to change before the business even realizes it.
* Act as the Cross-Functional Translator: Seamlessly navigate the competing priorities and distinct languages of Finance (margins, EBITDA, cost structures), Sales (pipelines, win rates, quotas), and Delivery (SLAs, resource allocation, utilization).
* Design Bespoke Solutions: Build custom transformation frameworks tailored to the specific problem at hand, recognizing that a solution for the Sales team will look vastly different than one for Delivery.
* Drive Execution Through Influence: Lead change management efforts without direct authority, acting as a trusted advisor and coach to help teams adopt new operational models.
* Build the Plane While Flying It: Thrive in an environment with high ambiguity, bringing structure to chaos and turning abstract business problems into actionable, measurable transformation projects.

**Qualifications**

* The Engineer-Strategist: You possess an Engineering mindset to break down complex, systemic problems into solvable parts, paired with an MBA-level understanding of holistic business strategy.
* Highly Adaptable: You do not wait for a brief or a step-by-step guide. You are entirely comfortable walking into a room, asking the right questions, and defining the scope of work yourself.
* A Master Communicator: You can explain a technical delivery constraint to a VP of Sales, and a financial hurdle to a Lead Engineer, ensuring everyone is aligned and moving in the same direction.

**What You Bring**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field combined with an MBA (strongly preferred).
* Experience: 5-10 years of experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, operations, or a cross-functional leadership role.
* Domain Fluency: Proven ability to understand and speak to the core metrics, challenges, and workflows of Finance, Sales, and Delivery organizations.
* Change Management: Demonstrated success in leading complex change initiatives across multiple business units in a fast-paced environment.

**What’s In It For You**

* Work in a culture of collaboration and innovation
* Be at the forefront of building software products that are being deployed in mission-critical projects world wide
* Be offered avenues to develop yourself for career progression
* Not a low-level development opportunity, as you would get to work in the real business world and with a wide range of customers & coworkers

Inclusion statement
  
  
As a game-changer in sustainable technology and innovation, Dassault Systèmes is striving to build more inclusive and diverse teams across the globe. We believe that our people are our number one asset and we want all employees to feel empowered to bring their whole selves to work every day. It is our goal that our people feel a sense of pride and a passion for belonging. As a company leading change, it’s our responsibility to foster opportunities for all people to participate in a harmonized Workforce of the Future.

description:
For more than 30 years, SonicWall has delivered a partner-first unified cybersecurity portfolio that helps SMBs, MSPs, and IT teams consolidate network security, endpoint security, security service edge (SSE), and threat response across hybrid environments. By bringing connected technology, real-time threat intelligence, automation, and expert services together, SonicWall helps organizations simplify security operations, achieve better security outcomes, and lower total cost of ownership. Backed by a global ecosystem of more than 17,000 partners, SonicWall delivers enterprise-grade protection built for SMB and mid-market realities.

 

For more information, visit


www.sonicwall.com

or follow us on


X,


LinkedIn

,


Facebook

, and


Instagram

.

 

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a highly experienced
**Senior QA Manager**
to own end-to-end quality for
**SonicOS**
, the core operating system powering SonicWall’s next-generation firewall products. This is a high-impact leadership role where you will define quality strategy, drive automation and test infrastructure investments, and partner closely with Product Management, Development, Release Engineering, DevOps, and Support teams to ensure every release meets high standards of reliability, security, and customer trust.

You will be responsible not just for test execution, but for shaping how quality is built into the product lifecycle — from early design reviews and threat modelling to release readiness and post-release learning.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Quality Strategy & Release Ownership**

* Define and continuously improve the QA strategy for SonicOS across major releases, patches, and hotfixes
* Establish quality gates, entry/exit criteria, and clear release readiness standards
* Drive risk-based testing and shift-left practices to catch issues early
* Own go/no-go decisions for releases from a quality standpoint

**Firewall Domain & Technical Leadership**

* Provide strong technical leadership across firewall features such as:

+ Stateful firewall, NAT, VPN (IPSec/SSL), routing, HA
+ Security services like IPS, DPI-SSL, Gateway AV, App Control, Web Filtering

* Review PRDs, design documents, and architecture proposals with a quality & security mindset
* Define comprehensive test strategies covering:

+ Functional correctness and complex E2E customer workflows
+ Performance, scale, and stress (throughput, sessions, DPI impact)
+ HA failover, upgrades/downgrades, config migrations, and long-run stability

* Champion security and negative testing to validate abuse cases and threat scenarios

**Automation, CI/CD & Test Infrastructure**

* Define the long-term automation vision (UI, API, CLI, E2E) and measurable coverage goals
* Partner with automation leads to build scalable, reliable frameworks integrated into CI/CD
* Drive stability and reliability of automated test suites (reduce flakiness, improve signal)
* Own strategy for testbeds spanning hardware appliances, virtual firewalls, and cloud deployments
* Work with infra teams to ensure availability, capacity planning, and reliability of test environments

**Execution Excellence & Metrics**

* Own and track key quality metrics: defect leakage, escape rate, regression effectiveness, automation ROI, flakiness trends
* Lead regular release readiness and quality reviews with senior stakeholders
* Drive deep root cause analysis for production escapes and systemic quality gaps
* Convert learnings from field issues into preventive quality improvements

**People Leadership & Stakeholder Influence**

* Build, mentor, and retain a strong leadership bench of QA managers, leads, and senior engineers
* Set clear expectations, career paths, and technical growth plans for the QA organization
* Influence engineering leadership and PMs to prioritize quality, reliability, and customer impact
* Represent QA in leadership forums, customer escalations, and cross-functional reviews

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 10+ years of total technical experience, including at least 2+ years in a management or leadership role
* Strong background in testing firewall / network security products or similar system software
* Deep understanding of networking and security fundamentals (TCP/IP, routing, NAT, VPN, HA, IPS/DPI concepts, authentication mechanisms)
* Experience owning quality for complex, large-scale system software releases
* Proven leadership experience managing and scaling QA teams across geographies
* Strong exposure to automation strategy and CI/CD-driven quality practices
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence senior technical stakeholders

**Good to Have**

* Prior experience with SonicOS or comparable firewall OS platforms
* Exposure to security compliance programs (FIPS, Common Criteria, SOC2)
* Experience testing in hybrid environments (hardware + virtual + cloud)
* Experience handling customer escalations and field issue RCA

**What Success Looks Like**

* Predictable, high-quality SonicOS releases with reduced Sev1/Sev2 customer issues
* Measurable improvement in automation coverage and test effectiveness
* Faster feedback cycles for Dev and PM through shift-left and CI/CD integration
* Strong QA leadership bench and high team engagement
* Improved customer trust and reduced critical escalations
