title: Sr Mgr. Product Support
description: Why UKGAt UKG, the work you do matters. The code you ship, the decisions you make, and the care you show a customer all add up to real impact. Today, tens of millions of workers start and end their days with our workforce operating platform. Helping people get paid, grow in their careers, and shape the future of their industries. That’s what we do.We never stop learning. We never stop challenging the norm. We push for better, and we celebrate the wins along the way. Here, you’ll get flexibility that’s real, benefits you can count on, and a team that succeeds together. Because at UKG, your work matters—and so do you.About The RoleThe Senior Manager, Real-Time Operations and Workforce Management will build and lead a new 24/7 Real-Time Operations Center in Pune, India. This leader will establish the processes, operating rhythms, tools, and team capabilities required to manage intraday workforce performance across a global Support organization.The role combines WFM expertise with strong operational leadership. The Senior Manager will oversee real-time staffing, schedule execution, adherence, shrinkage, queue health, and live customer demand across calls and case work. Using NICE CXone WFM and Salesforce, this leader will ensure emerging risks are identified early, decisions are made quickly, and actions are coordinated with Support leadership, WFM planning, and frontline managers.This leader will also help translate broader Customer Experience priorities and the Operational Rigor framework into practical daily operating mechanisms. The goal is to improve visibility, accountability, service protection, productivity, and customer outcomes while freeing frontline managers to focus on case progression, coaching, quality, employee development, and customer commitments.Key ResponsibilitiesReal-Time Operations Center Leadership Build and operationalize the Real-Time Operations Center, including its staffing model, coverage plan, role clarity, shift structure, handoff routines, escalation paths, and management cadences. Lead and develop a distributed 24/7 team of Real-Time Operations Specialists, establishing expectations for decision quality, responsiveness, documentation, communication, and customer-impact awareness. Create a culture of ownership, urgency, analytical thinking, and disciplined execution in which the Center actively protects service and customer outcomes rather than simply reporting conditions.Intraday Workforce Management and Service Protection Oversee intraday monitoring and intervention across global Support operations, including staffing levels, queue conditions, contact volumes, case backlogs, service levels, productivity, occupancy, and emerging demand or capacity gaps. Use NICE CXone WFM to monitor schedules against actual activity, manage real-time adherence, identify late starts, absences, extended AUX states, and other deviations, and coordinate approved schedule or coverage changes. Establish response playbooks for staffing shortages, unexpected volume, shrinkage events, system disruption, high-priority customer demand, backlog risk, and other business-continuity situations. Ensure the Center monitors both live calls and Salesforce case queues so customer demand is managed across channels and work types rather than through a voice-only lens.Operational Rigor and Process Design Design and continuously improve standard operating procedures, decision rights, escalation matrices, shift handoffs, incident routines, and evidence-based operating practices for real-time management. Partner with WFM leadership to align real-time execution with forecasting, scheduling, skill-group consolidation, shift optimization, heat maps, capacity models, and broader workforce planning. Help standardize AUX codes, shrinkage categories, schedule adherence practices, queue definitions, reporting logic, and operational terminology across Support business units. Develop dashboards, daily views, interval reporting, and recurring operational communications that create a reliable single source of truth for managers and leaders.Cross-Functional Leadership and Customer Experience Partner with Support Services, WFM, Ready, Pro, Pro WFM, Operations, Technology, Product, and other stakeholders to align real-time actions to customer experience priorities and business commitments. Translate operational signals into clear recommendations, decisions, and escalations for Support leaders, including the likely effect on customer wait time, case aging, service level, resolution speed, and employee experience. Ensure real-time operations are connected to the broader Ops Rigor framework, including customer outcomes, operational health and flow, management routines, governance, and accountability. Represent the Real-Time Operations Center in operating reviews and transformation forums, bringing forward patterns, systemic gaps, and opportunities to improve the Support operating model.Analytics, Governance, and Change Adoption Define and monitor performance measures such as schedule adherence, shrinkage, occupancy, queue and case service levels, staffing variance, productivity, backlog risk, escalation response, and data quality. Establish inspection and review routines that distinguish planned schedules from actual AUX activity and reinforce accurate, timely operational data. Lead change adoption for new WFM processes, CXone capabilities, Salesforce operational views, and real-time management routines, ensuring changes are understood and embedded into daily work. Use trends and root-cause analysis to recommend improvements to staffing, skills, processes, technology, and cross-functional ownership.Basic Qualifications 8+ years of experience in workforce management, contact center operations, customer support operations, real-time management, or a related operational leadership field. Demonstrated experience leading intraday or real-time operations in a complex, multi-site, multi-channel contact center or enterprise support environment. Strong working knowledge of WFM disciplines, including forecasting and scheduling partnership, real-time adherence, shrinkage, occupancy, staffing variance, service levels, and interval management. Experience using NICE CXone WFM, NICE IEX, or a comparable enterprise WFM and ACD platform. Experience with Salesforce Service Cloud or comparable case-management tooling is strongly preferred. Proven ability to build operating models, standard operating procedures, escalation frameworks, dashboards, and governance routines from the ground up. Strong people leadership, executive communication, analytical reasoning, and decision-making skills in a fast-paced, matrixed environment. Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree or relevant WFM, contact center, or operations certification preferred.Preferred Qualifications Experience launching or transforming a command center, real-time operations center, or centralized intraday management function. Experience managing global operations across multiple regions, time zones, languages, channels, skill groups, or business units. Experience with workforce capacity models, interval forecasting, heat maps, business-continuity planning, and operational reporting. Experience driving change management, workforce discipline, and adoption of standardized operating practices across distributed teams.Success ProfileThe ideal candidate is a builder and operator who can create structure without slowing the business down. This leader combines contact-center WFM expertise with sound judgment, clear communication, and a strong customer lens. They are comfortable making time-sensitive decisions with incomplete information, escalating appropriately, and turning real-time signals into coordinated action. They will be measured not only by the accuracy of reports, but by whether the Center helps Support leaders act earlier, protect customer experience, improve workforce discipline, and create a more predictable operating environment.Company OverviewUKG is the Workforce Operating Platform that puts workforce understanding to work. With the world's largest collection of workforce insights, and people-first AI, our ability to reveal unseen ways to build trust, amplify productivity, and empower talent, is unmatched. It's this expertise that equips our customers with the intelligence to solve any challenge in any industry — because great organizations know their workforce is their competitive edge. Learn more at ukg.com.UKG is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to promoting diversity and inclusion in the workplace, including the recruitment process. title: Production Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Rexel with a mission to support customers around the globe, to create value and run their business effectively, Rexel is a global player which provides Industrial Automation, Supply Chain Consolidation and Lighting solutions. With approximately € 19.2 Bn turnover and having presence in 17 countries with headquarter in Paris, France, Rexel through its 26000+ employees globally, is supporting its customers through wide range of innovative products and solutions, wherever they are.
  
  
Rexel in India, is a fully owned INR 800 cr + subsidiary of Rexel Global, having presence in the country with 16 branches and 16 stock points, from where we are serving customers on a Pan Inda level. We offer a wide variety of products across various categories covering length and breadth of the Industrial Automation, Lighting requirements, Panels and Supply Chain Consolidation (C-Class Direct and Indirect material purchases) for plants and offices. We are a one stop source for your business needs ranging from Stationery, office supplies to Industrial Automation.

* Experience in electrical/PLC automation panel manufacturing
* Shop floor production supervision and manpower handling
* Knowledge of PLC control panels, MCC, PCC, APFC, and VFD panels.
* Ability to read electrical drawings and schematics.
* Hands-on experience in panel wiring and testing.
* Familiarity with Siemens, Allen Bradley, Schneider, ABB, Mitsubishi, or Omron PLC systems.
* Knowledge of electrical standards such as IEC, UL508A, and IS standards.
* Proficiency in AutoCAD and Microsoft Office.
* Coordination and communication skills.
* Basic computer and documentation skills
* To plan, coordinate, and execute the manufacturing, wiring, assembly, and testing of PLC, MCC, PCC, VFD, and control panels while ensuring compliance with customer specifications, quality standards, safety requirements, and project timelines.
* Production planning and execution
* Shop floor supervision
* Panel manufacturing control
* Coordinate with design, engineering, procurement, and project teams.
* Review technical changes and implement revisions in production.
* Support customer inspections and factory acceptance tests (FAT).
* Quality and Testing compliance/QAP procedure responsibility with the help of QC Team
* Material and Inventory coordination with Logistic/store team
* Manpower Management, Safety Management at shop floor, dispatch and unloading/loading support
* Responsible for end-to-end shop floor production, manpower supervision, quality compliance, safety and on-time delivery of project or panels.

**Qualifications**
Diploma/BE/B. Tech in Electrical/Instrumentation Engineering or equivalent with 8-12 years of exp.

title: Shift Supervisor - Design Operations #6
description:
Binated is looking for an experienced
**Shift Supervisor – Design Operations**
to join our team in Pune.

We are specifically looking for someone with a professional background in graphic design/design operations who has progressed into a team-handling or supervisory role.

**The ideal candidate should understand creative/design workflows while also being capable of managing people, allocating work, monitoring productivity and quality, and ensuring timely delivery.**

This role is suitable for an experienced Graphic Designer, Senior Designer, Design Team Lead, Creative Team Lead, or Design Supervisor who has hands-on design experience along with team-handling responsibilities.

**Job Type: Full-time, Permanent**

**Location: Pune – Work from Office**

**Shift: Night Shift / Rotational Shift**

**Working Days: 5 days per week**

**Key Responsibilities**

**Design & Production Operations**

* Manage and supervise the day-to-day workflow of the design/production team during the assigned shift.
* Understand design requirements and ensure work is assigned to team members based on their skills, workload, and priorities.
* Take ownership of all assigned orders/projects and ensure completion within defined turnaround times and SLAs.
* Monitor live production queues and prioritize urgent or high-value assignments.
* Ensure design briefs, customer specifications, brand guidelines, and production requirements are correctly understood and followed.
* Identify bottlenecks in the design workflow and take immediate corrective action.
* Escalate high-priority or at-risk orders before they become overdue.

**Team Leadership & Supervision**

* Lead and supervise a team of designers/production associates during the assigned shift.
* Allocate work effectively based on individual skills, capacity, and business priorities.
* Monitor team productivity, attendance, quality, and overall performance.
* Provide guidance and support to designers when they face design or production-related challenges.
* Coach team members to improve quality, productivity, accuracy, and turnaround time.
* Conduct effective shift handovers and communicate pending work, priorities, and escalations.
* Maintain discipline and ensure adequate staffing throughout the shift.

**Quality & Design Standards**

* Review design output to ensure it meets required quality standards before completion/delivery.
* Ensure adherence to design guidelines, customer specifications, SOPs, and internal quality standards.
* Identify recurring quality issues and work with the team to reduce errors and rework.
* Provide constructive feedback to designers to improve overall output quality.

**Operational Excellence**

* Monitor workflow and productivity throughout the shift.
* Coordinate with Quality, Customer Service, and Operations teams to resolve production issues.
* Identify opportunities to improve processes, turnaround times, and team efficiency.
* Ensure adherence to standard operating procedures and company policies.
* Take ownership of operational issues occurring during the assigned shift.

**Reporting**

**Prepare and maintain end-of-shift reports covering:**

* Orders/tasks received and completed
* Pending work and reasons for delays
* SLA performance
* Individual and team productivity
* Quality and rework issues
* Attendance and staffing
* System or resource concerns
* Major escalations and corrective actions

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Order/task clearance rate
* SLA compliance
* On-time delivery
* Team productivity
* Design quality and accuracy
* Rework/error rate
* Pending order percentage
* Escalation response time
* Team attendance and shift discipline

**Required Experience & Skills**

* 2–5 years of overall professional experience, preferably within graphic design, creative production, or design operations.
* Hands-on experience working as a Graphic Designer, Senior Designer, Creative Designer, or in a similar design-related role.
* Minimum 1 year of team-handling, team-lead, supervisory, or people-management experience preferred.
* Strong understanding of design workflows and creative production processes.
* Ability to review design work and identify quality or execution issues.
* Strong leadership and people-management skills.
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
* Ability to manage deadlines and multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
* Good organizational and time-management skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and production/workflow management systems is preferred.

**Candidate Profile**

We would particularly like to hear from candidates currently working as:

**Senior Graphic Designer | Design Team Lead | Graphic Design Team Lead | Creative Team Lead | Design Supervisor | Senior Designer with Team-Handling Experience**

Candidates with only general operations or customer-service supervisory experience without a design/creative background may not be suitable for this position.

**Job Requirements**

* Strong written and verbal English communication.
* Must have a design/creative production background.
* Must have team-handling or leadership experience.
* Willing to work in night/rotational shifts.
* Comfortable working from the office in Pune.
* Available for a 5-day working schedule.
* Graduate preferred.
* Immediate joiners preferred.
* Must have relevant educational and employment documents.

**Benefits**

* Leave Encashment
* Provident Fund
* Shift Allowance
* Overtime Pay
* Yearly Bonus

title: Manager - Network Security
description:
**About Cognizant Corporate**
Cognizant Corporate is a global community united by a shared purpose: to make a meaningful impact. We are committed to excellence and driven by outcomes that matter. Collaboration is at the heart of how we work, and our forward-thinking mindset fuels continuous learning, innovation, and growth.
  
  
At Cognizant, careers transcend titles. We empower our people to think strategically, inspire others, and lead with purpose – always guided by our core values. Join us in shaping future of business.
  
  
**About The Role**
The
**Manager, Network Security Engineering and Operations**
will provide technical and operational leadership for enterprise network security services across traditional firewall, remote-access, identity-based access, and cloud-delivered Zero Trust technologies.
**12 to 16 years**
of experience in enterprise networking or network security, including substantial experience in technical leadership or service management.
  
  
Demonstrated experience managing Network Security engineering or operations teams in a large, distributed enterprise
  
  
**Role**
The role will be accountable for service strategy, architecture governance, engineering delivery, operational stability, security compliance, major-incident leadership, and team capability across:
  
  

* Enterprise firewalls, preferably Cisco ASA/FTD and Palo Alto Networks
* Remote Access VPN using Cisco Secure Client/AnyConnect
* Site-to-site IPSec VPN
* Cisco Identity Services Engine
* Zscaler Internet Access
* Zscaler Private Access
* Zero Trust Network Access and Secure Access Service Edge

**In This Role, You Will**
1. Service Ownership and Leadership
  
  

* Own the end-to-end lifecycle of enterprise Network Security services, including strategy, architecture, engineering, transition, operations and optimisation
* Establish clear service ownership, operating procedures, escalation paths and accountability across internal technology teams.
* Define annual service roadmaps covering platform upgrades, security improvements, automation, technology refresh, resilience and legacy retirement.
* Manage service performance, capacity, availability, risks, dependencies, technical debt and operational readiness.
* Act as the management escalation point for significant service, delivery, stakeholder and vendor issues.
* Balance operational stability with security transformation and business delivery priorities.
* Architecture and Design Governance
* Provide design authority for network security solutions across corporate environments, data centres, remote users, cloud platforms, business units, merged entities and isolated environments.
* Review and approve high-level and low-level designs, security patterns, traffic-flow diagrams, migration approaches, implementation plans and operational acceptance criteria.
* Govern technical standards for firewalls, RAVPN, IPSec tunnels, Cisco ISE, ZIA, ZPA, App Connectors, traffic forwarding and endpoint posture.
* Ensure architecture decisions align with Zero Trust, least privilege, segmentation and defence-in-depth principles.
* Technology and Engineering Leadership

Maintain Sufficient Technical Depth To Guide Engineering Teams, Challenge Vendor Recommendations, Approve Designs And Support Critical Escalations Across The Following Domains
  
  
**Firewalls**

* Cisco ASA/FTD, Firewall Management Center, Palo Alto Networks and Panorama
* Security policies, ACLs, NAT, segmentation, routing and high availability
* IPS/IDS, URL filtering, SSL inspection and threat prevention
* Rule optimisation, recertification and removal of obsolete policies
* Platform lifecycle, patching and vulnerability remediation

**Remote Access and IPSec VPN**

* Cisco Secure Client/AnyConnect architecture
* SSL VPN, IKEv1/IKEv2 and site-to-site IPSec VPN
* Authentication, authorization, SAML, RADIUS and certificates
* Tunnel profiles, split tunnelling, routing, NAT and resiliency
* Migration from conventional VPN access to application-based Zero Trust access

**Cisco ISE**

* Authentication and authorization policies
* RADIUS, TACACS+, 802.1X, profiling and posture
* Certificate and identity integrations
* VPN posture, device compliance and access enforcement
* Node health, upgrades, high availability and disaster recovery

**Zscaler ZIA and ZPA**

* ZIA traffic forwarding through ZCC, GRE, IPSec, Cloud Connectors and service edges
* URL filtering, SSL inspection, DNS security, cloud firewall, threat prevention and DLP integration
* ZPA App Connectors, application segments, access policies, Browser Access, posture and identity integration
* Managed, unmanaged and isolated-device access patterns
* App Connector placement, capacity, application discovery and segmentation
* ZIA/ZPA policy governance, administrative access and logging
* Operations, Delivery and Problem Management
* Ensure effective L3/L4 support for firewall, RAVPN, IPSec, ISE, ZIA and ZPA services.
* Lead or oversee P1/P2 incidents, technical war rooms and executive escalations.
* Coordinate troubleshooting across network, security, endpoint, identity, cloud, application, vendor and service-management teams.
* Ensure Network Security platforms comply with corporate security baselines, internal standards and applicable control frameworks.
* Partner with Corporate Security and Audit teams to provide evidence for firewall governance, endpoint posture, identity enforcement, vulnerability remediation and access controls.
* Support NIST, ISO, internal audit and regulatory evidence requirements as applicable.
* Lead security transformation programmes involving RAVPN-to-ZPA migration, firewall optimisation, application segmentation and cloud-security adoption.
* Lead, coach and develop a team of Network Security engineers and technical leads.
* Build effective relationships with Corporate Security, Architecture, IAM, Endpoint, Cloud, Network Operations, Service Management and business stakeholders.
* Translate technical issues and risks into clear business impact, decisions and investment requirements.
* Manage engineering and escalation relationships with Cisco, Palo Alto Networks, Zscaler and implementation partners.
* Review vendor proposals, statements of work, architecture recommendations and product roadmaps.
* Hold vendors accountable for defect resolution, root-cause findings, security fixes, platform reliability and delivery commitments.
* Coordinate complex incidents and interoperability issues involving multiple providers.
* Ensure all material decisions, responsibilities and dependencies are captured through documented RACI and governance structures.

**These will help you succeed**
**Preferred Certifications**

* CCNP Security or equivalent Cisco security certification
* Palo Alto Networks PCNSE
* Zscaler ZIA/ZPA Administrator or Zscaler Digital Transformation certification
* ITIL Foundation or advanced IT service-management certification
* Relevant cloud certification in Azure, AWS or GCP

**Work model –**
We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 2-3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Pune, Maharashtra. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance though our various wellbeing programs.

description:
**Location:**
Chakan, Pune (full-time, on-site)

**Reports to:**
Board of Directors

**About Sadguru Autocomponents Pvt. Ltd. (SAPL)**

SAPL is an end-to-end aluminium die casting solution provider in Chakan MIDC, Pune, serving global customers with precision and critical aluminium castings. We supply automotive and non-automotive sectors, including electrical, consumer appliances, industrial equipment, HVAC, architectural and medical applications.

Our facility has fully automatic high-pressure and gravity die casting lines, a modern machine shop with CNC and VMC machining, multi-spindle drilling and tapping, and leak testing, plus an in-house powder coating unit with advanced pre-treatment. We are ISO 9001:2015 certified, are transitioning to IATF 16949, and are building a reputation for reliability in India and abroad.

**The Role**

We are looking for a Plant Head to lead end-to-end operations of our aluminium die casting plant. You will be responsible for production output, quality, delivery, cost and safety, and for the people who deliver them.

You will work closely with maintenance, quality, machining and powder coating to keep workflows smooth and meet customer specifications and regulatory standards. You will drive continuous improvement, Lean and 5S, and best practice in die casting and machining, and you will support customer audits and ISO and IATF compliance.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Plan and run daily plant operations, including production planning, scheduling, manpower and machine allocation.
* Deliver against safety, quality, delivery and cost targets, and track performance through clear plant metrics (OEE, scrap, cycle time, on-time delivery).
* Lead root cause analysis and corrective action for defects, customer complaints and process issues.
* Drive cycle time reduction, die life improvement, porosity reduction and yield improvement across HPDC and GDC.
* Manage the plant budget, cost control and capacity utilisation.
* Coordinate with NPD and tooling on new part industrialisation, trials (T0) and customer approvals.
* Lead, coach and develop plant supervisors and staff, and build a disciplined, accountable team culture.
* Maintain ISO 9001 and move the plant to IATF 16949 requirements, including internal audits and PPAP/APQP support.
* Represent the plant in customer reviews and cross-functional meetings.

**Qualifications and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Mechanical or Production Engineering, or a related field. Advanced certification in manufacturing, quality or operations management is an advantage.
* 10+ years in aluminium die casting, machining or automotive component manufacturing, including prior plant or department leadership.
* Strong hands-on knowledge of HPDC and GDC processes: tooling, gating, thermal balance, parameter optimisation and defect analysis.
* Working knowledge of CNC/VMC machining and powder coating processes.
* Proven experience with production planning and scheduling, capacity management and workflow optimisation.
* Experience implementing and maintaining ISO 9001 and IATF 16949 systems, process audits and root cause analysis.
* Strong new product development and industrialisation experience.
* Excellent people management, communication and stakeholder skills, with the ability to lead cross-functional teams.

**Position Summary**

**Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) - SAP MM/FICO/SD integration with Direct or Indirect Tax experience**
Deloitte’s Tax Transformation Consulting practice is seeking a Manager, Tax Services professional to help clients modernize and improve their tax operations. In this role, you will lead SAP tax transformation and application managed services efforts, guide teams through complex delivery requirements, and help translate tax and business needs into technology-enabled solutions. You will work across tax, process, and technology teams to support scalable, compliant, and efficient tax functions.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Manager, Tax Services professional on the Tax Transformation Consulting team, you will be responsible for...
  
  

* Business Development: Develop and maintain contact with top decision makers at key clients; organize and lead pursuit teams; participate and lead aspects of the proposal development process; contribute to the development of proposal pricing strategies
* Client Management: Manage the day-to-day interactions with executive clients and sponsors
* Engagement Management: Lead engagement planning and budgeting; mobilize and manage engagement teams; define deliverable structure and content; facilitate buy-in of proposed solutions from top management levels at the client; direct on-time, quality delivery of work products; manage engagement economics; and manage engagement risk
* AMS Delivery & Operations Management: Own end-to-end delivery of SAP FICO/MM/SD tax AMS engagements, including SLA governance, ticket triage and escalation across L1/L2/L3, incident and problem management, and driving continuous improvement in support processes and tooling
* Practice Development & Eminence: Develop practical solutions and methodologies; develop "thought-ware" and "point-of-view" documents; participate in public speaking events; get published in industry periodicals
* People Development: Perform the role of counselor and coach; provide input and guidance into the staffing process; actively participate in staff recruitment and retention activities; provide leadership and support for delivery teams and staff in local offices

**The team**
Deloitte’s Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) - Ever expanding regulations and increasing scrutiny on multinational corporations has made it necessary for leading-edge tax departments to serve a critical role in the risk management and overall performance of the enterprise. This has resulted in an opportunity for Deloitte to provide even greater value through our tax services, in helping develop tax departments of the future that are strategic, agile, and, above all, focused on creating value for the business.
  
  
Deloitte's TTC group helps our clients' tax departments move forward from their current state to the next generation of tax functions and is dedicated to finding new methods and processes to assist clients in improving their tax operations. Deloitte TTC professionals are aligned across our global network of member firms to address our clients' objectives in a seamless fashion. Deloitte TTC teams include industry, tax, organizational change, technology, and co-sourcing specialists who help connect our clients' global strategies with the options that exist to turn strategy into an executable plan.
  
  
TTC's Enterprise Tax Transformation (ETT) professionals provide an integrated approach to process improvement that can help the tax department maximize its strategic value to the organization. Companies that have already implemented, or are considering implementing, an enterprise resource planning (ERP) system often overlook the tax benefits these systems can provide or underestimate the impact on the tax department. To be most effective from a tax perspective, a successful ERP implementation requires professionals who specialize in tax and can effectively address a corporate tax function's unique needs, requirements, and obligations. Our ETI team, the largest of its type, offers the necessary combination of skills, methodology, and practical experience to help clients avoid the pitfalls of an ERP implementation.

title: Technology Consulting Manager - Manufacturing OT
description:
**ZS**
is a place where passion changes lives. As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it, we transform ideas into impact by
**bringing together data, science, technology**
and
**human ingenuity**
to deliver better outcomes for all. Here you’ll work side-by-side with a powerful collective of thinkers and experts shaping life-changing solutions for patients, caregivers and consumers, worldwide. ZSers drive impact by bringing a
**client-first mentality**
to each and every engagement. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life-changing impact to ZS.
  
  
**About ZS Manufacturing Team**
At ZS, our Manufacturing, Engineering and Quality practice helps global organizations transform how they design, operate and optimize their manufacturing environments. We work at the intersection of business strategy and technology, combining AI, Agentic systems, advanced analytics, and digital twin technology to drive manufacturing efficiency, engineering precision, and quality compliance at scale.
  
  
Our teams work hands-on with clients to connect shop floor data with enterprise decision-making, integrate with legacy systems, and embed intelligent, outcome-driven solutions across manufacturing execution, maintenance, and quality workflows. Whether the challenge is improving yield, ensuring compliance, reducing operational risk, or accelerating the shift to smart manufacturing, we bring deep expertise and purpose-built technology approached to make it real.
  
  
***What You'll Do :
  
  
Engagement & client leadership -***

* Lead multiple technology engagements simultaneously, ensuring successful delivery across the lifecycle — discovery, requirements, solution design, implementation, testing, deployment and ongoing operations.
* Build and manage client relationships across assigned accounts, serving as a trusted advisor and primary point of contact for technology initiatives and strategic discussions.
* Partner with client stakeholders to understand business objectives, identify technology-enabled solutions, and develop roadmaps that support long-term transformation.
* Drive account expansion — identify opportunities, shape proposals, facilitate client discussions and collaborate with internal teams on solutions.
* Coordinate cross-functional, geographically distributed teams across India and the US, ensuring collaboration, delivery excellence and alignment across workstreams.

***Subject matter (OT & industrial data) -***

* Act as the OT subject-matter expert — shape and drive manufacturing and Industry 4.0 use cases across sites and enterprise programs (process monitoring, predictive maintenance, OEE, yield, energy, asset reliability).
* Apply deep knowledge of plant-floor OT and industrial data: sensors and instrumentation, PLC / DCS / SCADA, historians (e.g. OSIsoft / AVEVA PI), industrial IoT and edge, and manufacturing data platforms.
* Design and govern OT/IT data layers and Unified Namespace (UNS) architectures; define semantic models / ontology and contextualization of time-series and equipment data.
* Apply industrial standards and connectivity — ISA-95, ISA-88, OPC-UA and MQTT / UNS — and translate operational needs into scalable data products and analytics.

***Delivery & technology (SDLC) -***

* Lead end-to-end delivery and the full SDLC, guiding solution architecture, integration patterns, data models and the team’s technical approach while staying hands-on as and when required.
* Own estimation, planning, risk, dependency and delivery governance; ensure quality, non-functional requirements and, for validated systems, GxP / CSV validation (IQ/OQ/PQ, RVM traceability) and data integrity.

***Change Management & Value Delivery -***

* Drive organizational change management, ensuring adoption of new technologies and digital ways of working.
* Build business cases with clear ROI, and deliver measurable improvements in productivity, efficiency, quality, and time-to-market.
* Lead workshops, training, and stakeholder engagement to foster a culture of innovation and data-driven decision-making.

**What You'll Bring :**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, Life Sciences or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* 10–12 years leading client-facing technology, digital transformation or consulting initiatives within a professional-services or technology-consulting environment in the Manufacturing functional area.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple engagements and workstreams concurrently while balancing client expectations, delivery commitments and business priorities.
* Ability to translate business challenges into practical technology solutions and guide initiatives from strategy through execution.
* Experience leading cross-functional teams in a global, matrixed environment across multiple locations (India and US).
* Strong written, verbal and presentation skills, able to communicate with executive stakeholders; fluency in English.
* Client-first mentality, intense work ethic, collaborative spirit and problem-solving approach.
* Deep OT / industrial data expertise: sensors, PLC/DCS/SCADA, historians (PI), IIoT/edge, Unified Namespace, ontology / semantic models; ISA-95, ISA-88, OPC-UA, MQTT.
* Strong technology background: solution architecture, data engineering, Python / SQL, cloud (Azure / AWS / GCP) and integration.
* Life-sciences / pharma manufacturing domain experience.

**Nice to have :**

* Exposure to Smart Factory, Connected Worker, Digital Twin and Industrial AI initiatives.
* Familiarity with cloud industrial data platforms (e.g. Cognite, Snowflake) and streaming (Kafka); OT cybersecurity and data governance.
* Broad exposure across multiple technology domains — enterprise applications, cloud, analytics, data platforms or digital products.
* Demonstrated success identifying, shaping and expanding opportunities within existing client accounts.

**How you’ll grow:**

* Cross-functional skills development & custom learning pathways
* Milestone training programs aligned to career progression opportunities
* Internal mobility paths that empower growth via s-curves, individual contribution and role expansions

**Perks & Benefits:**
At ZS, your growth matters. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package that supports your health and well‑being, financial future, time away, and professional development. With robust skills‑building programs, multiple career progression paths, internal mobility, and a deeply collaborative culture, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, expand your capabilities, and thrive as part of a global community. For details on total rewards in India, visit ZS India office locations | Where we work | ZS.
  
  
**Hybrid working model:**
We are committed to giving our employees a flexible and connected way of working. A flexible and connected ZS allows us to combine work from home and on-site presence at clients/ZS offices for the majority of our week. The magic of ZS culture and innovation thrives in both planned and spontaneous face-to-face connections.
  
  
**Travel:**
Travel is a requirement at ZS for client facing ZSers; business needs of your project and client are the priority. While some projects may be local, all client-facing ZSers should be prepared to travel as needed. Travel provides opportunities to strengthen client relationships, gain diverse experiences, and enhance professional growth by working in different environments and cultures.
  
  
**Considering applying?**
At ZS, we honor the visible and invisible elements of our identities, personal experiences, and belief systems—the ones that comprise us as individuals, shape who we are, and make us unique. We believe your personal interests, identities, and desire to learn are integral to your success here. We are committed to building a team that reflects a broad variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. Learn more about our inclusion and belonging efforts and the networks ZS supports to assist our ZSers in cultivating community spaces and obtaining the resources they need to thrive.
  
  
If you’re eager to grow, contribute, and bring your unique self to our work, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
ZS is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment and advancement opportunities without regard to any class protected by applicable law.

Candidates must possess or be able to obtain work authorization for their intended country of employment. An on-line application, including a full set of transcripts (official or unofficial), is required to be considered.

**Designation:**
Director – Projects (Construction).

Master’s degree in construction management, Civil Engineering, Architecture, or related field.

Minimum 18 years of experience in construction project management, leading a team more than 10 people, preferably within higher education or institutional environments

**Role Summary:**

The Director of Projects (Construction) will lead the end-to-end planning, development, and execution of all construction and infrastructure initiatives across the university campus. This leadership role is responsible for ensuring that all projects are delivered on time, within budget, and in compliance with university standards for quality, sustainability, and safety. • Lead and manage university-wide construction projects including new buildings, renovations, and infrastructure upgrades.

• Define project scopes, timelines, budgets, and resource plans in collaboration with university leadership and stakeholders.

• Oversee architectural design reviews, procurement processes, contractor selection, and contract negotiations.

• Ensure compliance with university standards, local building codes, environmental norms, and safety regulations.

• Monitor construction progress, budget adherence, quality control, and risk mitigation across multiple projects.

• Prepare and deliver detailed project reports and presentations to university management and governing bodies.

• Manage, mentor, and build a high-performing team of project managers and support staff.

• Champion sustainable construction practices and integrate energy efficiency in all development plans.

• Serve as the key liaison with architects, consultants, government authorities, and regulatory bodies.

• Align construction projects with academic priorities, operational requirements, and long-term strategic goals.

• Ensure minimal disruption to academic and administrative functions during construction activities.

• Advise senior leadership on capital planning, facilities modernization, and infrastructure investments.

• Implement project management best practices using digital tools and software.

• Foster collaboration across departments, build consensus, and drive accountability throughout project lifecycles.

• Represent the university’s interests with professionalism, integrity, and a commitment to excellence in campus development.

****Job Description****
**Senior Manager Product and Lifecycle Management**
****About Medline****
Medline is the largest provider of medical-surgical products and supply chain solutions serving all points of care. Through its broad product portfolio, resilient supply chain and leading clinical solutions, Medline helps healthcare providers improve their clinical, financial and operational outcomes. Headquartered in Northfield, Ill., the company employs more than 45,000 people worldwide and operates in more than 100 countries. To learn more about how Medline makes healthcare run better, visit www.medline.com.
  
  
**Medline India**
Medline India was established in 2010 in Pune as Global Capability Center to support Medline, headquartered in Illinois, USA. Over the years, it has grown into a 1,800+ strong team of technology, finance, and business support professionals who contribute to Medline’s global mission: to make healthcare run better. Medline India offers a dynamic and collaborative work environment with ample opportunities to learn, innovate, and grow. With a highly engaged and empowered team, Medline India plays a vital role in driving business excellence and supporting healthcare systems across the globe.
  
  
****Job Summary:****
Lead and integrate a global operations capability supporting the lifecycle of healthcare products and procedure kits, from product and component setup through controlled changes, commercial enablement, inventory management and discontinuation. The role connects product information, technical documentation, supply chain execution and business analytics to improve product availability, data quality, turnaround time and financial outcomes.
  
  
The Senior Manager will lead through managers and team leaders, establish a common operating model across the combined teams, and partner with global Product Management, Supply Chain, Commercial, Quality and Regulatory, and Technology leaders. The mandate includes building specialist talent, delivering reliable operations, and converting analytics, automation and AI opportunities into measurable improvements.
  
  
Business scope
  
  

* Kitting and lifecycle operations: new and revised kit setup, bill of materials maintenance, component changes, kit activation and closure, discontinued business, inventory disposition and lifecycle exceptions.
* Product information and technical support: product master data, technical data sheets, labeling and instructions for use support, packaging information, translations, product cross references and controlled documentation.
* Commercial and supply chain enablement: quotations and pricing support, vendor and sourcing administration, product availability and backorder insights, tender information and coordination across product divisions.
* Analytics and transformation: business intelligence, product and component analysis, workflow automation, project governance, process standardization and capability expansion.

****Responsibilities:****
Product and lifecycle accountabilities
  
  
Kitting and lifecycle operations
  
  

* Own service delivery for kit and component setup, bill of materials changes, revisions, activation and closure. Establish checks that keep approved product, quotation, packaging and system information consistent across handoffs.
* Coordinate new, revised and discontinued business with Product Management, planning, manufacturing, purchasing and customer-facing teams. Manage dependencies, exceptions and escalation to protect continuity of supply.
* Lead the operational response to excess, obsolete and expiring inventory, component shortages, revision runout and customer cancellations. Use analysis to recommend transfers, returns, purchase order actions or disposition for approval by the accountable business owner.

Product data and documentation
  
  

* Establish ownership and quality controls for product attributes, descriptions, packaging hierarchies, images, component data and cross references. Resolve data defects at source and maintain consistency across product information and ERP systems.
* Oversee technical data sheet creation and updates, labeling and artwork coordination, instructions for use documentation, translation workflows and document publication. Maintain version control, traceability and evidence of required reviews.
* Strengthen controls for product changes, component discontinuations and related document updates so that approved changes reach the affected systems, users and downstream processes.

Technical and product development support
  
  

* Lead the assigned support for supplier information, product specifications, sample review coordination, packaging study documentation and project milestones. Ensure requirements, acceptance criteria, dependencies and outstanding decisions are clearly documented.
* Partner with Product Management, Quality and Regulatory specialists on technical reviews and change decisions. Exercise approval authority only within formally assigned responsibilities and approved procedures.

Commercial and supplier enablement
  
  

* Oversee quotation and pricing administration, component cost and margin analysis, product replacement information, tender responses and product documentation requests. Ensure business recommendations use validated information and reach the authorized decision maker.
* Direct assigned vendor setup, vendor data maintenance, purchasing support and pricing or invoice exception workflows. Improve coordination with Procurement, Finance and global commercial teams.
* Improve availability and backorder support by connecting inventory, production schedules, component constraints and product alternatives. Ensure customer-facing responses reflect approved product information and reliable supply assumptions.

Transformation and leadership accountabilities
  
  
Business analytics and decision support
  
  

* Build a prioritized analytics portfolio covering inventory exposure, expiry and obsolescence, component shortages, kit revisions, product availability, quotation economics, margin drivers and time to market.
* Translate business questions into data requirements, agreed definitions and actionable dashboards. Challenge data quality, assumptions and analytical conclusions, and ensure insights lead to documented decisions and follow-up actions.

Automation and AI
  
  

* Sponsor process simplification and automation using suitable tools such as Power Automate, Power Apps, Power BI, RPA and system integrations. Define requirements, controls, testing, adoption and support arrangements with Technology partners.
* Develop AI use cases for extracting and validating product information, comparing document versions, assisting product cross referencing, summarizing exceptions and supporting stakeholder queries. Define evaluation criteria and human review for technical, quality and regulatory content.
* Own the business case and benefits realization for each initiative. Establish a baseline, measure capacity released and improvements in quality or cycle time, and validate financial benefits with Finance while accounting for delivery and ongoing support costs.

People and capability leadership
  
  

* Lead managers, team leaders, analysts and domain specialists across the combined portfolio. Define accountabilities, performance expectations, succession coverage and decision rights at each level.
* Build specialist career paths in product lifecycle operations, product data, technical documentation, analytics and automation. Recruit and develop talent capable of taking on more complex global responsibilities.
* Create a common culture of ownership, problem solving and continuous learning. Coach leaders through change, resolve competing priorities and maintain employee engagement as scope and ways of working evolve.

Global partnership and operational governance
  
  

* Establish one service catalogue, demand and capacity process, performance scorecard and escalation framework. Lead business reviews with global stakeholders and align resources to business value, risk and service commitments.
* Manage delivery quality, turnaround time, backlog, productivity, controls, budget and continuity within delegated authority. Maintain current procedures, training records, access controls and reliable backup coverage.
* Shape a phased capability roadmap and lead new scope discovery, transition planning, knowledge transfer and stabilization. Define acceptance criteria, service ownership and controls before assuming additional work.

****Work Experience & Required Skills:****

* Typically 15 or more years of progressive experience across product operations, product lifecycle management, supply chain, technical business operations or global capability environments, with substantial responsibility for complex delivery portfolios.
* Demonstrated experience leading managers or team leaders across multiple specialist teams, including performance management, succession development, organizational change and global stakeholder engagement.
* Strong understanding of product and component data, bills of materials, lifecycle changes and cross-functional dependencies. Relevant experience may come from medical devices, healthcare products or other complex manufactured-product businesses.
* Proven delivery of analytics and automation initiatives with measurable business outcomes. Ability to assess analytical logic, data quality, technology options and benefits rather than relying solely on project status reporting.
* Commercial and operational acumen sufficient to evaluate inventory exposure, cost and margin implications, service trade-offs and the business case for capability expansion.
* Ability to work with senior international stakeholders, influence decisions without direct authority, communicate complex issues clearly and lead teams through ambiguity.

****Educational Qualification:****

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, science, supply chain, operations, business or a relevant discipline. An MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification is preferred. Lean Six Sigma, project management, supply chain or product lifecycle qualifications are useful where supported by delivery experience.
* Preferred exposure includes regulated product documentation, kitting or configurable products, product information management and ERP systems, Power BI and the Microsoft Power Platform.
* Familiarity with SQL, data modeling, RPA or AI implementation strengthens the profile.
* Relevant environments in the current scope include SAP, QAD, AS400, PIM, Medpack, NetQuote, Workfront and Smartsheet; expertise in every platform is not required.

Busway knowledge: Pow-R-Way III, Pow-R-Way II, and supported busway offerings; feeder and plug-in busway; straight lengths and fittings; elbows, offsets, tees, crosses, flanges, joints, expansion and phase-transposition sections; transformer taps and throat connections; reducers, adapters, end feeds, end closers, hangers, power takeoffs, plug-in devices, layout drawings, final-field-fit requirements, and equipment coordination. Working knowledge of copper and aluminum conductor application, bus ampacity, voltage and short-circuit ratings, phasing, orientation, grounding, neutral arrangements, insulation, voltage drop, environmental ratings, clearances, supports, seismic requirements, installation constraints, and field coordination. Strong understanding of applicable ANSI, IEEE, UL, NEMA, NEC, NFPA, CSA, and IEC requirements, including low-voltage switchgear, busway, arc-resistant, testing, and installation requirements applicable to the supported portfolios. Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, structure and compartment assembly, breaker and device fitment, bus fabrication and jointing, wiring, inspection, testing, packaging and shipping splits, quality systems, engineering changes, and product lifecycle management. Experience with BidManager or comparable configuration tools; AutoCAD and AutoCAD Electrical; Inventor or comparable 3D CAD; ENOVIA/3DX or comparable PLM; Design Automation; BIM; MAPICS/AS400; and manufacturing-release or order-management systems. Proven ability to lead design automation, BIM and digital-thread initiatives, reusable product definition, configuration validation, drawing and BOM automation, busway engineering automation, workflow optimization, and engineering-quality improvement. Demonstrated application of Lean, DMAIC, Design for Six Sigma, Agile, and continuous-improvement methods; Green Belt or Black Belt certification is preferred. Ability to evaluate competitor offerings, customer and market trends, product standards, installation practices, and technology developments relevant to low-voltage assemblies and busway.

title: Director, IT Operations
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Director, IT Operations and Services is responsible for OpenGov's global IT operations, spanning teams in Pune and the US, and owns global End User Services strategy — making sure the platforms, network, and support our workforce relies on every day are reliable, secure, and consistent across every site. Based in Pune and reporting to the Sr. Director of Enterprise Technology, this role owns the core IT platform stack (Google Workspace, Slack, Atlassian, and Okta), network management, and IT systems administration and engineering; partners with Systems Engineering on joint projects; and runs global IT asset and inventory management as well as office IT infrastructure and buildouts.
  
  
The ideal candidate provides the vision and leadership to run IT operations globally while remaining willing to build the strategy and do the work at the same time — setting direction without losing touch with the core stack, network, and tooling. Experience scaling IT operations in a high-growth, Global environment is important. They develop leaders and teams across geographies and time zones, hold every site accountable to measurable service levels, and drive an automation-first way of working across a global organization.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Team & Global Operations
  
  

* Lead and develop the global IT operations and end user services function, spanning teams in Pune and the US.
* Own global End User Services strategy and set the standards, SLAs, and quality bar for IT across all sites.
* Own IT systems administration and engineering, and partner with Systems Engineering on joint projects and shared initiatives.
* Own the IT operations roadmap and budget, including managed service provider (MSP) strategy and where to leverage MSPs to scale support globally.

Platforms, Network & Infrastructure
  
  

* Own the core IT stack — Google Workspace, Slack, Atlassian, and Okta — including Okta identity and access (SSO, provisioning, access policy).
* Own network management and connectivity across all sites, ensuring reliable, secure infrastructure.
* Own the Atlassian stack — Jira, Jira Service Management, and Confluence.
* Own global office IT infrastructure — design, maintenance, and new-site buildouts — in partnership with Workplace.

Assets & Service Quality
  
  

* Own global IT asset and inventory management, from procurement through retirement, and the associated hardware vendor relationships.
* Be accountable for support quality and SLA attainment at every site, with consistent workflows and escalation paths.
* Serve as senior escalation for major incidents and own change control for core systems.

Security & Compliance
  
  

* Partner with Security to uphold identity, endpoint, and data-protection standards across the enterprise.
* Ensure IT systems and processes meet compliance requirements (e.g., SOC 2), including audits and access reviews.

**Requirements**

* 13+ years in IT within a cloud-first, SaaS environment, including 10+ years managing IT teams — with experience managing managers or team leads.
* Experience leading globally distributed teams across sites and time zones, including offshore and India-based teams.
* Deep, hands-on expertise with Google Workspace, Slack, Atlassian, and Okta — with strong Okta IAM depth (SSO, provisioning, access policy).
* Solid grounding in ITSM/ITIL — SLAs and incident, change, and problem management.
* Experience running IT asset/inventory, network management, and office IT infrastructure/buildouts across multiple locations.
* Able to set strategy and direction while staying hands-on; experience scaling IT operations in a high-growth, multinational environment.
* Strong understanding of security and compliance (e.g., SOC 2) as it applies to IT operations.
* A clear communicator and leader who sets standards, develops talent, and partners effectively with senior stakeholders. On-site in Pune; Bachelor's in IT/CS or equivalent experience.
* Experience owning office IT infrastructure, site expansion and new-site buildouts.

***Nice to Have***

* Experience selecting and managing managed service provider (MSP) relationships.
* Experience supporting teams across both India and the US.
* Familiarity with endpoint/MDM platforms (Kandji, Jamf, or Intune) and EDR tooling.
* Scripting and automation experience (Bash, Python, or PowerShell) to drive an automation-first team.

**Why OpenGov?**
**A Mission That Matters.**
At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.
  
  
**Opportunity to Innovate**
The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.
  
  
**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**
This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.
  
  
**A Place to Make Your Mark**
We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.
  
  
**Benefits That Work For You**
Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:
  
  

* Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families
* Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions
* Professional development and growth opportunities
* A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

description:

**About This Role**
We are seeking an experienced
**Siebel CRM application operations professional**
to manage the day-to-day operational health and technical support of Oracle Siebel CRM and associated platforms from
**SP Infocity, Pune**
.
  
  
This hands-on role focuses on service stability, SLA adherence, major incident and problem resolution, proactive monitoring, technical troubleshooting, automation, operational governance and continual service improvement. You will act as a technical escalation point for complex production issues and work across Siebel CRM, Oracle BSS and connected technology teams.
  
  
You should bring
**6-8 years of Telecom IT, Oracle BSS or enterprise CRM application operations experience**
, including at least
**4**
**years of hands-on Oracle Siebel CRM production support experience**
. Working knowledge of SRE practices, observability and automation is important for improving reliability, service performance and operational efficiency.
  
  
What you will do
  
  
Application support and technical operations
  
  

* Manage day-to-day support and operational health of Oracle Siebel CRM services
* Act as the technical escalation point for complex incidents, service degradation and cross-system issues
* Coordinate P1/P2 incident triage, technical analysis, service restoration and timely stakeholder communication
* Perform detailed troubleshooting using Siebel logs, workflow and component analysis, Oracle SQL, Unix/Linux utilities and monitoring data
* Coordinate end-to-end diagnosis across FMW/AIA, OSM, BRM, WebLogic, database, infrastructure and network teams

SLA, service management and governance
  
  

* Track adherence to agreed incident response, restoration and service request SLAs
* Review service KPIs including availability, SLA compliance, incident trends, MTTR, MTTD, backlog and recurring failures
* Support weekly and monthly service reviews with concise reporting covering operational performance, risks, actions and dependencies
* Keep operational controls, runbooks, knowledge articles, support procedures and audit evidence current and ensure agreed processes are followed

Problem management and continual improvement
  
  

* Lead technical investigations into recurring incidents and contribute to high-quality root cause analysis and preventive actions
* Maintain and prioritise a service-improvement backlog using incident trends, monitoring gaps and operational risks
* Identify opportunities to automate health checks, alert responses, reporting, housekeeping and repetitive support activities
* Improve monitoring coverage, alert quality, dashboards and early detection to reduce customer impact and operational effort
* Track corrective and preventive actions through to closure and validate that improvements deliver sustainable results

Team and stakeholder coordination
  
  

* Provide technical guidance, work-allocation support and knowledge sharing for application support engineers
* Collaborate with Service Management, Business, Architecture, Infrastructure, Security, Oracle and other support partners
* Escalate risks, capacity concerns, vendor dependencies and unresolved service issues through agreed governance channels

Who you are
  
  
Technical knowledge and experience
  
  

* You have 7–10 years' experience in Telecom IT, Oracle BSS or enterprise CRM application operations
* You have at least 5 years' hands-on Oracle Siebel CRM production support experience
* You have strong knowledge of Siebel CRM architecture, server components, configuration, Workflows, eScript, Business Services, EAI, Integration Objects, inbound/outbound web services and Open UI troubleshooting
* You understand Siebel administration, including component health, tasks, sessions, logs, parameters and environment checks
* You have strong Oracle SQL/PLSQL skills for data analysis, troubleshooting and performance investigation
* You can use Unix/Linux and Shell scripting for log analysis, health checks, housekeeping and operational automation
* You understand telecom order management, product catalogue, customer and service-request flows
* You can troubleshoot integrations involving FMW/AIA, OSM, BRM, WebLogic and downstream systems
* You have hands-on experience with one or more observability tools such as Dynatrace, AppDynamics, Splunk, Kibana, Grafana or Zabbix
* You understand cloud, containers and Kubernetes/OKE operations, including pod health, logs, events, resource usage and restart validation
* You have awareness of CI/CD, configuration control and rollback principles in an application-operations environment
* You have experience supporting business-critical services and resolving complex production incidents within SLA

Service management and collaboration
  
  

* You understand Incident, Major Incident, Problem, Change, Release and Service Request management
* You have working knowledge of the ITIL framework and production-operations controls
* You have experience with SLA/KPI tracking, service reporting and operational governance
* You can contribute to effective RCA, risk management and continual service improvement
* You can coordinate effectively with stakeholders, vendors and cross-functional teams
* You communicate technical and operational information clearly in writing and verbally
* Experience delivering measurable improvements through automation, monitoring or continual-service-improvement initiatives is important

**Preferred Qualifications And Experience**

* ITIL Foundation certification
* Exposure to Kubernetes/OKE, cloud operations, DevOps/SRE practices and enterprise observability tools
* Experience with telecom order management and Oracle BSS integrations

Not a Perfect Fit?

If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
  
  
**What’s In It For You**

* Exposure to complex, cross-platform telecom operations spanning FMW/AIA, OSM, BRM, WebLogic, databases, infrastructure and networks

title: Delivery Operations Manager
description:
DeepIntent is the leading healthcare marketing platform, purpose-built to help marketers plan, activate, and optimize data-driven campaigns with speed and precision. Trusted by the world’s top healthcare brands and their agencies, DeepIntent uniquely unites media, identity, and real-world clinical data to power privacy-safe, omnichannel marketing across every screen. Backed by patented technology and proven outcomes, DeepIntent’s platform delivers measurable audience quality and script lift at scale. Learn more at www.deepintent.com.
  
  
**About The Delivery Amplification Office**
The Delivery Amplification Office (DAO) is not a traditional PMO. We are an AI-native delivery function that makes engineering faster, clearer and easier to steer.
  
  
We run on the following two foundations.
  
  
**Amplified Squads**
is our AI-native operating model. Small, goal-aligned squads with AI built into how they plan, track, report and ship. Agents and automation handle intake, hygiene and status, so people spend their time on decisions and delivery.
  
  
Our
**Delivery Intelligence Platform**
is the centre of everything we do. It is an always-on layer across Jira, Confluence, Slack and our people systems that turns delivery activity into live signal: squad health, risk, throughput, release status and executive briefs. Every squad, epic, release and report flows through it — and Delivery Operations keeps it true.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
Delivery Operations Manager is the operational backbone of a Business Line (BL). You run the day-to-day machinery of Amplified Squads, keep the Delivery Intelligence Platform accurate, and make sure Engineering teams decide on data they trust. Paired with a Delivery Lead, you own the daily operating rhythm — and automate the parts of it that shouldn't need a human in the first place.
  
  

* Amplified Squads Operations

+ Stand up new squads: members, consultants, boards, filters, release versions and communication channels.
+ Keep every squad tied to its goal and initiative; route missing goals, initiatives and PRDs to the Delivery Lead with the specific gap named.
+ Track each squad's lifecycle from formation to dissolution, and confirm or re-date every dissolution with stakeholders before the day.
+ Maintain squad membership and allocation data as people join, rotate and roll off.

* Delivery Intelligence Platform Stewardship

+ Treat the platform as the single source of truth for your BL: complete, current and reconciled to Jira.
+ Act on the signals it raises — stale epics, missing dates, slipping squads — before they reach a review.
+ Test new platform capabilities and report edge cases with reproducible examples.
+ Log every recurring data gap as a rule, validation or automation candidate, so the platform gets smarter each quarter.

* Release and Change Communication

+ Run daily release management: confirm planned deployments landed, validate components on the release ticket, and verify release notes with owners.
+ Publish release announcements that engineering, product and client-facing teams can act on without follow-up.

* Workflow Hygiene

+ Run daily checks on the work hierarchy: components, epic-to-goal links, past-due and approaching-due epics.

+ Field Jira workflow, field and board change requests; implement the agreed ones and keep the configuration consistent across squads.

* Cadence and Ceremonies

+ Set up and maintain recurring Product Line and BL syncs; coordinate ad-hoc initiative meetings.

+ Gather and validate the quantitative layer for executive reporting, recurring delivery briefs and ad-hoc leadership requests.

* Automation and AI Agents

+ Use the platform, Jira automation and AI assistants (Claude or equivalent) in your daily work.
+ Operate and tune the AI delivery agents that run hygiene checks and summaries, and catch where their output is wrong.

**Who You Are**

title: Senior Delivery Operations Manager
description:
DeepIntent is the leading healthcare marketing platform, purpose-built to help marketers plan, activate, and optimize data-driven campaigns with speed and precision. Trusted by the world’s top healthcare brands and their agencies, DeepIntent uniquely unites media, identity, and real-world clinical data to power privacy-safe, omnichannel marketing across every screen. Backed by patented technology and proven outcomes, DeepIntent’s platform delivers measurable audience quality and script lift at scale. Learn more at www.deepintent.com.
  
  
**About The Delivery Amplification Office**
The Delivery Amplification Office (DAO) is not a traditional PMO. We are an AI-native delivery function that makes engineering faster, clearer and easier to steer.
  
  
We run on the following two foundations.
  
  
**Amplified Squads**
is our AI-native operating model. Small, goal-aligned squads with AI built into how they plan, track, report and ship. Agents and automation handle intake, hygiene and status, so people spend their time on decisions and delivery.
  
  
Our
**Delivery Intelligence Platform**
is the centre of everything we do. It is an always-on layer across Jira, Confluence, Slack and our people systems that turns delivery activity into live signal: squad health, risk, throughput, release status and executive briefs. Every squad, epic, release and report flows through it — and Delivery Operations keeps it true.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
The Senior Delivery Operations Manager owns the operating system of one or more Business Lines (BLs): the data, cadence, tooling and automation that Amplified Squads run on. Paired with a Senior Delivery Lead as daily working partner and growth-path mentor, you move from keeping the system accurate to redesigning it — on a deliberate path toward Delivery Lead.
  
  

* Operating Model Stewardship

+ Own Amplified Squads health for 1–2 BLs: lifecycle adherence, goal coverage, squad lifespan and dissolution postponements.
+ Set and enforce operating conventions (naming, release versions, mandatory fields, dissolution checks), and document them in the DAO playbook.
+ Turn squad retrospectives and survey data into concrete changes to how squads form, run and close.

* Delivery Intelligence Platform Ownership

+ Act as the operations voice of the platform: define business logic, data-quality rules and acceptance criteria, and run UAT with the Delivery Engineers who build it.
+ Drive adoption so squads, EMs and PMs work from the platform, not from side spreadsheets.
+ Turn its signals into early warnings that reach your Delivery Lead before a review does.

* Automation and AI Agents

+ Maintain the ops automation backlog for your BLs: every recurring task with its frequency, effort and automation path (Jira rule, platform capability or AI agent).
+ Ship at least one automation per quarter that retires a recurring manual task, and report the hours returned.
+ Design and tune AI delivery agents for hygiene, summarisation and follow-up, with clear checks on their accuracy.
+ Contribute proven patterns to the DAO's Agentic Framework for cross-BL adoption.

* Reporting and Delivery Insights

+ Own the quantitative layer of executive reporting and recurring delivery briefs for your BLs, reconciled to source.
+ Draft the first qualitative read — what moved, why, and what's at risk — for your Senior Delivery Lead to sharpen.
+ Track the metrics the operating model is judged on: throughput, cycle time, WIP and goal coverage.

* Tooling and Workflow Governance

+ Own Jira configuration standards across your BLs: workflows, issue types, fields and boards.
+ Assess the impact of every workflow change request, align stakeholders on edge cases, and roll changes out without breaking reporting.

* DAO-wide Ops Domain

+ Own one operations domain for the whole DAO, such as release and change management, cadence design, or the reporting data layer.
+ Define the standard other Delivery Operations follow in that domain, and spot-check their output.

* Enablement and Team Leverage

+ Own the playbooks and onboarding that teach teams the Amplified Squads model and our tooling.
+ Review and coach the work of Delivery Operations peers.
+ Work against explicit Lead-readiness milestones agreed with your Senior Delivery Lead: run a BL review solo, lead a stakeholder alignment, own an escalation end to end with a recommendation.
+ Act as Delivery Lead backup for your BL during leave or peak load.

**Who You Are**

* 4+ years in delivery operations, PMO, program coordination or Atlassian administration in a fast-moving technology company, including 1+ year owning operations for a team or BL rather than executing tasks.
* Expert in Jira: advanced JQL, dashboards, workflow and automation rules, and how field and screen configuration drive data quality.
* Proven automator: you have retired a manual process with Jira automation, scripts or AI, and can say how many hours it returned.
* Hands-on with AI tools (Claude, Cursor or equivalent) in operational workflows — demonstrated, not aspirational.
* Comfortable with data: you reconcile sources, spot anomalies, and read throughput, cycle time and aging.
* Influence without authority: EMs and PMs keep their work current because you made it easy, not because you chased them.
* You treat process debt the way engineers treat tech debt, and you write operating docs people actually follow.
* You want the path to Delivery Lead and can name your own gap to it.
* Scripting or SQL and BI tooling are a plus.
