title: Support AI Operations Manager
description:
**Organization Overview**
**Company Description**
QAD Inc. is a leading provider of adaptive, cloud-based enterprise software and services for global manufacturing companies. Global manufacturers face ever-increasing disruption caused by technology-driven innovation and changing consumer preferences. In order to survive and thrive, manufacturers must be able to innovate and change business models at unprecedented rates of speed. QAD calls these companies Adaptive Manufacturing Enterprises. QAD solutions help customers in the automotive, life sciences, packaging, consumer products, food and beverage, high tech and industrial manufacturing industries rapidly adapt to change and innovate for competitive advantage. We are looking for talented individuals who want to join us on our mission to help solve relevant real-world problems in manufacturing and the supply chain.
  
  
**This hybrid position requires candidates to be based in Pune, with 3-4 days of in-office collaboration per week.**
**Job Description**
We are looking for a
**Support AI Operations Manager**
to drive and coordinate the growing portfolio of AI initiatives across QAD Support. This role will provide dedicated ownership for ensuring AI opportunities are identified, prioritized, coordinated across teams, and successfully moved from concept and pilot through implementation, adoption, and measurable business outcomes.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines strong project and program management skills with a practical understanding of AI technologies and delivery models. This person will serve as a bridge between Support and technical teams, bringing structure, governance, and accountability to AI initiatives without being responsible for hands-on AI development.
  
  
This is an individual contributor role that will work closely with Support leadership and cross-functional partners across Engineering, Product, IT, Data, Security, and other relevant teams.
  
  
**Key Deliverables**
**AI Strategy, Roadmap & Governance**

* Own and maintain the Support AI roadmap, ensuring initiatives are aligned with Support priorities and broader QAD AI strategy.
* Establish and maintain governance processes to evaluate, prioritize, and manage AI opportunities across Support.
* Create consistent operating mechanisms for AI initiative reviews, status reporting, decision-making, and leadership visibility.
* Track the overall portfolio of AI initiatives, including milestones, dependencies, risks, resource requirements, and expected business outcomes.

**AI Project & Program Management**

* Manage AI use cases from initial intake and evaluation through prioritization, pilot, implementation, adoption, and ongoing optimization.
* Coordinate cross-functional AI projects across Support, Engineering, Product, IT, Data, Security, and other stakeholders.
* Develop project plans, establish milestones and owners, identify dependencies, and proactively remove roadblocks.
* Partner with technical teams and external vendors as needed to ensure initiatives are delivered effectively and in accordance with business requirements.
* Ensure AI initiatives have clear success criteria and measurable outcomes, including productivity improvements, cost savings, customer experience improvements, and impact on key Support metrics.

**AI Adoption & Enablement**

* Drive adoption of AI tools and capabilities across Support by partnering with leaders and teams to integrate AI into existing workflows and processes.
* Identify and address barriers to adoption, including process, technology, training, and change-management needs.
* Coordinate communications, training, documentation, and enablement activities to support successful implementation.
* Monitor adoption and effectiveness following implementation and identify opportunities for continued improvement.

**Opportunity Identification & Continuous Improvement**

* Partner with Support leaders and subject matter experts to identify opportunities where AI can improve operational performance and the customer experience.
* Evaluate potential use cases across areas such as Support productivity, case diagnostics, knowledge management, case resolution, customer self-service, and mean time to resolution (MTTR).
* Help assess the feasibility, potential value, risks, and organizational readiness of proposed AI use cases.
* Maintain awareness of emerging AI capabilities and identify opportunities to apply new technologies to Support operations.

**Risk, Security & Data Governance**

* Partner with technical, security, legal, and data governance teams to ensure AI initiatives comply with QAD's AI, security, privacy, and data governance requirements.
* Ensure appropriate governance and risk considerations are incorporated throughout the AI project lifecycle.
* Help establish repeatable processes for evaluating and managing AI-related risks within Support.

**Qualifications**
**Education**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field; equivalent professional experience will also be considered.

**Experience**

* Overall 8-10+ years working within support with 2–3+ years of hands-on experience managing AI initiatives, AI projects, or AI-enabled business transformation programs.
* Additional experience in project management, program management, operations, or business transformation.

**Technical Skills**

* Practical understanding of AI technologies, use cases, implementation approaches, and AI delivery models; hands-on AI development experience is not required.

**Soft Skills**

* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple cross-functional initiatives simultaneously and drive projects from concept through implementation and adoption.
* Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to establish structure, manage competing priorities, and maintain accountability across stakeholders.
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to evaluate business cases, define success measures, and track outcomes and ROI.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to effectively translate between business and technical teams.
* Experience working with technology, product, engineering, data, or IT teams.
* Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment where priorities and technologies may change quickly.
* Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to identifying opportunities and removing obstacles.
* Experience with Support, Customer Service, SaaS, or other technology-enabled operations is preferred.

**Additional Information**

* Your health and well being are important to us at QAD. We provide programs that help you strike a healthy work-life balance.
* Opportunity to join a growing business, launching into its next phase of expansion and transformation.
* Collaborative culture of smart and hard-working people who support one another to get the job done.
* An atmosphere of growth and opportunity, where idea-sharing is always prioritized over level or Hierarchy.
* Compensation packages based on experience and desired skill set

**About QAD**
QAD | Redzone is redefining manufacturing and supply chains through its intelligent, adaptive platform that connects people, processes, and data into a single System of Action. With three core pillars — Redzone (frontline empowerment), Adaptive Applications (the intelligent backbone), and Champion AI (Agentic AI for manufacturing) — QAD | Redzone helps manufacturers operate with Champion Pace, achieving measurable productivity, resilience, and growth in just 90 days.
  
  
QAD is committed to ensuring that every employee feels they work in an environment that values their contributions, respects their unique perspectives and provides opportunities for growth regardless of background. QAD’s DEI program is driving higher levels of diversity, equity and inclusion so that employees can bring their whole self to work.
  
  
We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class.

From technology to product innovation, we’re making our mark on the financial services industry. For more than two centuries, we’ve been helping our clients safeguard and steward the investments of millions of people. Summary of This Role
  
  
Manages the operation, maintenance and administration of the organization's operating and management systems so that they function reliably, meet the organization's business needs, and use the organization's IT resources effectively. Participates in vendor events which focus on future products and services, industry trends, vendor strategic direction and similar topics. **Job Details**
**Summary**
The Supply Chain Network Modeling Manager is responsible for leading the development and application of advanced supply chain network models that support operational decision-making across the enterprise. This role combines hands-on modeling expertise with people leadership responsibilities, managing a team of supply chain modelers and analysts while ensuring delivery of high-quality network design, transportation optimization, capacity planning, inventory optimization, and business continuity initiatives.
  
  
The Manager translates business challenges into analytical solutions that optimize cost, service, capacity, inventory, risk, and growth objectives. * Analyze tradeoffs between cost, service levels, inventory, risk, resilience, sustainability, and growth.
* Develop transportation optimization and cost-to-serve models.
* Support long-range planning, annual operating planning, and capital investment decisions through scenario analysis.
* Drive adoption of advanced analytics, optimization, simulation, AI, and emerging technologies.

* Develop reusable templates, tools, and frameworks to improve efficiency and consistency.
* Support the evolution of Network Modeling as a Service (NMaaS) and consulting capabilities.
* Identify opportunities for automation and process improvement.

* 5+ years of experience in Supply Chain Analytics & Optimization.
* 2+ years of team management/leadership experience.
* Expertise translating business rules into modeling requirements and scenarios

title: Assistant Peer Review Performance Manager
description:
We believe in bold ideas, diverse perspectives, and the drive to transform knowledge into impact. Here, your curiosity fuels progress, your voice shapes innovation, and your ambition helps redefine what’s possible within science and learning. We are a culture that obsesses over impact, challenges, and drives what’s next to power infinite possibilities for our customers, colleagues and society at large.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Assistant Peer Review Performance Manager oversees day-to-day business-as-usual peer review performance for a segment of the Research Publishing journal portfolio. The role assesses editor and editorial office performance across assigned journals, monitors progress against expected behaviours and key performance indicators (KPIs), and drives improvements that support best practices and a positive author experience throughout the author lifecycle. The role receives direction from the manager, along with guidance and coaching from senior peers.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Oversee the day-to-day management of peer review and journal editorial office services.
* Oversee and evaluate editor and editorial office administrator performance across the assigned segment of the Research Publishing portfolio.
* Drive continuous improvement, workflow optimization, and the adoption of peer review best practices and standards across the portfolio.
* Focus on value-added strategies and tactics that support the delivery of editorial decisions, including speed to decision, the quality of the author experience, and the integrity of manuscripts and the workflows underpinning the peer review process.
* Seek guidance on remedial action plans, as appropriate.

Peer Review Management
  
  

* Provide journal-level oversight of the manuscript peer review process, from submission through final editorial decision and export to Content Operations, for a portfolio of Research Publishing journals, using best-practice principles and effective time-management practices.
* Maintain oversight of accurate documentation for the peer review management process.
* Identify and escalate integrity concerns, and implement outcomes from investigations as needed.
* Adopt new services and tools when introduced, and implement enhanced workflows as they are rolled out.

Editor and Editorial Office Performance Management
  
  

* Monitor and manage the performance of editors, editorial office administrators, and vendor-partner editorial assistants, and provide feedback.
* Communicate and manage expected behaviours and KPIs against established benchmarks.
* Handle performance-related queries and escalations.
* Assess insights from self-service reports and analyses provided by editorial data analysts to continuously improve performance.
* Ensure that editors and administrators follow established best practices and workflows.
* Ensure that editors demonstrate expected behaviours, including adherence to the code of conduct.
* Implement remedial actions or retraining for editors who do not meet performance expectations.
* Implement remedial actions or initiate retraining for editorial office administrators or vendor-partner editorial assistants when expectations are not consistently met.
* Share insights about consistently poor editor performance with Publishing Development and/or Partner Publishing colleagues.
* Seek guidance on remedial action plans and support with enforcing alignment, as appropriate.

Optimization and Harmonization
  
  

* Review and optimize journal workflows, ensuring alignment with peer review best practices and standards, and implement changes that improve efficiency and standardization.
* Communicate and implement opportunities identified through audits or data-driven improvement projects led by Publishing Operations or Editorial Excellence.
* Implement journal-level changes.
* Support transitions between editorial office models and onboard new partners moving to Wiley Peer Review Management.
* Contribute to accurate product data masters by recording journal-level changes.

Cross-Functional Collaboration
  
  

* Collaborate with internal colleagues to achieve departmental and customer-focused goals and objectives.
* Partner with editorial data analysts to advance improvements based on data-driven approaches and insights.
* Work with Research Publishing colleagues on journal-specific strategic initiatives and relationship management, and provide information and data to support improvements at the journal level.
* Contribute to relevant projects, as required.

**Qualifications**

* Experience supporting peer review, editorial operations, journal publishing, or a related environment.
* Ability to monitor performance against KPIs, interpret data and reports, and translate insights into practical improvements.
* Knowledge of peer review workflows, publishing integrity requirements, and editorial best practices.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple journals and priorities.
* Effective communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Ability to address performance concerns, manage escalations, and support remedial actions with appropriate guidance.
* Commitment to delivering an efficient, consistent, and positive author experience.

**We power infinite possibilities.**
For more than 200 years, we've transformed knowledge into discoveries that shape the world. Today, our global team of innovators, creators, and experts is driving what's next in science, education, and publishing—creating impact that reaches everywhere.
  
  
We're not just observers of progress. We're the ones accelerating scientific breakthroughs, advancing learning, and sparking innovation that redefines entire fields and improves lives.
  
  
Here, your talent matters. Your ideas have room to grow. And your work creates breakthroughs that can change everything.

+ Well versed with MS Excel and PowerPoint

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. title: Product Trialing Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Syngenta Seeds is one of the world’s largest developers and producers of seed for farmers, commercial growers, retailers and small seed companies. Syngenta seeds improve the quality and yields of crops. High-quality seeds ensure better and more productive crops, which is why farmers invest in them. Advanced seeds help mitigate risks such as disease and drought and allow farmers to grow food using less land, less water and fewer inputs.
  
  
Syngenta Seeds brings farmers more vigorous, stronger, resistant plants, including innovative hybrid varieties and biotech crops that can thrive even in challenging growing conditions.
  
  
Syngenta Seeds is headquartered in the United States.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role purpose**
Lead the planning, execution and delivery of vegetable-seed trials
*(includes PLC 6.1, agronomy trials, satellite demos, demo day fields)*
across India to generate robust, high-quality data that supports product advancement, positioning and successful commercial launch. The role connects breeding, product specialists, agronomy and commercial teams, ensuring trials reflect diverse Indian growing environments and customer needs.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute annual trialing plans for assigned vegetable crops, including varietal evaluation, product placement and agronomic practices
* Identify and manage trial locations across key agro-climatic zones, ensuring representative testing for season, disease pressure, soil type and grower practice.
* Lead trial protocol development & execution, plot design, data standards and timely execution through internal teams, external partners and contract growers.
* Ensure accurate collection, validation and analysis of trial data covering yield, quality, maturity, disease tolerance, plant habit, shelf life and marketable traits as per the product profile. Effective use of the internal tools like Ez Capture
* Translate trial results into clear recommendations on advancement, positioning, target geographies and product claims.
* Work closely with Product specialist, Breeding & TPP teams to support pipeline decisions and hybrid advancement with trial execution, PAT execution, data collection and data consolidation for proposal to the product meetings
* Partner with commercial, Product specialist, customer experience teams to establish satellite demo & demo days field demonstrations and build compelling evidence for launches and demand generation activities around CPIs with CX and Commercial team
* Manage trialing budgets, seasonal resource plans, vendors and compliance requirements.
* Lead, coach and develop the trialing team, setting clear objectives, managing performance, building technical and operational capability, and ensuring effective deployment of people and resources across trial locations and seasons.
* Ensure adherence to company stewardship, safety, quality, phytosanitary and data-integrity standards.
* Support to the commercial team for the mass scale customer complaints validation and RCA process

**Qualifications**
**Qualifications and experience**

* Master’s degree in Agriculture, Horticulture, Plant Breeding, Agronomy or a related discipline
* Around 15 years of relevant experience in vegetable-seed trialing, product development, agronomy or field trial management
* Demonstrated experience managing multi-location trials in India, preferably across multiple vegetable crops and seasons.
* Strong understanding of vegetable production systems, crop agronomy, hybrid evaluation and market requirements.
* Experience in experimental design, statistical analysis and digital trial-data systems.
* Proven ability to lead field teams and external partners across geographically dispersed locations.
* Fluency in English; working proficiency in Hindi and/or regional languages is preferred.
* Willingness to travel extensively within India during key trialing periods.

**Key competencies**

* Strong scientific and agronomic judgement
* Rigorous data quality and attention to detail
* Planning and execution discipline
* Stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration
* Commercial awareness and customer orientation
* People leadership and capability building
* Clear, evidence-based communication

**Success measures**

* Timely completion and quality of planned trials
* Reliable, decision-ready data for pipeline and launch decisions
* Effective product recommendations by crop and region
* Trial budget and resource efficiency
* Strong adoption of trialing standards, stewardship and data governance
* Successful support for priority product launches in India

**Additional Information**
Syngenta is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion or any other employment practices for reasons of race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

title: Vice President, Platform Engineering
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Vice President, Platform Engineering
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
This is a senior site and technology leadership role. This role will provide visible leadership for Mastercard (Vocalink) colleagues in Pune and drive culture, growth, prioritisation and effectiveness of Vocalink Pune capability through influence and is accountable for the connection between Pune execution and UK leadership, architecture, engineering, programme and business priorities.
  
  
The successful candidate will bring enterprise-level technology leadership, executive presence and the ability to align a broad technical community via matrix management authority. This is not a software engineering leadership role. It requires experience influencing multidisciplinary infrastructure, platform, operations, architecture and enterprise technology stakeholders.
  
  
Key Accountabilities
  
  

* Act as the visible technology leadership and escalation point for Mastercard (Vocalink) colleagues in Pune, creating clarity and momentum without direct line-management authority.
* Drive Vocalink culture in Pune by leading town halls, leadership forums and large colleague events, engaging and influencing audiences of 100 or more people.
* Maintain an effective UK–Pune operating link, influencing People Leaders and technical stakeholders to align local execution with UK strategy, architecture, governance and business accountability.
* Translate technology strategy, roadmaps and programme direction into a clear, sequenced and achievable portfolio of work.
* Facilitate and influence prioritisation across strategic change, regulatory commitments, operational resilience, technical debt and service improvement, securing agreement from accountable leaders.
* Provide matrix leadership across multidisciplinary teams, using technical fluency to challenge assumptions, expose dependencies and shape sound decisions.
* Establish governance for demand, capacity, delivery health, risks, dependencies and escalation.
* Identify and remove systemic blockers, including unclear ownership, decision delays, skills gaps, environmental constraints and cross-team dependencies.
* Influence UK and Pune leaders to grow the volume and complexity of work delivered from Pune by aligning demand, capacity, capability and realistic delivery plans.
* Drive measurable efficiency through automation, standardisation, simplification, reuse and improved ways of working.
* Coach, connect and influence local leaders to drive talent retention, strengthen leadership depth, succession and technical capability while reinforcing an inclusive and accountable culture.
* Build effective relationships with senior leaders, architects, engineers, programme teams, support functions, partners and vendors.

Expected Outcomes
  
  

* A unified UK–Pune operating model achieved through strong relationships, shared priorities, clear ownership and effective escalation routes.
* A transparent and prioritised portfolio aligned to business outcomes and technology strategy.
* Pune Tech Hub strategy to create a high-performing, increasingly productive workforce, underpinned by robust quality, resilience and controls.
* Faster removal of blockers and more effective management of cross-functional dependencies.
* Measurable improvements in productivity, automation, deployment lead time and operational efficiency.
* A confident and increasingly self-sufficient Pune organisation, enabled through influence, coaching and stronger local leadership depth.

Candidate Profile
  
  
**The Ideal Candidate Will Demonstrate**

* Significant senior leadership experience in a complex, multinational technology, payments or critical-infrastructure environment.
* Executive presence and gravitas, with evidence of commanding large audiences and remaining credible under challenge.
* Experience providing matrix leadership across multidisciplinary infrastructure, platform, operations, architecture or enterprise technology teams. A career focused primarily on software engineering will not provide the breadth required.
* A track record of connecting offshore or remote technology capability with onshore leadership, strategy and accountability without relying on direct reporting lines.
* Strong programme and portfolio leadership covering direction-setting, prioritisation, sequencing, dependencies, risk and benefits delivery.
* Technical fluency across infrastructure, platforms, architecture, operations, resilience and security, with the ability to challenge technical positions without being the deepest subject-matter expert.
* Proven success in diagnosing delivery blockers, resolving ambiguity and establishing clear ownership and governance.
* Evidence of scaling workload and capability through effective demand, capacity and skills planning.
* Measurable delivery of efficiency through automation, standardisation, simplification or operating-model change.
* Exceptional influencing, facilitation and stakeholder-management skills, with evidence of securing commitment and resolving conflict without formal authority.
* Commercial and financial discipline in managing resources, budgets and investment priorities.
* A people-centred leadership style that builds trust, accountability, inclusion and capability across cultures and locations through coaching, credibility and relationships.
* High personal integrity and a leadership approach aligned with Vocalink and Mastercard values.

What Success Looks Like
  
  
The successful leader will establish Pune as an integrated and trusted part of Mastercard (Vocalink) technology organisation through influence rather than hierarchy. They will convene stakeholders, create a sustainable pipeline of valuable work, resolve barriers and secure commitment to clear priorities, effective governance and measurable outcomes.
  
  
**Essential Screening Summary**

* Broad enterprise technology leadership, not solely software engineering.
* Proven executive presence and large-audience communication.
* Cross-location matrix leadership connecting Pune or offshore delivery with UK or onshore accountability.
* Programme direction, portfolio prioritisation and technical fluency.
* Evidence of influencing accountable leaders to remove blockers, scale workload and deliver measurable efficiencies.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Sourcing Manager
description:
**Position Summary**
Identify and develop supplier base for existing and plan for new products for local & overseas divisional requirement. Provide guidance to the SCM/quality team in MSDI.
  
  
Shape the strategy for Sourcing and analytics of key commodities across all value streams/products in a cost-effective way that enhance product value to support divisions AIP objectives.
  
  
THIS ROLE IS BASED IN PUNE.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Supplier Sourcing & Selection**

* Conduct market and vendor research to identify potential suppliers across required commodities (casting, machining, sub‑assembly, C‑class).
* Compare and evaluate supplier proposals using total cost of ownership criteria (price, lead time, quality, capacity, risk).
* Lead supplier selection and onboarding, ensuring alignment with product specifications and commercial objectives.
* Negotiate pricing, payment terms, Incoterms, and other commercial conditions to secure competitive, sustainable agreements.

**Supplier Development & Quality Assurance**

* Establish and validate manufacturing processes at supplier locations to meet product quality and specification requirements.
* Conduct supplier capability assessments and drive corrective actions to raise quality to expected standards.
* Own PPAP and supplier acceptance activities and remain accountable for new‑part stabilization through PPAP + 3 months.
* Collaborate with suppliers to implement process controls (machining, tooling, heat treatment, grinding, lapping, casting) and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Category & Commodity Strategy**

* Define and execute commodity strategies for key categories in alignment with market trends and divisional AIP/growth objectives.
* Segment suppliers (strategic / preferred / transactional) and deploy appropriate governance, risk‑mitigation and supplier development approaches.
* Implement long‑term sourcing roadmaps including supplier consolidation, localization and strategic partnerships.

**Cost Optimisation & Value Engineering (VAVE)**

* Lead value engineering (VAVE) initiatives and product cost analyses to identify opportunities for cost reduction and value enhancement.
* Analyse material, labour and overhead cost drivers; implement initiatives to reduce total supply chain cost via price, volume aggregation, lead‑time reduction or quality-driven savings.
* Drive VAVE projects from conception to implementation and monitor adherence to budget and timelines.

**Capacity Planning & Supply Continuity**

* Monitor supplier capacity and utilisation to ensure uninterrupted supply and manage contingency plans for peak demand or disruptions.
* Work with suppliers and internal planning teams to forecast demand and align capacity, buffer inventories or alternate sources as needed.

**Contracting & Commercial Management**

* Lead contract negotiations and finalization of strategic supply agreements, VMI arrangements, rebates/discounts and periodic price agreements.
* Manage and optimise key commercial attributes (price, payment terms, MoQs, lead times, penalty terms) to support business needs.

**Project & New Product Sourcing**

* Lead purchasing strategy for new products and customer projects, developing suppliers in parallel with product development.
* Manage supplier development of new parts through launch and stabilization (responsible for new parts until PPAP + 3 months).

**Spend & Supplier Performance Management**

* Monitor and analyse spend and supplier base performance; create and implement plans to optimise price, lead‑time, service levels and supplier capabilities.
* Drive supplier performance reviews and corrective actions; escalate chronic issues and implement improvement plans.

**Financial Control & Performance**

* Control and manage budgeted procurement spend; identify and address adverse trends to meet business objectives and priorities.
* Drive year‑on‑year cost savings and contribute to Deflation Plan / Price Performance metrics.
* Deliver at least the defined productivity savings target (e.g., 1% productivity savings of total supplier spend) and continually identify further opportunities.

**Technical Expertise & Continuous Improvement**

* Apply deep technical knowledge of manufacturing processes (machining, tooling, heat treatment, grinding, lapping, casting) to enable supplier discussions, troubleshooting and capability development.
* Conduct periodic product and process analyses to identify cost and value improvement opportunities and embed continuous improvement into supplier relationships.

**Risk Management & Market Intelligence**

* Analyze market trends, commodity price drivers and supplier capabilities to anticipate risks and unlock sourcing opportunities that support profitable growth.
* Recommend hedging, sourcing diversification or alternative material/tech solutions where appropriate.

**Qualifications**

* B.Tech/M.Tech Degree with Supply Chain or Management discipline.
* 8-12 years of experience
* Six sigma green belt will be added advantage.

**Cost Manager – Procurement**

The ideal candidate should have strong experience in procurement planning, commercial negotiations, cost management, contract administration, and stakeholder management within the Construction, Real Estate, Infrastructure, Data Center, EPC, PMC, or Interior Fit-out sectors.

Procurement Management

Cost Management & Commercial Control

* Identify cost-saving opportunities and implement value engineering initiatives.

* Manage vendor performance and compliance.

Project & Stakeholder Coordination

* Participate in project planning and procurement review meetings.
* Provide regular procurement status updates to internal stakeholders.

Risk, Compliance & Governance

* Ensure adherence to company procurement policies and procedures.
* Mitigate procurement and supply chain risks.
* Monitor supplier compliance with quality, safety, and contractual obligations.
* Support internal and external audits by maintaining procurement documentation.

Qualifications

Education

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Quantity Surveying, Commerce, or related discipline.
* MBA/Postgraduate qualification in Procurement, Supply Chain, Finance, or Operations will be an added advantage.

Experience

* 8-10 years of experience in Procurement and Cost Management.
* Experience in Construction, Data Centers, Real Estate, Infrastructure, EPC, PMC, or Interior Fit-out projects preferred.

title: Field Application Manager – Robotics
description:
Location for this opening: Pune Factory

Field Application Manager – Robotics

Lead field applications at the first company in India to design, manufacture and assemble robots and AMRs in-house. It is a priceless opportunity to shape robotics in India.

Own applications, demos and commissioning for cobots, industrial robots, AMRs, AGVs, humanoids and robot dogs, including Fairino, Yasaka and Unitree.

Location: Openings at Mumbai Factory, Pune Factory and Delhi region (HQ: Navi Mumbai, Koparkhairane), with regular travel to customer sites

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience: 6–10 years

The Role

You will lead Luna's Field Application Engineers and own the technical success of every robotics project across our Fairino, Yasaka and Unitree range: industrial robots and cobots, AMRs, AGVs, humanoid robots and quadruped robot dogs. You will be the senior technical partner for key accounts and the sales team, and set the standards our field team works to.

What You Will Do

• Lead, coach and plan the work of the FAE team across sites.

• Own application success by validating feasibility, cycle time, cell layouts and AMR/AGV fleet concepts before commitment.

• Plan and deliver high-impact demos and proof-of-concept projects for robot arms, mobile robots, humanoids and robot dogs.

• Set and enforce standards for commissioning, programming, service, documentation and handover.

• Act as the senior technical contact for key accounts, and lead escalations to fast resolution.

• Build training programs for FAEs, sales engineers, partners and customer teams.

• Feed field insight to our in-house robot design team, principals and management.

Must Have

• BE/BTech in Mechatronics, Robotics, Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Mechanical or Automation Engineering.

• 6–10 years in robotics or automation applications, including at least 2 years leading engineers or projects.

• Hands-on robot/cobot or mobile robot commissioning, with PLC, servo and machine vision integration.

• Proven experience delivering demos, technical presentations and customer training.

• Strong customer-handling skills and willingness to travel to customer sites.

Good to Have

• Experience with ABB, FANUC, KUKA, Yaskawa, Universal Robots or similar robots is a plus.

• AMR/AGV fleet deployment, mapping and navigation; ROS experience is a plus.

• Robot cell layout, simulation or offline programming.

• Exposure to safety standards and risk assessment for robot cells and mobile robots.

Why Luna

• Be part of an India first: Luna designs, manufactures and assembles robots and AMRs in-house. Work directly with our design and manufacturing teams, plus Fairino, Yasaka and Unitree platforms. A priceless opportunity.

• Real ownership: build your team, set the standards and make fast calls, with direct access to leadership.

• Grow as we grow: as the robotics vertical scales, your role grows into senior technical and business leadership.

• Keep learning: principal and OEM trainings, manufacturer certifications, and new tech in mobile robotics, vision and motion control.

• High-impact projects: lead flagship deployments in factories, warehouses and new applications for key customers.

• Get rewarded: competitive compensation, performance incentives and a supportive, growing team.

About Luna Technologies

Luna Technologies Pvt. Ltd., headquartered in Navi Mumbai (Koparkhairane), is the first company in India to design, manufacture and assemble robots and AMRs in-house. We also deliver industrial automation, motion control and mechatronics solutions with global technology partners.

How to Apply

Email your resume to recruitment3@luna.co.in and recruitment1@luna.co.in with the subject "FAM – Robotics" and your preferred location (Mumbai, Pune or Delhi).

Luna Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Controls Engineering Manager
description:

title: Lead Technology Risk and Controls - Metrics & Automation
description:
**About Northern Trust**
As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
  
  
With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
  
  
**Major Duties**
May act as Project Leader. Provide leadership and direction to team members, fostering a collaborative and high-performance culture within Technology Risk and Control function.
  
  
Plan and oversee daily tasks and long-term projects to ensure timely and high-quality delivery.
  
  
Develop and deliver high-quality presentation materials that clearly articulate technology risk and control strategies, project updates, key findings, and recommendations for Technology and Risk stakeholders.
  
  
Collect and synthesize input from Technology Risk and Control leaders on key technology risk and control topics, translating complex themes into concise executive presentations, leadership briefings, and decision-ready materials.
  
  
Drive process improvements across Technology Risk and Controls, applying a solid understanding of technology risk domains, control design, control execution, and evidence requirements to enhance operational effectiveness and efficiency.
  
  
Support preparation for management meetings by compiling data, drafting talking points, and creating briefing materials.
  
  
Develop and maintain a knowledge base for Technology Risk and Control, including key risk areas, control expectations, governance processes, reporting standards, and supporting procedures.
  
  
Perform data analysis and visualization using tools such as Power BI to identify technology risk trends, control gaps, emerging issues, and actionable insights that support data-driven decision-making by IT management.
  
  
**Requirements**
Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related discipline and at least four, typically six or more years of technical experience in the security aspects of multiple platforms, operating systems, software, communications and network protocols or an equivalent combination of education and work experience.
  
  
Solid understanding of technology risk and control concepts, including inherent and residual risk, control objectives, key controls, risk indicators, issue management, control testing, and risk governance within a technology environment.
  
  
Experience in technology risk or control functions, preferably in financial services or a regulated industry.
  
  
Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  
  
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  
  
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  
  
**Working with Us**
As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
  
  
Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodation**
Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
  
  
**About Our Pune Office**
The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
  
  
Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

**Job Summary**
We are seeking an experienced IAM Operations Lead/Specialist to oversee offshore operations, drive service level compliance, and manage end-to-end L2 support for Identity and Access Management (IAM) systems. This role requires strong hands-on experience with core IAM platforms (Entra ID, Okta, CyberArk), operational governance, team leadership, and scripting capabilities to drive process improvements and automation.

* Oversee offshore operations team handling IAM L2 support.
* Ensure SLA compliance and maintain high quality in request handling.
* Coordinate with the Global Service Desk and other IT teams for escalations.
* Manage workload distribution and monitor team performance metrics.
* Create and manage shift rosters to ensure continuous coverage.
* Define and maintain operational processes, including tracking and managing the ticket queue.
* Drive process improvements in account creation, access provisioning, and directory services.
* Act as the primary point of contact for offshore escalations and ensure proper redirection of invalid requests.
* Collaborate with senior engineers (L3) to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues.

* Create ServiceNow dashboards and generate operational reports on SLA compliance.

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 8–10+ years of dedicated experience in IT operations and Identity and Access Management (IAM).
* Proven leadership experience in managing offshore operational teams.
* Strong working knowledge of IAM tools including Entra ID, Okta, and CyberArk.
* Solid understanding of the broader ecosystem, including Active Directory (AD/AAD), ServiceNow, and HR Systems integration.
* Hands-on experience with PowerShell scripting for automation features and Postman for API testing and troubleshooting.
* Excellent communication, reporting, and stakeholder management skills.

title: Department Manager
description:
**WHO WE ARE**
**​**

H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.​

​

We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. ​

**Job Description**

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**
**​**
  
As a Department Manager, you’ll be the leader supporting and encouraging your whole team. By fostering an inclusive culture that promotes collaboration and an entrepreneurial spirit, you’ll create an environment where everyone can thrive. Acting in line with our values, you’ll contribute to both your own success and the success of the company.

You will:

* Lead your team to deliver an outstanding customer experience by ensuring excellent operational and visual standards, while actively promoting and selling our products.
* Take responsibility for your store and department’s strengths, analyse sales performance, identify commercial opportunities, set goals, and create plans to optimize results, profits, and stock levels.
* Manage team planning, scheduling, and ensure seamless opening and closing routines.
* Recruit, onboard, and develop your team while fostering an inclusive and collaborative culture that promotes growth and innovation.
* Stay updated on fashion trends, customer preferences, and competitors to maintain a competitive edge.
* Represent yourself and the brand positively during all customer interactions.

​

**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH**
**​**

Our stores are the heart of our company, where customers experience our brand firsthand. As part of the dynamic Store Team, every role—from Sales Advisors, Department Managers, Store Managers and Visual Merchandisers to Assistant Store Managers, Cash Office Responsible, and Delivery Responsible in larger stores—contributes to creating an inspiring and welcoming environment. You’ll also connect with the wider Area Team, collaborating across stores to share insights and drive success together. Alongside your team, you'll play a vital role in helping customers feel confident and express their individuality with the latest trends and timeless styles. By building meaningful connections with customers in our stores, we make fashion accessible and sustainable for all.

​

​

**WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE**
**​**

At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.

· We value diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to race, ethnicity, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, and disability.

· We pride ourselves on being a values-driven organization, guided by our 7 unique values that have been part of our success story for over 75 years.

· We are an inclusive company where you’re encouraged to be yourself at work

· You will have access to a large global talent community, where career growth and aspirations have no limits.

· We believe in supporting your overall wellbeing and offer comprehensive benefits inclusive of health insurance, wellness for self and family.

· You’ll be able to express your personal style with our employee discount at H&M group.

· We offer 5 days of working in a week to have great work life balance.

Click here for complete role description.

**JOIN US**
**​**

Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.​

​

Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.​

​

​

*\*We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.*

**Qualifications**

*We are looking for people with…*
​

* 3+ Years of experience in retail management and operations.
* Strong leadership skills, with a passion for coaching and developing teams while exemplifying company values and culture.
* Expertise in sales planning, analysis, and follow-up, using customer-centric tools and reporting.

*And people who are…*
​

* Strong and confident leaders who inspire, coach, and develop their teams with integrity.
* Thriving in collaborative, dynamic environments, with a solution-focused mindset.
* Motivated to create great customers experiences while promoting and selling our products.
* A keen interest in fashion trends, commerciality, and competitor insights to drive sales.
* Effective communicators, creative, and curious.
* Flexible, analytical, and achievement-oriented, with the ability to manage statistics and work with numbers.

​

**Additional Information**

This is a full-time position for our stores in Pune. The position reports to the Store Manager.

title: Workforce Management - Senior Associate Manager - Real Time (Bangkok, Kuala Lumpur, Gurgaon, Pune Based - Relocation Provided)
description:
**About Agoda**

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

**About Agoda**

 

 

Agoda is an online travel booking platform for accommodation, flights, and more. We build and deploy cutting edge technology that connects travelers with more than 2.5 million accommodations globally. Based in Asia and part of Booking Holdings, our 4,000+ talents coming from 90+ different nationalities foster a work environment rich in diversity, creativity, and collaboration. We innovate through a culture of experimentation and ownership, enabling our customers to experience the world.  

 

**Get to Know our Team:**

 

 

The Customer Experience Group of Agoda effectively serves our customers and partners to ensure satisfying results. This great task is accomplished with the support of our Global Service Vertical team. We serve as the backbone for Customer Experience Group’s global operations. Our team is comprised of project managers, process owners, analysts, and talent management. Together we work nonstop to improve the quality and efficiency of our customer and partner support processes. Working with the Global Service Vertical team is a great opportunity to collaborate with various stakeholders and develop initiatives with our sister companies and external partners all over the world. We are a very data-driven environment, eager to move fast and learn through experimentation. A clear focus on supporting our customers and partners is bolstered by a strong, entrepreneurial culture that enriches us and Agoda’s business performance.

 

 

 

**The Opportunity:**

 

The Senior Associate WFM Manager is a people leader in role, responsible for leading a WFM team, enabling them to be successful and delivering against the prescribed KPIs.

 

The Manager enables their team and team members by providing coaching and feedback, building strong professional relationships, maintaining a regular flow of communication, and providing direction, support, and development.

 

The Manager also contributes to the overall WFM performance and culture, collaborating with peers and broader colleagues to ensure WFM delivers to the company and CEG objectives.

 

The Senior Associate WFM Manager is expected to be an SME in Workforce Management, having a good knowledge of WFM concepts, to support the team with challenges and capability and to adequately represent WFM, to senior stakeholders.

 

 

 

**ACTIVITIES PERFORMED ON THE JOB:**

 

* ****Coaching and giving feedback:****

* Coaching and providing feedback within WFM (usually one-on-one) constructively and creatively, to enable colleagues to perform at their best.

* Review performance of individuals and team using performance reports/dashboards, observations, buddying, and reviewing system audit reports.

* Manage all underperformance, using the Performance Improvement Plan (PIP) process where appropriate.

* ****People leadership:****

* Build healthy and professional relationships with team members.

* Establish and nurture a culture of performance excellence, open feedback, collaboration, recognition, and quality delivery of outcomes.

* Organize team building activities that will engage people in teamwork and create a positive work environment.

* Ensure the team is well supported to perform their day-to-day activities, including:

* ensuring appropriate real-time support is available, taking and managing escalated issues.

* Providing approvals as part of the business process (e.g. absorption).

* Ensure team schedule is maintained to a high standard to provide stakeholder support and manage team requests and unplanned absence, in line with process.

* Provide clarity on performance vs targets, and any other team or group objectives.

* Use reward and recognition as part of motivating the team.

* Conduct team meetings: sharing important information, updates, performance progress, and broader company updates.

* Ensure your team is connected to the company's WFM objectives and strategy.

* Be an example to the team through behavior, living up to the Agoda values and behavior standards expected of people leaders.

* Collaborate with other departments, working together to enable overall success (e.g. WFM teams, CEG Operations Teams, CEG Teach Team).

* ****Reporting & data analysis:****

* Work with data from various sources to analyze and observe performance of CEG SLAs and gain insights as a basis for feedback and change suggestions.

* Prepare and present team performance data, challenges, issues, ideas, and opportunities.

* ****Collaboration:****

* Collaborate with local WFM team:

* On team performance: providing updates about the team, traffic, projects, concerns, challenges, and opportunities.

* Participate actively in leadership meetings: share what works well for you, provide feedback and input on decisions or updates, and be open and constructive about what is not working well and how the group can improve.

* Stay up to date with products, news, goals, decisions, projects.

* Collaborate with other teams:

* CEG Operations Leadership and Management.

* CEG GSV.

* ****Personal Management:****

* Remain up to date with important company/team/department updates, requirements.

* Act in the best interests of the organization: ensuring that we operate with absolute integrity and compliance with all legal obligations or compliance requirements.

* Be an active and constructive Agoda team member: Always being respectful to others and seeking to be better together.

* Aim to understand, then meet and exceed the expectations agreed with your manager.

 

**EXPECTATIONS - BEHAVIORS AND VALUES**

 

**Behavior**

 

**Definition**

 

***Continuous improvement***

 

Regularly identify improvement opportunities, quantify them, and follow through to measurable/demonstratable outcomes. Embraces both successes and failures to learn and maximize the benefits.
 
  

Embraces and drives change, is open and supportive of improvement opportunities identified by others.

 

***Deliver better together***

 

Collaborates and engages with colleagues and broader Agoda teams to share ideas and learn and work together toward shared ambitions.
 
  

Is respectful to colleagues, open to different perspectives /viewpoints, and positively contributes to discussions.

 

***Enable others` success***

 

Is committed to building and nurturing a culture of frequent feedback, coaching and career development. 
 
  

Provides clarity on accountability, goals, and progress.
 
  

Regularly takes the opportunity to connect and align teams and team members to the Agoda/CEG strategy, making these relevant and digestible.

 

 

**COMPETENCIES REQUIRED**

 

**Analytical Ability & Problem Solving**

 

Can visualise, articulate, conceptualise, or solve both complex and uncomplicated problems using the data available.

 

**Decision making ability**

 

Set a course of action purposely chosen from different alternatives to achieve company objectives.

 

**Effective communication**

(Verbal and written)

 

Delivers, receives, and interprets ideas and information, presents information appropriately to a diverse range of audiences, and influences partner decisions Excel/Power Point Skills

 

**Flexibility and Agility**

 

Can adjust behavior to new information and changing circumstances. Be open to new ways of doing things and always experiment with new methods. Works effectively in a dynamic environment.

 

**KPI management**

 

Create and execute a KPI plan designed to help achieve and evaluate success in reaching the company's goals.

 

**Listening and influencing**

 

Practice attentive and active listening. Can influence strategies that persuade key stakeholders to take action that will promote shared interests and business goals.

 

**Process Improvement**

 

Organise, evaluate, plan, and implement improvements in our internal and external processes and practices. Actively work on creating better processes once changes take place.

 

**Reporting**

 

 Be able to confidently give a written account of business metrics, projects, and team performance based on data, observations, or investigations.

 

**Result driven**

 

Driving high standards to accomplish challenging goals. Works hard to achieve them.

 

**Time / workload management & prioritization**

 

Creating a work environment where tasks and responsibilities are accomplished successfully within the time available.

 

**Coaching**

title: Manufacturing/Production Head
description:
**CAbout the Role**

**We are looking for an experienced Manufacturing Head / Plant Head**
to lead and manage end-to-end manufacturing and plant operations for our medical technology business.

The role will be responsible for ensuring efficient manufacturing operations while maintaining high standards of quality, compliance, productivity, cost control, and on-time delivery.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end manufacturing and plant operations, including production planning, assembly, testing, dispatch, and operational execution.
* Develop and implement manufacturing strategies aligned with business and production requirements.
* Manage production planning and scheduling to achieve quality, productivity, and delivery targets.
* Establish and monitor KPIs for production, quality, productivity, yield, OEE, cost, and delivery.
* Ensure compliance with applicable quality management systems, regulatory requirements, SOPs, and manufacturing standards.
* Work closely with Quality, R&D, Engineering, Procurement, Supply Chain, Service, and Commercial teams.
* Drive process improvement, lean manufacturing, waste reduction, productivity improvement, and cost optimization.
* Identify manufacturing bottlenecks and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Ensure effective utilization of manpower, machines, materials, and plant infrastructure.
* Lead capacity planning and support new product introduction (NPI), product transfer, and manufacturing scale-up.
* Establish robust systems for process validation, production documentation, traceability, and change management.
* Manage vendors and contract manufacturing partners, wherever applicable.
* Ensure adherence to EHS and workplace safety requirements.
* Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing manufacturing and plant operations team.
* Prepare and manage manufacturing budgets, operational costs, and resource requirements.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across the plant.
* Participate in internal and external quality/regulatory audits and ensure timely closure of observations.
* Provide regular operational updates and manufacturing performance reports to senior management.

**Relevant Skills and Knowledge**

**·       Strong leadership in plant operations, production planning, capacity management, and team development.**

**·       In-depth knowledge of medical-device and IVD manufacturing, including assembly, testing, packaging, labeling, traceability, and product release controls.**

**·       Working knowledge of ISO 13485, applicable regulatory requirements, Good Manufacturing Practices, and audit-readiness expectations.**

**·       Strong understanding of process validation, equipment qualification, manufacturing documentation, nonconformance control, CAPA, risk management, and change control.**

**·       Experience with lean manufacturing, operational excellence, root-cause analysis, waste reduction, OEE, yield improvement, and cost optimization.**

**·       Knowledge of supply chain coordination, inventory control, vendor management, and contract manufacturing oversight.**

**·       Ability to support NPI, design transfer, production scale-up, and cross-functional issue resolution.**

These plants operate using Solar, Wind, Battery storage or Grid connections, either individually or in combination. This position entails ensuring the reliability of all plants from an electrical standpoint, encompassing both HV & LV systems. The ideal candidate must possess a solid understanding of transformers, rectifiers, breakers, motors, etc. (prior solar experience will be an added advantage). Responsibilities include developing safe operating procedures for electrical operations, creating preventive maintenance schedules for equipment, conducting root cause analyses on failures, devising spare parts plans for the plants, and assisting sites in identifying and troubleshooting issues, either remotely or through on-site visits depending on the severity of the issue.

Supporting the engineering team in identifying suitable equipment, reviewing, and implementing changes by creating MOC (Management of Change) documents are key responsibilities of this role. While the base location for this position will be in Pune, frequent visits to multiple plants across India will be necessary.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Coordinating with site teams to oversee day-to-day operations.
* Establishing a preventive maintenance (PM) schedule for all electrical equipment.
* Ensuring the timely completion of PM tasks.
* Conducting root cause analyses (RCA) on equipment failures and facilitating troubleshooting efforts.
* Developing Safe Operating Procedures (SOPs) for electrical operations.
* Guaranteeing compliance with electrical safety regulations at the site in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.
* Providing training to site engineers and technicians on electrical operations and safety protocols.
* Implementing and promoting a safe work culture at the site through the implementation of Permit-to-Work (PtW) systems, Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) procedures, and Management of Change (MOC) processes.
* Assisting the project and engineering teams in equipment selection and supporting pre-commissioning/commissioning activities for new plants. Liaising with government offices to ensure compliance with regulations.
* Taking responsibility for maintenance and troubleshooting activities related to solar plants, which are integral to the core plant operations.

**Qualifications:**

• Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering.

• Minimum of 10 years of experience in continuous process plant/Gas Plant/ASU/SMR/Chemical-Fertilizer plants, etc.

• Strong knowledge of Solar PV-based power generation control and wind power generation control. Control of BESS power systems will be additional value.

**Desired Skills:**

An Electrical Engineer should have a deep-seated passion for sustainable energy and a desire to make a positive impact on the environment.

**Creativity:**
As renewable energy technologies continue to evolve, an electrical engineer should have the ability to think creatively and develop innovative solutions to operational challenges.

**Analytical thinking:**
Electrical Engineers should be able to analyse data, interpret results, and make sound engineering decisions.

**Team player:**
Electrical Engineers should be able to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams to ensure successful project execution.

**Adaptability:**
Electrical Engineers should be able to adapt to changing circumstances and be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.

**Problem-solving skills:**
Electrical Engineers should be able to identify problems and develop solutions to overcome them.

**Attention to detail:**
Electrical Engineers should have a strong attention to detail to ensure that projects are completed to required standards.

**Integrity:**
Electrical Engineers should operate with the utmost integrity and be committed to ethical engineering practices.

**Continuous learning:**
Electrical Engineers should have a passion for continuous learning and be committed to staying up-to-date with the latest advancements in renewable energy technologies.

title: Tech Manager, Cloud Operations, Actimize
description:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.
  
  
**So, what’s the role all about?**
We are looking for a technically strong and delivery-focused Technical Manager to lead a team of CloudOps Delivery Engineers responsible for post go-live operations of cloud-based applications. This role is critical in ensuring timely upgrades, defect resolution, and performance enhancements across our customer environments. You will work closely with cross-functional teams and customers to drive operational excellence and continuous improvement.
  
  
**What you will be doing?**

+ Lead and mentor a team of CloudOps Delivery Engineers focused on post go-live activities.

+ Promote a culture of ownership, agility, and technical excellence.

* Technical Delivery

+ Oversee upgrades to the latest product versions across the customer base.
+ Oversee the deployment of changes, enhancements and fixes for performance, security, and stability.
+ Ensure adherence to change management and CAB processes.
+ Drive automation and standardization of delivery workflows.
+ Assess technical feasibility and impact of proposed changes and upgrades across diverse customer environments.
+ Define and maintain delivery playbooks and low-level execution plans to support consistent and scalable delivery.
+ Collaborate with Program Managers to support project planning, effort estimation, and resource allocation.
+ Identify risks and dependencies early in the delivery lifecycle and propose mitigation strategies.

* Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement

+ Work closely with CloudOps Delivery Program Managers to align on delivery plans, priorities, pipeline and backlog management.
+ Collaborate with internal teams including AppOps, DevOps, Customer Support, Professional Services and R&D to resolve issues and improve delivery outcomes.
+ Support customer-facing teams in ensuring smooth post go-live operations.

* Operational Excellence

+ Drive automation, standardization, and scalability of delivery processes.
+ Track and report on delivery KPIs including upgrade success rates, defect resolution times, and customer impact.
+ Identify and implement improvements to reduce manual effort and increase reliability.

**Have you got what it takes?**

* 10+ years of experience in Application Implementation, Cloud Operations or Infrastructure Engineering.
* 5+ years in a technical leadership or management role.
* Strong hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes, and infrastructure automation tools (Terraform, Ansible, etc.).
* Solid understanding of change management, version control, and configuration management.
* Experience working in a SaaS or Enterprise software environment.

+ Certifications in cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP, CKA Kubernetes).
+ Familiarity with ITIL or other service management frameworks.
+ Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
+ Experience with customer-facing delivery or support roles.

**What’s in it for you?**
Join an ever-growing, market disrupting, global company where the teams – comprised of the best of the best – work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NiCE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate, innovative, and excited to constantly raise the bar, you may just be our next NiCEr!

At NiCE, we work according to the NiCE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. Naturally, office days focus on face-to-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere.

Individual Contributor

title: Laboratory Manager - Geotechnical and Material Testing (NABL)
description:
**Job title:**
Laboratory Manager – Geotechnical & Materials Testing (NABL)

**Company:**
Soiltech India Private Limited

**Workplace type:**
On-site

**Location:**
Hadapsar, Pune, Maharashtra

**Employment type:**
Full-time

**Seniority:**
Mid-Senior level

**Industry:**
Civil Engineering

**Job function:**
Engineering, Quality Assurance

**Description:**

Soiltech India Private Limited is an ISO/IEC 17025:2017 NABL-accredited geotechnical investigation and materials testing laboratory since 1974. We are hiring a Laboratory Manager to run our Pune lab: test quality, turnaround, people, and continued NABL accreditation.

**What you’ll do**

Technical operations

* Plan and supervise testing of soil, rock, concrete and aggregates as per IS 2720, IS 516, IS 2386, ASTM and project specifications
* Oversee grain size, Atterberg limits, compaction, CBR, consolidation, direct shear, triaxial, permeability, UCS, point load and cube/core testing
* Testing of materials like Aggregates, cement, steel, cubes etc
* Review data and reports before release; act as authorised signatory once NABL approves you
* Manage sample receipt, storage and retention, and meet committed turnaround times
* Support the commercial team on test scope and lab capacity for tenders

NABL and quality system

* Maintain compliance with ISO/IEC 17025:2017 and NABL requirements for the accredited scope
* Lead NABL surveillance, renewal and scope-extension assessments, and close NCs on time
* Conduct internal audits and management reviews; maintain the quality manual, SOPs and formats
* Manage the calibration schedule, intermediate checks and traceability
* Estimate measurement uncertainty and validate methods
* Organise proficiency testing and inter-laboratory comparisons
* Handle complaints, non-conforming work and corrective actions

People and equipment

* Train and authorise lab staff, and maintain competence records
* Build a trained backup for every accredited test
* Plan equipment procurement, maintenance and AMCs
* Enforce lab safety and housekeeping

**What you bring**

* B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering; M.E./M.Tech in Geotechnical Engineering preferred
* 5-8 years of hands-on geotechnical and materials testing experience
* 3+ years as Technical Manager, Quality Manager or authorised signatory in a NABL-accredited lab, having faced at least two NABL assessments
* Working knowledge of ISO/IEC 17025:2017, internal auditing and measurement uncertainty
* ISO/IEC 17025 internal auditor training preferred
* Rock mechanics and advanced soil testing experience is a plus

**What we offer**

* Leadership of a 50-year-old accredited lab
* Exposure to metro, highway, hydropower, mining and industrial projects across India
* Competitive salary based on experience

Apply here
