title: ML Operations Lead
description: # Job Title: ML Operations LeadExperience:** 18–25 Years overallRelevant Experience:** 8+ years in ML, MLOps, or Data Science Engineering, including team leadershipLocation:** Hinjewadi Phase 1, PuneWork Mode:** 5 Days Work from OfficeWorking Hours:** 9 AM – 6 PM IST(870)Notice Period:** Immediate Joiners to Serving Notice Period Candidates(only upto 30days)## Role OverviewWe are seeking an experienced ML Operations Lead to lead a team responsible for operating and maintaining traditional Machine Learning models in production. The role focuses on ensuring model accuracy, reliability, stability, auditability, and continuous performance through effective monitoring, drift detection, retraining, validation, deployment, and rollback practices.The successful candidate will manage a team of two ML Operations Engineers in India and collaborate with international stakeholders, Data Engineering teams, and business teams to ensure timely and reliable model operations.Note:** This is a classical MLOps role focused on traditional predictive ML models, not LLM/GenAI operations.## Key Responsibilities Lead, mentor, and develop the ML Operations team, establishing operational standards, priorities, and best practices. Manage the deployment, monitoring, retraining, validation, and maintenance of traditional ML models in production. Establish model validation gates, including backtesting and champion-challenger approaches, before promoting models to production. Define and manage rollback procedures to restore previous stable model versions when required. Monitor data drift, feature drift, concept drift, and model performance degradation across the model portfolio. Define retraining triggers, thresholds, and processes to maintain model accuracy and reliability. Maintain model registries, version history, training data lineage, baseline metrics, and last-known-good model records. title: Associate Director - BAU Support
description:

In addition to running stable operations, the role will drive transformation of BAU through AI and automation, improving efficiency, reducing cost, and minimizing human dependency.

**The responsibilities we entrust you**

**End-to-End BAU Operations Ownership**

* Lead and govern L1, L2, and L3 support teams (~50 members) across a 24x7 operating model
* Ensure high availability, stability, and performance of the cards processing platform
* Drive structured shift management, escalation matrices, and handoffs
* Act as the single accountable owner for production support delivery and outcomes

**Incident & Problem Management Leadership**

* Lead Major Incident Management (P1/P2) including coordination across technical and business teams
* Own end-to-end incident lifecycle — detection, triage, resolution, and closure
* Conduct Incident reviews / Post-Incident Reviews (PIRs)

* Ensure strong focus on preventive and corrective actions
* Interface directly with customers during escalations and critical incidents

**Command Center Management**

* Establish and manage a centralized Command Center (24x7) for real-time monitoring and incident coordination
* Drive command center governance including war-room execution for major incidents
* Ensure seamless collaboration across L1, L2, L3, Infra, and Engineering teams
* Define escalation frameworks and communication standards

**Command Center Optimization & Dashboarding**

* Continuously improve the way of working within the Command Center
* Design and enhance real-time operational dashboards
* Implement alert correlation, prioritization, and noise reduction
* Enable proactive monitoring and faster decision-making

**KPI Governance & Service Excellence**

* Track MTTD, MTTR, incident volume, and SLA adherence
* Build operational dashboards for leadership
* Drive reduction in incidents and faster resolution
* Move towards near-zero avoidable incidents

**AI & Automation-led Transformation**

* Identify areas for AI/AIOps integration
* Automate incident detection, classification, and remediation
* Drive RCA automation and incident clustering
* Deliver cost optimization and efficiency improvements

**Customer & Stakeholder Management**

* Act as primary interface for customers for BAU operations
* Lead escalation calls and service reviews
* Present incident summaries, RCAs, and KPIs
* Collaborate with engineering, infra, and product teams

**Team Leadership & Capability Building**

* Lead and mentor support teams
* Define KRAs and performance metrics
* Drive training and upskilling
* Build ownership-driven culture

**Risk, Compliance & Governance**

* Ensure PCI DSS and scheme compliance
* Identify risks and implement controls
* Support audits and regulatory reviews

15+ years in IT with strong cards & payments domain experience

Experience with at least 2 card processing platforms

2–3 years managing BAU operations

Strong experience in incident management, RCA, and escalations

Exposure to AWS and AI technologies

**Communication & Ownership:**

1. Strong communication, interpersonal, and conflict resolution skills
2. Able to work both independently and as part of a team

title: Campus Director – Academics, Operations & Student Success
description:
**Hiring: Campus Director – Academics, Operations & Student Success**

**Location:**
Pune, Maharashtra (On-site)

**Experience:**
Minimum 8 years | Preferred 10–15 years

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**About the Role**

Intellipaat is seeking a dynamic, result-oriented Campus Director to take complete ownership of academic delivery, faculty management, campus administration, student experience, financial discipline, and operational excellence at its Pune campus.

The successful candidate will act as the
**single point of accountability for campus performance**
, ensuring that every academic, operational, and student-experience commitment is implemented to the highest standards.

This is a hands-on leadership position requiring strong execution capabilities, an ownership mindset, and the ability to lead cross-functional teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Academic Delivery & Curriculum Execution**

* Ensure end-to-end execution of the approved curriculum and academic delivery plans established.
* Oversee academic, daily class schedules, faculty allocations, labs, assignments, assessments, and examinations.
* Ensure every class and practical session is delivered according to approved schedules and quality standards.
* Monitor student learning outcomes, curriculum completion, coding proficiency, projects, and academic performance.
* Identify learning gaps, establish corrective action plans, and ensure timely improvement.
* Drive coding labs, hackathons, innovation activities, industry projects, and other experiential learning initiatives.

**2. Faculty Leadership & Quality Management**

* Supervise all teaching faculty, academic coordinators, mentors, and supporting academic staff.
* Coordinate faculty recruitment, onboarding, training, performance reviews, and development.
* Conduct regular classroom observations and faculty-quality audits.
* Monitor faculty attendance, teaching effectiveness, student feedback, syllabus coverage, and assessment quality.
* Ensure appropriate replacement and contingency arrangements for faculty absence or performance issues.
* Build a culture of academic accountability and continuous improvement.

**3. Student Success & Campus Experience**

* Own the complete student experience from onboarding to graduation.
* Monitor attendance, academic performance, student engagement, behavioral discipline, and retention.
* Establish effective mentorship, academic counseling, and student-support systems.
* Conduct regular student-feedback sessions, address grievances, and drive improvements.
* Maintain proactive communication with parents regarding student progress and important concerns.
* Promote coding competitions, hackathons, technical clubs, entrepreneurship, and extracurricular initiatives.
* Ensure students experience a safe, disciplined, supportive, and high-quality learning environment.

**4. Campus Administration & Operations**

* Take ownership of day-to-day campus functioning, including classrooms, laboratories, IT infrastructure, facilities, security, housekeeping, and vendor management.
* Lead the campus administration team and coordinate with university departments.
* Ensure readiness of infrastructure, learning equipment, and student facilities.
* Oversee hostel and transportation coordination wherever applicable.
* Maintain operational discipline, safety standards, documentation, and effective grievance-resolution mechanisms.
* Ensure adherence to company SOPs and applicable university policies.

**5. Fee Management & Financial Accountability**

* Monitor student fee-payment schedules, collections, outstanding balances, and overdue payments.
* Coordinate with finance, admissions, students, and parents to ensure timely and professional fee follow-ups.
* Maintain accurate fee records, reconciliations, payment commitments, and collection forecasts.
* Identify and escalate chronic overdue cases, fee disputes, and financial irregularities.
* Supervise campus operating expenditure, budget adherence, vendor payments, and resource utilization.
* Ensure fee-related decisions and collection processes comply with university agreements and applicable policies.

**6. University Coordination & Stakeholder Management**

* Act as the primary operational liaison between all stakeholders.
* Build strong working relationships with university leadership, academic departments, examination teams, and administrative offices.
* Coordinate implementation of approved academic schedules, curriculum, academic policies, examination requirements, and student records.
* Ensure university-specific academic and administrative requirements are fulfilled on time.
* Escalate matters requiring institutional approvals without disrupting student learning.

**7. Campus Performance & Reporting**

* Maintain daily and weekly dashboards covering academic delivery, faculty performance, student attendance, student satisfaction, fee collections, and operational issues.
* Conduct regular performance reviews with faculty and administration teams.
* Identify performance deviations, create corrective action plans, and track closure.
* Provide transparent, data-driven reporting wherever required.
* Take accountability for agreed campus performance targets and continuous improvement.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

* Minimum 8 years of professional experience, preferably 10–15 years in higher education, engineering colleges, university administration, EdTech, or academic operations.
* At least 3 years managing academic or campus operations with direct responsibility for teams and measurable outcomes.
* Prior experience as Campus Head, Campus Director, Academic Operations Head, Dean – Operations, Senior Program Manager, or equivalent.
* Proven ability to manage faculty, academic delivery, student experience, administration, and multiple stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of engineering or technology education and outcome-oriented learning models.
* Experience implementing centralized curriculum and academic policies at a campus level.
* Demonstrated ability to manage budgets, fee follow-ups, operational reporting, and escalations.
* Strong leadership, problem-solving, conflict-resolution, communication, and analytical capabilities.
* Proficiency with Excel/Google Sheets, dashboards, student information systems, and LMS/ERP platforms.
* Bachelor's degree required; B.Tech, MBA, or a relevant postgraduate qualification preferred.

**What We Are Looking For**

We need a leader who is proactive, highly disciplined, data-driven, and comfortable taking complete ownership.

The ideal candidate should be equally comfortable reviewing classroom teaching quality, handling a difficult parent conversation, resolving faculty shortages, coordinating with university leadership, reviewing fee outstanding reports, and driving improvements in student performance.

**Success in this position will be measured by academic outcomes, curriculum execution, faculty effectiveness, student satisfaction, operational excellence, financial discipline, and overall campus performance.**

title: Manager - Cloud Container Services
description:
**About Northern Trust**
As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
  
  
With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
  
  
Position Overview
  
  
The Manager, Cloud Container Services is responsible for the operational leadership, governance, reliability, and lifecycle management of the enterprise Azure Central Kubernetes Service (CAKS) platform. The role leads a team of Kubernetes platform engineers and operations specialists responsible for delivering a secure, scalable, highly available, and automated container platform that enables application teams to deploy and operate workloads efficiently across the enterprise.
  
  
This position serves as the operational owner of the centralized AKS platform, driving platform adoption, service reliability, operational excellence, security compliance, and executive reporting. The role is accountable for providing leadership with actionable insights on platform performance, adoption, operational risks, capacity utilization, cost optimization, and service health. The role aligns closely with the enterprise Cloud Foundation strategy and centralized, multi-tenant AKS operating model.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Platform Operations & Service Ownership
  
  

* Own and manage the enterprise Azure Central Kubernetes (CAKS) platform.
* Ensure platform availability, stability, scalability, security, and operational excellence.
* Lead Incident, Problem, Change, Capacity, and Availability Management processes.
* Establish operational standards, support models, runbooks, and platform governance controls.
* Drive Kubernetes platform lifecycle management, including upgrades, patching, and end-of-life planning.
* Ensure adherence to enterprise security, compliance, and governance requirements.

Kubernetes Platform Management
  
  

* Oversee centralized multi-tenant AKS environments supporting mission-critical and non-mission-critical workloads.
* Manage cluster operations, node pool lifecycle, networking, and platform integrations.
* Ensure secure workload onboarding and platform standardization across business units.
* Partner with engineering teams to implement scalable and reusable Kubernetes platform capabilities.
* Drive platform modernization initiatives, automation, and self-service capabilities.

Reliability Engineering & Operational Excellence
  
  

* Define and monitor SLAs, SLOs, and operational KPIs.
* Lead major incident management and root cause analysis activities.
* Drive reliability engineering practices and resilience improvements.
* Implement automation-first operational processes leveraging GitHub and Infrastructure as Code.
* Ensure disaster recovery and business continuity readiness for critical Kubernetes workloads.
* Reduce operational overhead through standardization and automated remediation.

Executive Reporting & Operational Metrics
  
  

* Develop executive dashboards and leadership reporting focused on:

+ Platform Availability & Uptime
+ Cluster Health Metrics
+ MTTR & Incident Trends
+ SLA/SLO Compliance
+ Kubernetes Resource Utilization
+ Capacity Planning & Forecasting
+ Node Pool Utilization
+ Security & Compliance Posture
+ Platform Adoption Metrics
+ Cost Optimization & FinOps Insights
+ Support Backlog & Service Request Metrics

* Present operational reviews, risk assessments, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership

**Security & Governance**

* Maintain enterprise Kubernetes governance standards.
* Oversee RBAC, Azure AD integration, Managed Identities, and secrets management.
* Ensure enforcement of Azure Policy, security guardrails, and compliance controls.
* Partner with Cybersecurity teams to ensure secure platform operations.
* Lead audit and regulatory compliance activities related to container platforms

Stakeholder & Vendor Management
  
  

* Serve as the primary operational contact for application teams consuming AKS services.
* Build relationships with Architecture, Infrastructure, Security, DevOps, and Engineering teams.
* Collaborate with Microsoft and strategic partners to optimize platform capabilities.
* Drive customer experience and service improvement initiatives across the Kubernetes ecosystem.

People Leadership
  
  

* Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing Kubernetes platform operations team.
* Establish operational goals and performance expectations.
* Drive talent development, succession planning, and technical capability growth.
* Promote a culture of automation, accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.

**Qualifications**
Education & Experience:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field (Master’s preferred).
* 10+ years of experience in data engineering, cloud engineering, container engineering or platform engineering with 15+ years of total work experience, including Azure and/or AWS environments.
* 5+ years of people management experience managing Platform Engineering, DevOps, Infrastructure, or Operations Teams.
* Proven experience managing enterprise-scale cloud data platforms, specifically:

+ Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
+ Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, ArgoCD.
+ DevOps, GitHub, Terraform, Hub and Spoke Architecture,
+ RBAC, Managed Identities, Azure Key Vault etc..

* Strong experience leading ITIL service management functions, including Incident, Problem, Change, and Service Request Management.
* Experience building and presenting executive operational dashboards and service reviews.
* Proven track record of driving platform reliability, operational transformation, and automation initiatives.
* Experience managing globally distributed teams and complex enterprise environments.
* Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS or Azure) and Cloud Kubernetes Services.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Deep understanding of Kubernetes architecture, container orchestration, and cloud-native technologies.
* Expertise in Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) administration and operations.
* Experience managing enterprise-scale multi-tenant Kubernetes platforms.
* Strong knowledge of container technologies including Docker and container registries.
* Experience with GitOps practices using ArgoCD and modern CI/CD pipelines.
* Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform and Bicep).
* Strong understanding of cloud networking, including Hub-Spoke architecture, Private Link, Azure Firewall, ingress, and service networking.
* Experience implementing Kubernetes security controls, RBAC, Managed Identities, Azure Policy, and Secrets Management.
* Expertise in observability, monitoring, logging, and performance management using enterprise monitoring platforms.
* Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity Planning
* Vendor and Managed Service Provider Governance.

Key Success Metrics
  
  

* Enterprise CAKS platform consistently achieves availability, performance, and security objectives.
* Increased adoption of centralized AKS services across business units.
* High levels of automation, self-service, and operational maturity.
* Reduced operational overhead and improved platform reliability.
* Leadership receives timely, actionable operational insights and recommendations.
* High-performing teams delivering secure, scalable, and resilient Kubernetes platform services.

**Working with Us**
As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
  
  
Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

title: Regional Head of Services (APAC)
description:
**Who We Are**
Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.
  
  
**The Role**
The Head of Services, APAC owns the commercial performance and operational build-out of Addepar's services organization across the region. This leader is directly accountable for services revenue, SOW pricing, and margin — not just partnering with sales, but personally owning the number. A central part of this mandate is building and scaling the APAC services function itself: hiring, process design, partner delivery frameworks, and an operating model that doesn't yet fully exist in the region today.
  
  
This leader will translate the global services strategy into local execution, ensuring Addepar's standards for implementation, partner solutions, and client support are met. Implementation depth matters — the candidate needs enough technical and data fluency to hold their own in engineering conversations and to understand where recurring feed enhancements and service escalations originate — but it is one input to the role, not the primary qualification.
  
  
As a key leader in a matrixed organization, this role reports directly to the VP, Global Services & Delivery, while maintaining a strategic partnership with regional business leadership. The successful candidate will navigate a collaborative structure where cross-functional alignment is essential, as some regional team members may maintain dual reporting lines to global and regional functional leads.
  
  
Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own the commercial performance of the APAC services business, including revenue, margin, SOW pricing, and utilization. This is a direct P&L responsibility, not a support function to Sales.
* Build and scale the APAC services organization, including hiring, process design, partner delivery framework, and operating model — this function is being built from the ground up in the region, not inherited as a mature machine.
* Serve as the primary leader for the APAC services organization, ensuring alignment with the global GTM strategy defined by the VP, Head of Services.
* Oversee service delivery, including implementation, partner solutions, and technical client support for the APAC client base.
* Resolve recurring client escalations and BAU requirements, implementing local operational models that improve client outcomes and reduce time-to-value.
* Build and mentor a regional team, capable of handling complex, data-intensive implementations and ongoing support requirements.
* Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Engineering, and Global Services, ensuring local client needs (feed enhancements, platform adoption) are integrated into the global roadmap.
* Establish and track KPIs for the APAC region spanning commercial performance, service predictability, efficiency, and customer satisfaction.

**Who You Are**

* You have directly owned a services P&L. You can speak to a specific revenue target, SOW pricing model, or margin number you were personally accountable for — not one you supported from the sales or delivery side.
* You have built or significantly transformed a services function. You've stood up a services org from early stage, or substantially restructured one — not solely operated a mature, pre-existing machine.
* You've been a Head of Professional Services for a region, ideally APAC, with both services sales and services delivery leadership experience.
* Minimum 10+ years of experience in professional services within a high-growth, data-intensive SaaS or fintech environment.
* Proven track record managing distributed teams across distinct APAC sub-regions, with the regional leadership to navigate matrixed, dual-reporting structures.
* Enough implementation and technical fluency to hold your own in conversations about complex, data-intensive onboarding, feed architecture, and platform adoption — without needing to be the team's deepest technical expert.
* Willing and able to personally triage, not exclusively delegate — when a technical or client problem is stuck, you can get into the details enough to unblock it.
* Strong analytical skills with a focus on metrics-driven performance and operational excellence.

**Our Values**

* Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
* Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value.
* Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success.
* Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.
* Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.
  
  
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
  
  
PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar.com.

title: Enterprise Solutions Manager
description:
**The Role:**
11:11 Systems is looking for a dynamic and experienced Enterprise Solutions Manager (ESM) who will lead and manage technical service delivery on large & complex accounts. You will direct the design, implementation, and lifecycle management of 11:11 Systems’ solutions, leading a support team comprised of subject matter experts from multiple platforms, operating systems, storage and network technologies. As a trusted advisor, you will provide strategic business and technology support/counsel to your customer across both their production and recovery environments.
  
  
As ESM, you will be responsible for relationship development and management across key internal and customer stakeholders and executives to help translate their business needs into action.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Document and understand the customer’s current, future / desired state, business goals and challenges, capabilities, and IT investments.
* Based on this understanding provide technical and strategic direction from initial solution design to steady state, based on industry and 11:11 Systems best practices
* Serve as the single point of ownership for technology solutions and coordinate resources globally to optimize customer and 11:11 Systems value.
* Implement and manage effective governance practices and procedures across contracted scope of responsibilities (including change, incident, request, event, problem, and vendor management)
* Develop highly productive customer relationships and become a Trusted Advisor by providing thought leadership to help shape and grow our value to the customer
* Direct lifecycle management (LCM) activities to maintain up to date technical documentation, including production & recovery configurations, application dependency maps, run books and procedures, patching schedules, overall solution architecture document, recovery strategies / plans and contract changes
* Develop recovery strategies to meet customer RTO/RPO and conduct periodic testing to document recoverability
* Manage service / relationship risk areas and takes steps to mitigate.
* Contribute to securing renewals for expiring contracts by documenting and articulating our value to the customer.
* Participate in engineering efforts required to develop new capabilities to meet customer requirements, document results and sample deliverables.
* Identify sales opportunities and collaborate with Account Executives to grow revenue.
* Process customer self-service sales requests when needed.
* Meet/Exceed SLA targets by driving service management disciplines around incident, change, and problem management.
* Develop content and effectively lead Monthly Service Reviews and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and other strategic client meetings requested by the customer.
* Work supportively with colleagues, operating in a manner that is consistent with 11:11’s Code of Business Ethics and Company Values
* Responsibly receive, transmit, and handle company data and information per Company data handling agreements, work procedures and policies
* Review and follow company policies and guidelines, data privacy practices, including annual compliance training certification and policy acknowledgements
* Additional duties as assigned

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
* 10+ years of professional IT experience with at least 3 years of demonstrated experience related to Enterprise focused TAM role, Solution Architecture and Customer facing Service delivery experience within complex environments.
* Technology certifications preferred, such as MCSE, CCIE, RHCE, VCP, CCDP, Cloud etc
* At least one professional certification (eg. ITILv3, TOGAF, PRINCE2 etc.), or equivalent demonstrable skills and experience
* Functional knowledge and experience on following:
* Windows Server
* Virtualization; including VMWare & Hyper-Vs
* Networking; including routing and switching, security, and firewalls
* Storage & backup services/administration
* Database; Understanding of data models and data flows in complex multitier database and application environments.
* Unix/Linux
* BCP & DR scenarios/solutions
* Knowledge of Multi-Tier Application architecture design
* Strong interpersonal skills, customer service skills and communication skills
* Problem-solving skills to be able to resolve technical issues.
* Ability to train customers to use systems and software.
* Must be legally eligible to work without visa sponsorship

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential function satisfactorily. The requirements listed above are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

:

title: Engineering Operations Lead
description:
**Engineering Operations Lead**

**Location:**
Pune/Bengaluru, India (hybrid) |
**Team:**
Engineering |
**Reporting to:**
CTO

**OVERVIEW**

APEXX is an
**independent, enterprise payment orchestration platform.**
Merchants connect to APEXX once and reach the world's payment ecosystem:
**acquirers, alternative payment methods (APMs), Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) providers and network tokenisation.**
Our
**routing engine (AIRE), cascading, Smart Split and Revenue Protect decide in milliseconds where each transaction should go to maximise acceptance and minimise cost.**
We don't own an acquirer, so our only incentive is the merchant's outcome.

We're backed by
**MMC, Forward Partners, Alliance VC & Finch Capital**
and growing with enterprise travel and eCommerce merchants including
**Jet2, TUI, Ryanair, CarTrawler and Hotelbeds.**

We're looking for an
**Engineering Operations Lead**
to strengthen how our Product & Technology team operates, collaborates and delivers.

Working closely with our CTO and Engineering Leadership Team, you'll take ownership of our Atlassian ecosystem, improve delivery governance, release readiness and engineering performance visibility, and use AI, automation and modern development tools to build smarter, more scalable ways of working.

Your initial focus will be transforming Jira and Confluence, establishing effective workflows, reporting and platform governance, before expanding into broader technology operations, engineering productivity and strategic support for the CTO.

This is a hands-on role combining technical expertise, delivery management and operational improvement, ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex problems, building practical solutions and helping engineering teams perform at their best.

**WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING**

**Atlassian Platform & Engineering Operations**

* **Own and transform our Atlassian ecosystem:**
  take responsibility for Jira, Confluence and Jira Service Management, improving configurations, workflows, permissions, integrations and overall platform governance.
* **Standardise engineering workflows:**
  establish consistent, scalable processes across Engineering, Product, Platform and QA, reducing unnecessary complexity while supporting different teams' delivery needs.
* **Build automation and integrations:**
  connect Jira with GitLab, Slack, CI/CD tooling and other systems to improve traceability, data quality and operational efficiency.
* **Maintain secure, reliable platforms:**
  oversee access controls, configuration standards, documentation and audit trails in support of our PCI DSS, SOC 2 and ISO 27001 environment.
* **Drive platform adoption and improvement:**
  troubleshoot issues, simplify legacy configurations and enable teams through documentation, training and self-service capabilities.

**Technology Delivery, Governance & CTO Office**

* **Strengthen delivery governance:**
  establish consistent approaches to planning, tracking, reporting and managing delivery commitments across Product and Technology teams.
* **Improve engineering performance visibility:**
  develop dashboards and reporting covering DORA metrics, cycle time, throughput, sprint predictability, delivery bottlenecks and defect trends.
* **Support release readiness:**
  coordinate visibility into outstanding defects, testing progress, dependencies, operational risks and release milestones, helping teams identify and address issues before deployment.
* **Drive cross-functional delivery:**
  track key initiatives, milestones, dependencies and risks across Engineering, Product, Platform and QA, proactively escalating blockers and supporting resolution.
* **Improve incident and problem management:**
  strengthen incident tracking, escalation, root-cause analysis and follow-through on corrective and preventative actions.
* **Partner with the CTO:**
  translate technology priorities into structured initiatives, coordinate team reviews, maintain visibility into key decisions and commitments, and prepare concise executive & board reporting with storytelling at heart.
* **Champion delivery effectiveness:**
  identify recurring operational challenges, challenge inefficient processes and work with engineering leaders to improve predictability, accountability and execution.

**AI, Automation & Continuous Improvement**

* **Build intelligent automation:**
  develop workflows, integrations and lightweight internal tools using APIs, scripting, automation platforms and AI-assisted development.
* **Develop practical AI solutions:**
  explore and implement AI agents, intelligent reporting, ticket triage, knowledge retrieval and other solutions that improve engineering productivity and operational effectiveness.
* **Improve technology knowledge management:**
  strengthen documentation, knowledge sharing and AI-assisted search across Confluence and other internal platforms.
* **Connect and optimise our technology stack:**
  reduce manual administration, eliminate duplicated processes and improve the flow of information between engineering and operational systems.
* **Champion responsible innovation:**
  evaluate emerging AI and automation capabilities, ensuring solutions are secure, maintainable, appropriately governed and deliver measurable value.

**ABOUT YOU**

* Strong experience in
  **technology operations, technical delivery management, engineering operations or a similar role**
  within a software engineering environment.
* Demonstrable hands-on expertise administering and improving
  **Jira**
  , including workflows, schemes, permissions, automation, dashboards and integrations.
* Good understanding of
  **Agile/Scrum/Kanban, SDLC, engineering delivery processes, release management and delivery governance.**
* Experience coordinating technical initiatives, managing dependencies, identifying delivery risks and improving accountability across engineering teams.
* Familiarity with
  **engineering performance metrics**
  , including DORA, cycle time, throughput, defect trends and delivery predictability.
* Practical experience with
  **AI-assisted development, workflow automation, APIs or scripting**
  to build solutions and improve operational efficiency.
* Comfortable working with
  **Confluence, Jira Service Management, GitHub, Slack and modern engineering tooling.**
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience translating operational data into actionable reporting and recommendations.
* Confident partnering with
  **CTOs, Engineering leaders and senior stakeholders**
  , constructively challenging existing processes and driving cross-functional improvements.
* A proactive, hands-on approach, comfortable balancing platform administration, operational delivery and longer-term improvement initiatives.
* Excellent communication and organisational skills, with experience working across distributed, cross-functional teams.

**NICE TO HAVE**

* Experience working within a
  **CTO Office, Engineering Operations or Technical Programme Management**
  function.
* Atlassian certifications or experience with
  **Jira Cloud, REST APIs, ScriptRunner, Forge or Rovo.**
* Experience with
  **Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, SQL, n8n or similar automation tools.**
* Experience developing
  **AI-powered internal tools, LLM integrations or agentic workflows.**
* Experience with
  **engineering analytics, release governance, incident management or IT service management.**
* Experience in a
  **FinTech, SaaS or scale-up environment**
  , ideally with exposure to PCI DSS, SOC 2 or ISO 27001.

**HOW WE HIRE**

**Three conversations:**

* a talent screen,
* a conversation with the hiring manager, and
* a practical technology operations, delivery and automation discussion.

The practical session will explore how you approach real-world challenges - improving Jira workflows, establishing delivery governance, interpreting engineering performance metrics and using AI or automation to solve operational problems.

You're welcome to use AI tools where appropriate. We're interested in how you think, validate and make decisions.

Once a decision is made, every candidate receives written feed-forward from the panel. Tell us about any adjustments you need and we'll make them.

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**

* **Competitive compensation:**
  that recognises your skills, experience and impact.
* **Generous time off:**
  annual leave, public holidays and wellbeing-focused time away from work.
* **Work From Anywhere:**
  up to 90 days a year from eligible locations, subject to our policy.
* **Comprehensive health insurance:**
  for you and your loved ones.
* **Personal accident insurance:**
  for when it's needed most.
* **Enhanced family leave:**
  enhanced parental and family-friendly leave policies.
* **Learning & growth:**
  opportunities to learn, grow and build a meaningful career at APEXX.

**WHO WE ARE & WHERE WE ARE**

APEXX is a global payment orchestration platform with teams in the UK and India. For more than a decade we've helped enterprise businesses simplify payments through a single, scalable integration, with access to
**200+ acquirers, 150+ alternative payment methods and 10+ BNPL providers.**
We're trusted by leading global brands including Ryanair, TUI, Hotelbeds, CarTrawler, Avon and Jet2.

APEXX is an equal opportunities employer committed to equality, diversity and inclusion.

We do not accept speculative CVs or candidate profiles from recruitment agencies.

The Expert supports the outsourced procurement and cost management function by executing cost planning, tendering, and contract administration with high accuracy and process discipline. Working closely with the Senior Manager and the AVP, the Expert drives data accuracy, supports continuous improvement, and helps align delivery with Chain IQ’s global procurement practices. * Establish standard processes for travel requests, approvals, bookings, cancellations, and reimbursements.
* Monitor policy adherence and identify areas for improvement.

**3.Vendor Management**

* Identify, onboard, and manage travel agencies, airlines, hotels, cab operators, visa consultants, and other travel partners.
* Negotiate competitive rates, corporate deals, contracts, and service-level agreements.
* Regularly evaluate vendor performance, service quality, responsiveness, and pricing.
* Build strong relationships with key travel partners.
* Resolve vendor-related escalations and service issues.

**4.Cost Management & Optimization**

* Drive cost optimization across flights, hotels, transportation, and other travel expenses.
* Negotiate corporate rates and preferential pricing with travel vendors.
* Monitor travel spends and prepare periodic MIS and cost reports.
* Identify opportunities to reduce unnecessary travel expenses without compromising business requirements.
* Track budget versus actual travel expenditure.

**5.Leadership & Executive Travel**

* Manage travel requirements for founders, senior management, and leadership teams.
* Handle confidential and high-priority travel arrangements with accuracy and discretion.
* Coordinate complex itineraries involving multiple destinations and tight schedules.
* Ensure premium travel requirements are managed seamlessly.

**6.Visa & International Travel**

* Manage visa documentation and coordination for international business travel.
* Coordinate with visa consultants, embassies, and relevant agencies wherever required.
* Ensure employees have all necessary travel documents before departure.
* Track visa validity, passport requirements, travel insurance, and other documentation.

**7.Employee Travel Support**

* Act as the primary point of contact for employee travel-related queries and escalations.
* Ensure timely resolution of booking, cancellation, rescheduling, hotel, cab, and other travel issues.
* Provide travel support during emergencies or unexpected changes.
* Ensure employees receive clear and timely communication regarding their travel arrangements.

**8.Travel Technology & Systems**

* Evaluate and implement travel management platforms/tools wherever required.
* Improve automation of travel requests, approvals, bookings, and reporting.
* Maintain accurate employee travel records and vendor databases.
* Use data and analytics to monitor travel trends and identify cost-saving opportunities.



**9.Compliance & Documentation**

* Ensure proper documentation and compliance related to corporate travel.
* Maintain contracts, vendor agreements, invoices, travel records, and other relevant documentation.
* Coordinate with Finance and HR teams for travel expense reconciliation and reimbursements.
* Ensure timely verification and processing of travel invoices.

**10.Team Management**

* Lead and mentor the travel/admin team.
* Allocate responsibilities and ensure timely execution of travel requirements.
* Set performance standards and monitor team productivity.
* Build a responsive and service-oriented travel support function.

**Required Skills**

* Strong knowledge of corporate travel management.
* Excellent knowledge of domestic and international travel processes.
* Strong vendor negotiation and relationship management skills.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong cost-management and analytical skills.
* Ability to handle multiple priorities and urgent requirements.
* Strong problem-solving and crisis-management skills.
* Good knowledge of travel policies, booking systems, and travel documentation.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and travel management systems/tools.

title: Head of Core Client Reporting, AB India
description:
**Company Description**
As a leading global investment management firm, AB fosters diverse perspectives and embraces innovation to help our clients navigate the uncertainty of capital markets. Through high-quality research and diversified investment services, we serve institutions, individuals and private wealth clients in major markets worldwide. Our ambition is simple: to be our clients’ most valued asset-management partner.
  
  
With over 4,400 employees across 51 locations in 25 countries, our people are our advantage. We foster a culture of intellectual curiosity and collaboration to create an environment where everyone can thrive and do their best work. Whether you're producing thought-provoking research, identifying compelling investment opportunities, infusing new technologies into our business or providing thoughtful advice to clients, we’re looking for unique voices to help lead us forward. If you’re ready to challenge your limits and build your future, join us.
  
  
**Ops Group Description**
The Institutional Client Reporting Team is responsible for the production of monthly, quarterly, annual and ad-hoc accounting and investment reports for institutional clients. These reports cover the full range of the firm’s investment capabilities, including Fixed Income, Equity, Index / Enhanced, as well as Alternative Investments, Blend, Multi-Asset strategies, with an expanding range of derivative content.
  
  
There are extensive interactions and exposure to many functions of the AB business, notably Client Relationship Management, the Portfolio Management Team, Global Product Development team along with Operations and Information Technology.
  
  
In addition to the production support, the team also works on projects related to new report development and automation.
  
  
**Ops Job Description**
We are seeking a Vice President, Head of Core Client Reporting, AB India, to lead the Core Client Reporting team within the Institutional Investment Management Operations Team located in Pune, India. This role will provide strategic, operational, and people leadership for a critical reporting function that supports institutional client outcomes, strengthens control discipline, and enables scalable delivery across global stakeholders. The successful candidate will be expected to operate as a senior leader who executes against functional priorities, drives commercial and client-focused impact, develops talent, influences reporting strategy, and reinforces AB’s inclusive culture. People of color, women, and LGBTQ people are encouraged to apply. AB does not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, ancestry, national origin, sex, age, disability, marital status, citizenship status, sexual orientation. Gender identity, military or veteran status or any other basis that is prohibited by applicable law. AB’s policies, as well as practices, seek to ensure that employment opportunities are available to all employees and applicants, based solely on job-related criteria.
  
  
**Describe The Role**
The Head of Core Client Reporting is a senior leadership role responsible for the day-to-day and strategic management of AB India’s Core Client Reporting function. The role requires strong knowledge of institutional client reporting, investment operations, data governance, performance and portfolio reporting concepts, risk management, and operational controls. The leader will oversee multiple reporting workstreams, manage escalations, partner with global stakeholders, and drive continuous improvement across process, technology, training, quality assurance, and operating model design.
  
  
**Describe the applications and business or enterprise functions the role supports:**
This role supports global Institutional Client Reporting and related Investment Management Operations functions, including report production, data validation, exception management, controls, workflow oversight, stakeholder service, and reporting platform improvement. The role will partner closely with onshore and offshore reporting teams, portfolio management support functions, client service, technology, data teams, compliance, risk, and other operations partners to ensure a consistent, scalable, and controlled client reporting environment.
  
  
**The key job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:**

* Lead the AB Core Client Reporting team, including oversight of daily, monthly, quarterly, and ad hoc reporting deliverables, quality controls, issue resolution, and service-level performance.
* Become Subject Matter Expert in Client Reporting and have ability to make real time and time critical decisions on reporting issues.
* Execute against agreed functional priorities and hold team members accountable for timely, accurate, and controlled delivery of client reporting outputs.
* Oversee strategic direction for reporting production, workflow management, exception handling, and control routines to ensure client satisfaction and operational resiliency.
* Represent Client Reporting/Global Operations in setting agenda for conversion of existing functionality from internal systems over to new SimCorp driven processes.
* Partner with global reporting leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to identify market practices, address reporting gaps, manage escalations, and implement scalable reporting solutions.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives focused on standardization, automation, data quality, process simplification, control strengthening, and reduction of operational risk.
* Develop and maintain strong working relationships with internal clients, including client service, portfolio management support, technology, compliance, risk, and global operations partners.
* Chair meetings of the Global Client Reporting Steering Committee to prioritize enhancements, changes, and updates to the reports and infrastructure.
* Provide leadership oversight for escalated reporting issues, ensuring appropriate root-cause analysis, remediation, stakeholder communication, and prevention of recurrence.
* Establish and maintain documentation, procedure guides, training materials, quality-control frameworks, and evidence-based oversight routines for the team.
* Recruit, manage, motivate, coach, and develop staff to maximize individual contributions, professional growth, collaboration, and effective teamwork.
* Set leadership direction for functional training, cross-training, succession planning, and knowledge management across Core Client Reporting.
* Actively identify opportunities to control or reduce firm costs through improved operating model design, capacity management, automation, and efficient use of resources.
* Influence reporting strategy by bringing forward innovative ideas, anticipating downstream impacts, and aligning team priorities with broader SBU and firm objectives.
* Promote an inclusive, respectful, and high-accountability culture that encourages collaboration, constructive challenge, and continuous learning.

**What makes this role unique or interesting (if applicable)?**
This role offers the opportunity to lead a critical client-facing operations capability from India while partnering with global stakeholders across the institutional investment management platform. The successful candidate will shape how Core Client Reporting scales, modernizes, and strengthens control discipline. The role combines people leadership, operational execution, client service orientation, data and technology partnership, and strategic influence, making it an important leadership position for both local team development and global reporting effectiveness.
  
  
**What is the professional development value of this role, i.e. what learning and professional growth does the role offer the candidate?**
The role provides significant professional development through exposure to senior global stakeholders, complex institutional reporting requirements, reporting platform evolution, operational risk management, and enterprise-wide process improvement. The candidate will build deeper leadership capability in strategy execution, stakeholder management, talent development, controls, automation, data governance, and client outcome management.
  
  
**Job Qualifications (The Ideal Candidate Should Have The Following)**

* Performance Leadership: Drives execution of core reporting responsibilities, prioritizes high-impact initiatives, demonstrates resilience through operational challenges, and holds the team accountable for timely, accurate, and controlled delivery.
* Commercial Leadership: Creates positive internal and external client outcomes by improving reporting quality, strengthening stakeholder confidence, reducing operational friction, and identifying opportunities to lower cost and mitigate risk.
* People Leadership: Grows talent through coaching, performance management, training, feedback, and active participation in recruitment, development, change management, and team engagement activities.
* Thought Leadership: Influences reporting strategy through expertise, innovation, process improvement, automation opportunities, and an understanding of how local decisions impact the broader firm.
* Cultural Leadership: Sets the standard for respect, inclusion, accountability, collaboration, and recognition of behaviors that reflect AB’s values.

**Qualifications, Experience, Education**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience required; business, finance, accounting, economics, or related discipline preferred.
* Approximately 10+ years of relevant experience in investment operations, institutional client reporting, performance reporting, portfolio reporting, data operations, or a related financial services function.
* Demonstrated people management experience, ideally including leadership of multiple workstreams or teams in a global operating model.
* Strong understanding of institutional client reporting lifecycles, data dependencies, quality-control routines, operational risk, and service-level management.
* Experience leading process improvement, automation, workflow redesign, or operating model initiatives.
* Experience managing stakeholder relationships across regions, functions, and seniority levels.
* Exposure to investment data, portfolio holdings, transactions, performance, benchmarks, client deliverables, or related reporting concepts preferred.
* Working knowledge of SQL or data-querying tools preferred, with the ability to partner effectively with technology and data teams to investigate data issues, improve reporting controls, and support scalable reporting solutions.

**Skills**

* Strong leadership, coaching, performance management, and team development skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate clearly with senior stakeholders and global partners.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, prioritization, and decision-making skills.
* Exceptional attention to detail with a control-oriented mindset.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, escalations, and transformation initiatives simultaneously.
* Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel and PowerPoint; familiarity with workflow, reporting, data visualization, or automation tools preferred.
* Knowledge to query, analyze, and validate data using SQL or comparable tools preferred.
* Ability to influence without direct authority and build strong partnerships across business, operations, technology, compliance, and risk teams.
* High level of professionalism, sound judgment, ownership, and resilience.

**Special Knowledge (if Applicable)**

* Data quality, workflow management, reporting platforms.
* Experience with SimCorp Coric or Vermilion reporting products preferred.

**170+ Years Strong. Industry Leader. Global Impact.**
At Pinkerton, the mission is to protect our clients. To do this, we provide enterprise risk management services and programs specifically designed for each client. Pinkerton employees are one of our most important assets and critical to the delivery of world-class solutions. Bonded together, we share a commitment to integrity, vigilance, and excellence.
  
  
Pinkerton is an inclusive employer who seeks candidates with diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives to join our network of industry subject matter experts.
  
  
The Assignment Manager will drive the development and standardization of security policies and programs for safeguarding corporate business operations.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Represent Pinkerton’s core values of integrity, vigilance, and excellence.
* Ensure implemented country policies and procedures are followed at all levels within the security team on site.
* Guarantee all security and safety equipment identified issues are reported on timely basis for immediate corrective actions as per SLA.
* Nurture relationships with other local, state, and central agencies to include police and fire brigade.
* Stay involved in networking and hands-on industry intelligence.
* Communicate and coordinate with all stakeholder involved in the corporate operations.
* Manage the maintenance of electrical security equipment such as CCTV, access control, visitor management system, fire extinguisher, and others.
* Process Invoices and payment follow-ups with stakeholders.
* Call out the emergency services, as requested
* Manage the coordination with security vendors partners.
* Organize and conduct monthly security training sessions to deployed security staff.
* Prepare and share monthly management reports.
* Ensure the night escorting process is being followed as per the client's SOPs.
* Provide support during the executive protection duties and internal and external events.
* All other duties, as assigned.

**Qualifications**
Bachelor’s degree with at least six years of similar experience within a supervisory role.
  
  

* Able to deliver security awareness training programs.
* Maintain confidentiality when dealing with sensitive information.
* Able to carry out responsibilities with little supervision.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Effective interpersonal and follow-up skills.
* Serve as a positive team leader.
* Attentive to detail and accuracy.
* Computer skills; Microsoft Office.

**Working Conditions**
With or without reasonable accommodation, requires the physical and mental capacity to effectively perform all essential functions;
  
  

* Regular computer usage.
* Occasional reaching and lifting of small objects and operating office equipment.
* Frequent sitting, standing, and/or walking.
* Travel, as required.

Pinkerton is an equal opportunity employer to all applicants and positions without regard to race/ethnicity, color, national origin, ancestry, sex/gender, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, marital/prenatal status, pregnancy/childbirth or related conditions, religion, creed, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any protected status by local, state, federal or country-specific law.
