title: Head of Product Business Unit
description:
**About Us**
**HEAD OF PRODUCT BUSINESS UNIT**
Anchanto | Pune, India | Reports to the Chief Executive Officer | Unit of 12 to 45 people
  
  
**About Anchanto**
Anchanto is an e-commerce and supply chain technology company headquartered in Singapore, with offices in twelve countries across Asia Pacific, the Middle East and Europe and its largest engineering center in Pune. Brands, retailers and logistics service providers use our purpose built SaaS products to run and scale their e-commerce and omnichannel operations: Order Management, Warehouse Management, Anchanto Grid with more than 200 ready integrations to marketplaces, carriers and enterprise systems, Parcel Tracking, Control Tower and Operations Experience, with Vantage AI as the data and insights layer across all of them. Our AI enabled agentic services, launching soon, help customers run their commerce operations with less manual work and faster decisions. More than 360 enterprise customers, including L'OrÃ©al, Panasonic, EstÃ©e Lauder, DKSH, Toll and Bosch, process over 200 million orders a year through Anchanto across more than 700 warehouses. Anchanto is an Asendia portfolio company.
  
  
**THE ROLE**
A Product Business Unit (PBU) is Product Management and Engineering for one product, brought together as a single threaded organization with one head, one backlog and one set of priorities. The head owns the product's market position, strategy, roadmap, engineering, quality, reliability and business results, and leads the engineers who build it. This is how the leading software companies are organized today: Amazon's single threaded leaders and two pizza teams, the autonomous product units at Spotify and Atlassian, the product clouds at Salesforce and Adobe each run as a business. It removes the handoffs, competing priorities and diffused accountability of separate product and engineering functions, and puts one leader in charge who decides and answers for the result.
  
  
This is not a pure product management role. You lead the engineering team as well as the product team, you own the technical quality of what ships, and you are measured on outcomes, not activities. It is the role of building a product business that leads its category: you set where the product goes, build it with your own engineering team, put it in front of the market with the revenue teams, and answer for what it earns and how customers experience it.
  
  
**WHAT YOU OWN: PRODUCT STRATEGY, ROADMAP, ENGINEERING, DECISIONS AND RESULTS**

* Product strategy. You know your market and competitors better than anyone in the company, set the product strategy and the positioning ambition with the industry research leaders, keep the product's gaps against the Gartner, Forrester and IDC criteria on your roadmap with dates, and give the CROs your input on pricing and packaging.
* Roadmap and priorities. One backlog covering the roadmap, customer commitments, innovation and tech debt, with the trade offs made by you within the portfolio allocation the CEO sets. Customer priorities and asks come to you from the Delivery team, your internal customer; you deliver against them and do not overwrite them.
* Decisions. What gets built, in what order and how; technical design within the architecture and security standards the CTO sets; release decisions; and whether your product can meet a scope and a date. No scope or date is committed on your product without your confirmation, and once committed you deliver it.
* The way we build. Specs based, AI assisted engineering is the standard way of working in every unit. You own the spec standard for your product and the readiness gate that stops work starting before decisions, credentials and test windows are in place. Quality is owned by the people who build.
* Results. Product P&L, growth, margin and contribution; reliability, incident response and customer satisfaction for your product; and the people: unit structure, hiring, promotions and a standing innovation and AI sub pod that explores adjacent capabilities.
* Ecosystem. Alignment with the other PBUs on the shared roadmap, the blueprint and joint commitments, and working in step with Product Marketing.

**COMMERCIAL INVOLVEMENT**
This is not a sales role and carries no quota. The CROs set market priorities, the go to market and what and how your product is sold; the revenue teams (existing customers, Global Strategic Accounts, Key Account Management) own the customer connect. You help them sell: you step into strategic, complex or at risk deals when asked, and you are the final word on what your product can commit to and when. You do not override or bypass them to reach customers directly.
  
  
**How You Manage Your People**

* Every person in the unit has written objectives and two or three KPIs for the quarter, reviewed monthly; nobody is without them thirty days after joining.
* Feedback is direct, factual and given within the week, in writing when it matters.
* You represent the company to your team, not the team to the company. Management debt, wrong decisions, undelivered feedback and unaddressed interpersonal issues, is fixed within thirty days of knowing about it.
* Performance is measured against objectives, not effort or tenure. An underperformer gets a written plan and a date; if it passes you take the decision yourself, including exit. Interns are confirmed and people are promoted only after a documented assessment and a direct conversation.
* The unit reports in numbers, weekly in writing and monthly in the outcome review.
* You talk to your N-1, your N-2 and every individual contributor, with skip level one to ones at least quarterly; you do the final interview of every person joining the unit; and the unit runs on a written meeting cadence you publish in your first thirty days and keep.

**OWNING CUSTOMER ESCALATIONS**
An escalation on your product is yours from the moment it is raised until the customer confirms it is closed. You do not trivialize it, and you do not expect the CEO or the CROs to lead it. You own the fix and the communication: first written update within the hour, a fixed written cadence until closed, root cause and corrective action within five working days after. You put proactive monitoring in place so the unit knows before the customer does.
  
  
**Who Decides What**

* Decision: Roadmap, prioritization, trade offs, what gets built and how, technical design within architecture guardrails, release decisions within standards.

Decides: You
  
  

* Decision: Whether your product can meet a scope and a date; unit structure, hiring and promotions within policy; spend within the approved budget.

Decides: You
  
  

* Decision: Customer priority, customer asks, revenue delivery and the external customer commitment and timeline.

Decides: Delivery, with your confirmation on scope and date
  
  

* Decision: Pricing and packaging; market priorities; go to market; what and how your product is sold; customer connect.

Decides: CROs and revenue teams, with your input on pricing
  
  

* Decision: Portfolio allocation, the blueprint, headcount and total investment, cross PBU priority collisions.

Decides: CEO
  
  

* Decision: Technology standards, security and compliance, architecture guardrails, CICD, infrastructure, data and AI platform.

Decides: CTO
  
  
**How You Are Measured**
You own outcomes, not activities. Story points, releases and features shipped are not on this scorecard. You are judged on the outputs below, and you run the unit on five to eight controllable input metrics that you propose, prove move the outputs, and review every week. Numbers are baselined in your first month and verified by Finance.
  
  

* Product led revenue enablement

What we look at: Adoption and usage depth of the modules we sell, share of customers on the current version, deals unblocked or lost on product capability, referenceable customers, time to go live
  
  

* Retention and unit margin

What we look at: Net revenue retention for your product, churn and its reasons, and the unit's contribution margin after people, infrastructure and delivery cost
  
  

* Reliability and customer satisfaction

What we look at: Availability, incidents and time to resolve, escaped defects, escalations by count, root cause and time to close, NPS or CSAT, and whether the unit found the problem before the customer did
  
  

* Planned versus actual

What we look at: Execution against the quarterly plan and the annual plan: objectives met, committed deliveries on date, say to do ratio, and variances explained in writing
  
  

* Market position

What we look at: Where the product stands against the Forrester Wave, Gartner Magic Quadrant and IDC MarketScape criteria for its category, gaps closed each quarter, and analyst recognition over time
  
  

* AI leverage and AI first approach

What we look at: Share of work built specs based and AI assisted, automation percentage by activity, cost and cycle time per delivered item falling every quarter, new work designed AI first
  
  

* Team EPS and health

What we look at: Team EPS score, attrition and regretted attrition, skills coverage, and whether the unit runs without you in the room
  
  
**PLANNING AND CADENCE**
You write the multi year product plan, the annual plan each October as a six page narrative with targets and resource scenarios, and, four weeks before each quarter, a ninety day plan derived from both, presented to and aligned with the leadership team; execution is measured against it. Weekly unit review on the inputs in writing, monthly outcome review with the CEO, quarterly review on the two or three CEO goals for your unit.
  
  
**Skills And Prior Experience**
Must haves for every candidate. Candidates without all of these will not be shortlisted.
  
  

* At least fifteen years of industry experience, with at least five of them running a product, product line, business unit or operation with accountability for its results.
* Global experience. Has worked in, and built or run operations outside India, with customers or teams in more than one country. India only experience does not qualify.
* Education. Engineering from IIT or NIT, or an MBA from IIM or a top ranked global business school.
* Domain. Commerce, logistics, supply chain or marketplace software, or the operations they serve, with enterprise customers.
* Decides and manages directly. Makes the call quickly, takes the trade off and answers for the outcome. Has set objectives for every person, given hard feedback in time, taken exit decisions personally and owned the communication in a customer crisis. Comfortable making AI assisted, specs driven engineering the default way of working.

Career paths we are open to. The role needs product, technology and business skills together; nobody arrives with all three at the same depth, so we hire from four paths and test for the second skill in each.
  
  

* Technology leader with product skills. Director of Engineering, CTO, CIO or equivalent, with deep experience in building, releasing and commercializing software systems, who has also owned a roadmap, met the market and made product trade offs, not only delivered what product handed over.
* Product management leader with technology depth. Head of Product Management or commercial product management in B2B SaaS, with technology skills to a good extent: has led or closely directed engineering teams, can hold an architecture review, and has shipped and commercialized what they defined.
* Operations practitioner from a large 3PL, retailer or brand. Has run e-commerce, fulfilment or supply chain operations as a business at scale, with deep domain knowledge of how the work is actually done, and has specified, bought or built the systems behind it well enough to direct a product team.
* Consultant or transformation leader. Head of consulting, transformation or a consulting practice in commerce or supply chain, with deep consulting and domain expertise, who has delivered systems and operating models for clients end to end rather than advised from the side.

In every path the second skill must be shown with specific examples. This role is not a Head of Engineering with a product manager reporting in, a delivery manager promoted up, a product leader who hands execution to someone else, a second sales channel to the customer, or a union leader for the team. Compensation: fixed salary, variable pay tied to the scorecard, and long term incentives; details shared with shortlisted candidates.
  
  
**Benefits**

* Global Exposure: Work with diverse teams, customers and stakeholders across international markets and gain experience in a global B2B SaaS environment.
* Learning & Development: We invest in our people through sponsored learning, certifications and development opportunities aligned with your professional growth.
* International & Onsite Opportunities: Client-facing roles may offer opportunities to travel and work onsite with customers across our global markets.
* Medical Insurance: Comprehensive medical insurance coverage to support to you and your family health and well-being.
* Comprehensive Leave Benefits: Maternity, Paternity, Marriage and Bereavement leave, along with Comp Off and flexibility to support important personal commitments.
* Recognition for Long-Term Contribution: Tenured employees are eligible for additional monetary benefits, extra paid leave and company-sponsored paid vacations as part of our commitment to recognising long-term contribution.
* Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: A supportive and flexible work environment that enables employees to manage professional responsibilities alongside personal priorities.
* Meaningful Career Growth: Take ownership of challenging, high-impact work and contribute to products and solutions that serve global brands, retailers and logistics businesses.

title: Head of Solutions & Delivery
description:
**About the Company**

Fineshift is a founder-led technology services company helping enterprise customers solve complex engineering challenges across
**DevSecOps, Monitoring & Observability, and AI**
.

As an independent, bootstrapped company, we prioritise customer outcomes, delivery accountability, and fast decision-making. We are authorised partners of GitLab, IBM, JFrog, Snyk, and AWS, working with large enterprises across banking, financial services, and manufacturing.

We are at a stage where the leaders we hire will shape our next phase of growth. This is an opportunity to build and scale a technology practice, not simply inherit one.

**About the Role**

This is the senior technology leadership position in the company, reporting directly to the CEO.

You own what we propose to our customers and what we deliver to them. That means owning the technical solution end to end — understanding the requirement, designing the approach, preparing the proposal, defending it in front of the customer, and then standing behind it when it goes into delivery.

It also means owning the commercial outcome of the technology business and deciding how the technology organisation should be structured as it grows. You will have the mandate to shape the team, the practices, and the technical standards we hold ourselves to.

We are looking for someone who wants that level of ownership, not someone who wants a defined scope.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own technical solutioning for customer requirements across all three service lines, from discovery and requirement analysis through to the final solution.
* Prepare the technical proposal in line with the solution — architecture, approach, effort estimate, assumptions, and risks.
* Review and approve any technical proposal prepared by others before it reaches a customer.
* Present and defend the solution to the customer — solution walkthroughs, demonstrations, architecture discussions, and workshops.
* Act as the senior technical presence in customer conversations, including steering meetings, quarterly reviews, and escalation discussions.
* Own customer escalations end to end, including containment, resolution, and written root cause analysis.
* Define the right structure for the technology organisation — how solutioning, delivery, and support are organised — and evolve it as the business grows.
* Set technical direction for each service line and define the standard engagements are delivered to.
* Build and mentor the technical team, including senior technical staff responsible for solution design, estimation, and customer communication.
* Grow existing accounts through upsell and cross-sell, and grow the number of engineers deployed at customer sites.
* Own the technology P&L — margin per engagement, revenue per deployed engineer, and cost of unassigned capacity.

**Must Have**

* 12+ years in technology, including at least 3 years leading a delivery or solutions practice in an IT services or systems-integration company.
* Deep expertise in one of DevSecOps, Monitoring & Observability, or AI, with working credibility in the other two.
* Strong hands-on solution design and estimation ability — able to architect an engagement and size it accurately before it is sold.
* Strong understanding of CI/CD, release management, containers and Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, and cloud platforms (AWS/Azure).
* Working knowledge of observability tooling — IBM Instana, Prometheus, Grafana, Nagios, or Icinga — along with incident management and root cause analysis.
* Familiarity with AI engagement patterns — LLM and agent applications, RAG, on-premise versus cloud trade-offs — enough to scope an engagement without a specialist in the room.
* Experience carrying a P&L or a practice margin number, not only a delivery target.
* Experience building and leading a technical team across multiple concurrent customer engagements.
* Ability to hold a technical discussion with a CIO or customer architect directly, and to handle escalations without escalating them further.

**Good to Have**

* Experience in a partner or reseller model, working alongside product vendors.
* Enterprise customers in banking, financial services, or manufacturing in India.
* Experience growing a technical practice from a small team into a larger one.
* Exposure to presales in a services environment — RFP responses, solution defence, and competitive positioning.

Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

Manager, Operational Risk & Controls - Europe
  
  
Manager, Operational Risk & Controls - Europe

**Overview**
The Manager, Operational Risk & Controls– Europe strengthens Mastercard Europe’s (MCE) risk posture by providing independent 2LoD oversight and challenge across high operational risk processes spanning both technology and non-technology domains. The role drives consistent application of the ORC framework (risk identification & assessment, control identification & evaluation, and ongoing management & monitoring), and supports MCE’s regulatory obligations (i.e. SIPS, PISA, CROE).
  
  
Role
  
  
**Scope**

* Regional coverage: Mastercard Europe S.A. (MCE)
* Risk domains: Operational (incl. tech, process, people), legal & regulatory, third-party/outsourcing interfaces, and other topics relevant to European supervision.
* Regulatory context: Role contributes to ongoing readiness against regulatory expectations to comply with SIPS, PISA and CROE requirements, supporting alignment with supervisory themes (e.g., cyber/operational resilience expectations).
* Key relationships: ORC (Operational Risk and Controls) Global Function, 1LoD business and technology owners; 1LoD and 2LoD Tech Risk and Corporate Security; TPRM; Finance/Controllership; Regulatory Affairs; Internal Audit; MCE risk governance committees (TRC/BRCC/Board Risk Committee).

**Key Responsibilities**
Framework execution & oversight
  
  

* Champion application of the ORC Framework’s three pillars (Operational Risk Identification & Assessment; Controls Identification & Evaluation; Risk & Controls Management and Monitoring) across Europe; provide independent oversight, challenge, and guidance to 1LoD.
* Facilitate/oversee RCSAs (Risk and Control Self Assessments) and risk & control register for high operational risk processes (HORPs); ensure risks, controls, issues, risk events and treatments are captured and maintained to ORC standards.
* Review control designs, effectiveness assessment and control testing results; escalate significant control gaps and delays, and track remediation through closure.
* Support the maintenance of a Europe tech and non-tech control framework including control testing, in partnership with Group ORC and first line teams, including tech risk management and Corporate Security functions, that meet EU regulatory expectations

Technology & non-technology coverage
  
  

* Provide 2LoD oversight across technology risk and control domains (e.g., change management, availability, security, access, data) and nontech operational risks (e.g., process, people, financial operations), ensuring consistent control expectations across domains.

Regulatory enablement & external expectations
  
  

* Produce ORC content to European Risk Governance packs (TRC/BRCC/ Board)
* Provide support as needed in regulator interactions on topics related to Operational Risk and Controls.
* Support MCE’s efforts to address CROE-related remediation actions by assessing whether security and technology control gaps are adequately identified, prioritized, and remediated in line with supervisory expectations.

Risk events, issues & insights
  
  

* Review high/very high rated risk events for accurate rating, high-quality root cause analysis, and adequacy of remediation.
* Produce clear Management Reporting for governance forums; identify trends and emerging risks to inform priorities and controls evolution.
* Monitor issue/treatment plan milestones and challenge closure evidence for sufficiency and durability.

Ways of working & tooling
  
  

* Oversee completeness of operational risk data (e.g., OpenPages entries, risk registers, control assessments, remediation evidence).
* Ensure documentation meets regulatory, audit, and Europe governance expectations — including CROE aligned evidence standards.

**All About You**
Experience: 6-8 years in operational risk, internal controls, or assurance in financial services/payments; proven work across both technology and business/non tech processes.
  
  
Risk Management practices and frameworks: Strong working knowledge of ORC/ERM policy constructs (RCSA, risk & control registers, control evaluation & testing, issues/incidents/loss events, risk appetite).
  
  
Regulatory familiarity: Practical understanding of EU regulator expectations with ability to translate requirements into control objectives and testing criteria.
  
  
Skills: Analytical judgment; ability to challenge constructively; crisp writing for senior audiences; stakeholder management in a matrix.
  
  
Tools: Experience with risk GRC-applications (e.g., OpenPages, Archer)
  
  
Languages: Fluent English
  
  
Education/Certifications: Bachelor’s degree required; relevant certifications (e.g., CRISC, CISA, CIA) welcome.
  
  
**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Team Lead, ADM Ops
description:
**Who We Are**
Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.
  
  
**The Role**
Addepar's Private Fund Look-Through (PFLT) offering gives clients deep visibility into the underlying holdings of their private fund investments by extracting holding-level data directly from GP financial statements—primarily the Schedule of Investments (SOI). This white-glove solution combines proprietary AI/ML extraction technology with human-in-the-loop review to ensure maximum accuracy and full portfolio transparency.
  
  
As part of the broader Addepar Data organization, the
**PFLT Data Operations Team Lead**
is responsible for managing a team of Analysts and Senior Analysts focused on reviewing, validating, and enriching complex fund holding data within target SLAs. This role acts as a domain subject matter expert, overseeing exception resolution, pipeline monitoring (Databricks, Retool, Monday.com), and data entity mapping. You will play a pivotal role in driving team performance metrics, leading ML model retraining initiatives, and collaborating across Product, Engineering, ML Operations, and Client Success teams.
  
  
Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Lead and manage a team of PFLT Analysts & Senior Analysts, driving effective work allocation, daily queue management (Monday.com), and SLA compliance across peak quarter-end processing periods.
* Track and drive key team performance metrics, including SLA compliance, processing accuracy, and throughput.
* Support operational workflows, playbooks, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for private fund Look-through processing.
* Identify opportunities for process optimization, standardization, and automation across the pipeline.
* Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) supporting the team on complex Schedule of Investments (SOI) processing, special asset classes (e.g., crypto/token assets, real estate), and intricate fund accounting mechanics (e.g., PQ reconciliation, derived metric calculations, corporate actions).
* Guide and oversee the team in troubleshooting complex extraction errors across pipeline stages and front-end verification checks.
* Perform quality control reviews and high-level audits to assist the team in correcting improperly extracted or mapped holdings data.
* Serve as the primary escalation point for data quality discrepancies, pipeline failures, and complex mapping issues (SOAP UI, GSM Search, PitchBook).
* Partner with Product, Engineering, and AIP teams to enhance operational efficiency by identifying extraction errors, curating edge-case datasets for AI model retraining, and refining pipeline tooling and UI (Retool/Databricks).
* Engage directly with clients, GPs, and Fund Administrators to resolve technical data inquiries, document discrepancies, and reporting edge cases.

**Who You Are**

* Minimum 5+ years of experience in a relevant role and domain
* Minimum 2+ years of people Team leader experience
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, Commerce, Economics, or a related field
* Experience in Private equity / Alternatives investment process
* Experience in the financial investment/advisory industry with strong knowledge of capital markets, middle/back-office operations systems, and preferably with experience dealing with Alternatives (Private/Draw-down) Funds reporting statements and data
* Track record of demonstrating excellent attention to detail, effective problem-solving skills, and an ability to thrive in a fast paced environment
* Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills for engaging clients, data providers, and internal stakeholders across Sales, Services, and R&D
* Highly self-motivated to take on responsibility, forward thinking and pragmatic, and possess a collaborative team-player mentality
* Technical skills preferred in any or all of the following: Microsoft Excel, Google Suite, Atlassian Jira/Confluence, SQL, Salesforce, or other common financial services systems and applications
* Willing to work in overlapping US/EMEA shifts or flexible hours to align with global stakeholders

**Our Values**

* Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
* Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value.
* Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success.
* Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.
* Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.
  
  
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
  
  
PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar.com.

title: Crewing Manager (Ship Management)
description:
**1. Job Purpose**

To ensure effective and compliant management of seafarers assigned to the designated tanker fleet, maintaining high standards of crew competence, safety, operational readiness, and service delivery in accordance with applicable international regulations, Flag State and Oil Major requirements, and Crestline’s crewing standards.

The Crewing Manager oversees crew planning, recruitment, retention, deployment, certification, training compliance, travel coordination, and cost control to ensure a continuous supply of qualified and competent personnel across the assigned fleet.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

A. Crew Planning, Recruitment and Retention

* Recruit, select, and deploy suitably qualified officers and ratings in accordance with vessel-specific requirements and company standards.
* Develop and maintain crew rotation plans to ensure timely relief, adequate manpower availability, and uninterrupted vessel operations.
* Maintain a dedicated pool of competent seafarers, focusing on the retention of experienced officers and key personnel.
* Develop succession and career progression plans for senior officers, including Masters, Chief Engineers, Chief Officers, and Second Engineers.
* Maintain contact with officers during leave periods, as appropriate, to monitor availability, engagement, and future deployment.
* Identify crew shortages, retention risks, and succession gaps, implementing appropriate mitigation measures.
* Coordinate with approved manning agents to ensure timely sourcing and deployment of suitable personnel.

B. Regulatory Compliance, Certification and Training

* Ensure all crew joining assigned vessels hold valid certificates of competency and proficiency, medical certificates, visas, Flag State endorsements, and other required documentation.
* Maintain compliance with applicable STCW, MLC 2006, Flag State, Port State, and collective bargaining agreement (CBA) requirements.
* Review and maintain the crew training and competency matrix for each rank and vessel, ensuring compliance with company, shipowner, charterer, and applicable Oil Major requirements.
* Monitor certificate validity, endorsements, medical fitness, and mandatory training, ensuring timely renewals and completion.
* Verify crew qualifications and joining documentation before deployment.
* Coordinate tanker-specific training, familiarisation, and competency development with relevant departments.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date crew records in Shipmate.

C. Crew Travel and Deployment

* Arrange and coordinate crew sign-on and sign-off travel through appointed and approved marine travel providers.
* Ensure inbound and outbound travel is booked promptly and cost-effectively, considering vessel schedules, joining ports, visa requirements, and operational priorities.
* Manage travel changes and emergencies to minimise delays, additional costs, and operational disruption.
* Liaise with vessels, manning agents, travel providers, and internal departments to ensure smooth crew movements.

D. Crew Cost Control and Budget Management

* Prepare and maintain a rolling 12-month crew cost budget and rotation plan for the top four officers on each assigned vessel, aligned with fleet and key account requirements.
* Monitor monthly crew costs in Shipmate, identifying budget variances, cost trends, and savings opportunities.
* Submit monthly crew cost reports with variance analysis, explanatory comments, and corrective actions where required.
* Maintain accurate forecasts covering crew changes, salaries, travel, training, and other crewing expenses.
* Optimise costs without compromising crew quality, safety, regulatory compliance, or operational readiness.

E. Audit, Vetting and Operational Support

* Monitor crew-related audit and vetting performance and coordinate preparations for inspections and assessments.
* Work closely with Marine, Operations, Technical, and HSEQ Departments to address crew-related findings and implement corrective actions.
* Ensure crew qualifications, training records, and competency evidence are readily available and compliant.
* Monitor applicable Oil Major, charterer, and vessel-specific requirements to maintain operational eligibility.
* Visit assigned vessels whenever practicable, particularly when calling at Singapore, to engage with seafarers and address crew-related matters.

F. Crew Management Systems and Data Administration

* Ensure effective adoption and consistent use of Shipmate across all assigned crewing activities.
* Maintain ownership of crew data, rotation schedules, certificates, training records, and related documentation.
* Ensure crew movements, costs, and documentation status are accurately recorded and promptly updated in Shipmate.
* Improve system utilisation, reporting accuracy, and crewing administration efficiency.

G. Crew Welfare, Medical and Claims Administration

* Coordinate crew medical and P&I claims, ensuring supporting documentation is complete and submitted promptly.
* Liaise with internal departments, insurers, P&I correspondents, and medical providers on crew-related claims.
* Support the handling of crew welfare concerns, grievances, and disciplinary matters in accordance with company policies and applicable requirements.
* Maintain appropriate communication with seafarers to facilitate timely resolution of personnel matters.

H. Manning Agent Management and Performance

* Conduct periodic visits and performance reviews of approved manning agents.
* Conduct or coordinate audits covering recruitment practices, crew qualifications, certification, documentation, and regulatory compliance.
* Monitor agent performance in crew quality, availability, retention, responsiveness, and cost effectiveness.
* Document audit findings, agree corrective actions, and ensure timely follow-up.
* Maintain effective working relationships with manning agents to ensure reliable crew supply and continuity across the assigned fleet.

**Requirements:**

* Relevant maritime qualification, degree, or professional certification in maritime studies, crewing, human resources, or a related discipline.
* Substantial crew management experience in commercial shipping, preferably involving oil, gas, chemical, or product tankers.
* Sound knowledge of STCW, MLC 2006, Flag State requirements, tanker-specific training, crew certification, and applicable CBAs.
* Proven experience in crew planning, recruitment, retention, budgeting, and manning agent management.
* Familiarity with Oil Major vetting requirements and tanker crew competency standards.
* Experience with Shipmate or similar crew management systems.
* Strong organisational, analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage competing operational priorities.

title: Manager - FCU
description:
**Job Summary**
We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Manager for our Financial Crime Unit (FCU). In this role, you will lead a team of specialists dedicated to detecting, investigating, and preventing financial crimes, including money laundering, fraud, and terrorist financing. You will be responsible for overseeing daily FCU operations, ensuring compliance with global and local regulatory standards, and implementing robust risk mitigation strategies to protect the organization's integrity and assets.
  
  
Job Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead and manage the Financial Crime Unit, providing guidance, training, and performance evaluations to team members.
* Oversee the end-to-end investigation of suspicious financial activities, ensuring thorough documentation and timely resolution.
* Monitor transaction monitoring systems, evaluate alerts, and ensure accurate and timely filing of Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs) / Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) to regulatory authorities.
* Develop, implement, and update anti-money laundering (AML), counter-terrorist financing (CTF), and fraud prevention policies and procedures.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders, including Legal, Compliance, and Risk Management, as well as external law enforcement and regulatory bodies during investigations.
* Conduct regular risk assessments and audit preparations to ensure the effectiveness of the FCU control framework.
* Drive the continuous improvement of FCU detection tools, systems, and processes through the integration of new technologies and methodologies.

**Job Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Criminology, Finance, Business Administration, Law, or a related field.
* A minimum of 5 years of experience in financial crime investigation, AML/CFT compliance, or fraud risk management, with at least 2 years in a supervisory or leadership role.
* Professional certification such as Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist (CAMS) or Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE) is highly preferred.
* Deep knowledge of local and international financial crime regulations, compliance frameworks, and industry best practices.
* Strong analytical, investigative, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex financial data.
* Excellent communication and report-writing skills, with the ability to present findings clearly to senior management and external authorities.
* Proficiency in financial crime detection systems, transaction monitoring software, and data analysis tools.

title: Manager-Power Electronics (Data Center)
description:
**What You’ll Do**
This role is responsible for leading the electrical engineering design, development, and implementation of large-scale, mission-critical data center infrastructure projects. The position combines technical leadership, people leadership, and project delivery responsibilities to ensure innovative, reliable, scalable, and cost-effective data center solutions. The role serves as the technical authority for electrical systems while driving engineering excellence, design quality, innovation, and team development across the data center project lifecycle.
  
  
Engineering Management
  
  

* Lead and manage electrical engineers and subject matter experts across projects.
* Allocate resources and manage engineering workloads.
* Drive engineering execution to meet project schedules, quality targets, and customer requirements.
* Build, mentor, and develop high-performing engineering teams.
* Provide technical coaching and professional development support to engineers.

Project Delivery & Client Engagement
  
  

* Manage electrical engineering deliverables throughout project execution.
* Act as the primary technical interface for customers, contractors, and internal stakeholders.
* Participate in client meetings, technical reviews, and project discussions.
* Support successful project delivery through close collaboration with project management, commercial, and technical teams.
* Ensure alignment between customer expectations, project requirements, and engineering execution.

Quality, Standards & Governance
  
  

* Establish and maintain electrical engineering standards, procedures, and best practices.
* Conduct formal design reviews and peer reviews.
* Ensure compliance with applicable electrical codes, standards, and industry best practices.
* Promote continuous improvement of engineering processes and design methodologies.

Site Support & Commissioning
  
  

* Lead site visits during installation, testing, and commissioning phases.
* Monitor electrical installation activities and resolve technical issues.
* Support commissioning activities and operational readiness assessments.
* Provide technical guidance for field challenges and project execution risks.

Innovation & Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Drive adoption of innovative technologies and engineering solutions.
* Evaluate new approaches to improve efficiency, reliability, and cost performance.
* Contribute to the advancement of next-generation data center infrastructure.
* Support strategic engineering initiatives and long-term technology roadmaps.

**Qualifications**
Bachelor's/ Master's Degree in Electrical Engineering with 8 to 12 years of relevant experience in electrical engineering and data center infrastructure design.
  
  
**Skills**
Proven experience delivering electrical systems for mission-critical facilities.
  
  
The ideal candidate should possess strong technical expertise in the design and delivery of mission-critical data center electrical infrastructure, including medium- and low-voltage power distribution systems, transformers, UPS systems, standby generation, and critical power architectures. The role requires proficiency in electrical system design, power distribution analysis, design verification, installation and commissioning practices, as well as a thorough understanding of applicable electrical codes, standards, and quality processes. Candidates should be knowledgeable in emerging data center technologies, edge computing, AI-driven infrastructure trends, value engineering, and cost optimization strategies. Additionally, strong capabilities in engineering and project management, including resource planning, schedule management, quality oversight, risk mitigation, and multidisciplinary team coordination, are essential to successfully deliver reliable, scalable, and innovative data center solutions.
  
  
The ideal candidate should demonstrate strong leadership and people management skills, with the ability to build, mentor, and inspire high-performing engineering teams while driving technical excellence and innovation. The role requires strategic thinking, including the ability to evaluate emerging technologies, influence long-term technology direction, and maintain a strong customer and business focus. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills are essential, along with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear and actionable recommendations. The successful candidate should possess strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, effectively lead cross-functional teams, and demonstrate a results-oriented mindset, accountability, ownership, continuous improvement focus, customer-centricity, and a commitment to quality and engineering excellence.

description:

:

**Job Role Description:**

Manage and maintain the organization’s IT infrastructure, servers, data center operations, network and security systems, cloud services, and enterprise IT applications, ensuring high availability, security, performance, and business continuity.

1. IT Infrastructure Management

* Manage servers, storage, desktops, laptops, printers, network devices, and wireless systems.
* Plan infrastructure upgrades, installations, maintenance, and capacity; maintain documentation, asset inventories, and configuration records.

2. Server and Data Center Operations

* Manage physical/virtual servers, Windows and Linux environments, and virtualization platforms such as Microsoft Hyper-V.
* Monitor server performance, storage, hardware health, operating systems, and critical services; maintain UPS, power backup, cooling, physical access, and equipment safety.
* Plan server upgrades, migrations, preventive maintenance, and infrastructure improvements.

3. Network and IT Security

* Manage LAN/WAN, internet leased lines, routers, switches, firewalls, Wi-Fi, VPNs, and inter-site connectivity.
* Configure firewall policies, network access controls, secure remote access, and segmentation; manage endpoint security, antivirus/EDR, patching, access permissions, and system logs.
* Resolve network/security issues and implement appropriate security controls.

4. Backup, Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity

* Maintain backup policies for servers, virtual machines, applications, and business data; monitor jobs, retention, offsite copies, and recovery procedures.
* Conduct restoration tests and disaster recovery drills; maintain recovery plans to ensure continuity and minimize downtime.

5. IT Operations and Monitoring

* Monitor infrastructure availability, performance, system logs, and critical services; manage OS updates, software installations, patching, and preventive maintenance.
* Troubleshoot issues, perform root-cause analysis, implement corrective actions, and maintain incident, problem, change, and service-request processes.

6. Cloud Services and Enterprise Applications

* Administer Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID, cloud storage, user accounts, access permissions, MFA, email, collaboration tools, and subscription renewals.
* Support cloud migration and hybrid infrastructure; monitor service availability, security configurations, and license utilization.

7. IT Asset, License and Compliance Management

* Maintain records of IT assets, software licenses, subscriptions, warranties, support contracts, installations, allocations, renewals, and compliance.
* Coordinate procurement, vendor support, maintenance contracts, and upgrades; maintain IT policies, SOPs, and audit documentation.

8. IT Service Delivery and Team Management

* Lead the IT support team, assign responsibilities, monitor task completion, and ensure timely incident and service-request resolution.
* Coordinate with departments, vendors, and service providers; prepare IT budgets, infrastructure proposals, operational reports, and project updates.
* Identify opportunities to improve IT service quality, security, reliability, and cost efficiency.

**Qualifications and Skills:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in IT, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field
* 10–15 years of relevant experience
* Windows Server, Linux fundamentals, virtualization and server hardware; networking, TCP/IP, VLANs, DNS, DHCP, VPN, routing, switching and firewall administration; backup/disaster recovery, infrastructure monitoring and endpoint security; Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID and cloud administration; IT asset management, software licensing, vendor management and IT documentation.
* Experience managing enterprise IT infrastructure in a manufacturing or multi-location organization. Relevant certifications in Microsoft technologies, networking, cybersecurity, virtualization, or IT service management.

title: Manager, Product Support
description:
What You'll Do
  
  
**Manager, Technical Support**
**Reporting to:**
Sr. Manager /Director, Global Support Operations
  
  
**Work from Office**
**Working hours: 6:00 PM–3:00 AM or 8:00 PM–5:00 AM IST**
**Role Overview**
The Manager, Technical Support will lead and scale a high-performing global support organization, delivering exceptional technical assistance and customer experience.
  
  
You will be responsible for optimizing support operations, enhancing customer satisfaction, and driving strategic initiatives—including the adoption of AI and automation—to improve efficiency, scalability, and outcomes. This role requires a balance of strong technical acumen, leadership capability, and a data-driven approach to continuous improvement.
  
  
**What Your Responsibilities Will Be**
**What You Will Do**
**Leadership & Team Development**

* Lead and develop a team of technical support professionals, including first-line team leads.
* Set clear performance expectations, conduct evaluations, and foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Coach and mentor leaders to build a scalable, high-performing organization.

**Technical Support Operations**

* Own and optimize end-to-end support operations to ensure efficient, high-quality issue resolution.
* Drive adherence to SLAs, improve operational efficiency, and scale support processes.
* Partner with global teams to continuously improve KPIs such as TTR, CSAT, and productivity.
* Identify and implement opportunities for AI and automation to improve case deflection, triaging, and resolution times.

**Customer Experience & Escalation Management**

* Oversee critical escalations and provide guidance on complex technical issues.
* Engage directly with customers as needed to resolve high-impact issues and ensure satisfaction.
* Ensure clear, effective communication of technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Training teams to drive product improvements and better customer outcomes.
* Influence the development of AI-driven tools, self-service capabilities, and knowledge management systems.
* Act as a key stakeholder in aligning support strategy with broader organizational goals.

**Performance Management & Insights**

* Analyze support metrics, trends, and customer feedback to identify improvement opportunities.
* Provide regular insights and strategic recommendations to senior leadership.
* Use data to drive decision-making and continuous optimization.

**Continuous Improvement & Innovation**

* Champion initiatives to improve support quality, efficiency, and scalability.
* Stay current with industry trends, especially in AI-enabled customer support, and bring innovative practices into the organization.
* Drive a culture of experimentation and continuous learning.

What You’ll Need To Be Successful
  
  
**What You Bring**

* Graduate in any discipline (technical or business background preferred).
* 7+ years of experience building and scaling customer-facing technical support teams, including experience managing managers.
* Strong experience in API-based or technically complex support environments.
* Expertise in support operations, process optimization, and service delivery.
* Proficiency with CRM and support platforms (e.g., Salesforce, ServiceNow) and multi-channel support environments.
* Demonstrated experience leveraging AI, automation, or machine learning in support operations (e.g., chatbots, case routing, predictive analytics, knowledge systems).
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven mindset.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across technical and non-technical audiences.
* Flexibility to work in rotational night shifts (work from office, 5 days a week).

This role is critical in shaping the future of support by combining
**technical depth, leadership, and AI-driven transformation**
. You will play a key role in building a scalable, efficient, and customer-centric support organization that directly impacts customer success and business growth.
  
  
Avalara is an AI-first Company
  
  
AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.
  
  

* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
* You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
* You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

How We’ll Take Care Of You
  
  
Total Rewards
  
  
In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.
  
  
Health & Wellness
  
  
Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.
  
  
Inclusive culture and diversity
  
  
Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.
  
  
**What You Need To Know About Avalara**
We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.
  
  
We’ve already built an industry-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.
  
  
We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.
  
  
**We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer**
Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

title: Export/Import Manager
description: About JLG, An Oshkosh CompanyJLG began in 1969, when our founder, John L. Grove set out to resolve growing safety concerns in the construction industry. Since then we have been committed to understanding the challenges and delivering innovative solutions to the access market. We partner with customers to provide quality equipment, training opportunities and trusted support within the access industry. We are a global company, and our products—including mobile elevating work platforms, telehandlers, utility vehicles and accessories—can be found all over the world.Job SummaryThe Export-Import & Logistics Manager holds end-to-end operational and statutory ownership of international trade compliance, customs operations, plant logistics, warehousing, and inbound/outbound shipping for the Pune manufacturing facility. Reporting directly to the Plant Manager, this role acts as the site’s designated authority on foreign trade policy, customs regulatory affairs, tariff management, and international trade governance.As the Pune plant triples production output over the coming months, this leader will establish a world-class trade compliance infrastructure, scale plant warehousing and line-feeding operations, streamline customs clearance cycles to prevent port demurrage, and lead negotiations with custom house agents (CHAs), freight forwarders, and logistics service providers to ensure zero disruption to manufacturing schedules.Essential Duties And Responsibilities International Trade Compliance & Regulatory GovernanceStatutory Compliance & Legal Governance: Ensure absolute compliance with the Indian Customs Act (1962), Foreign Trade Policy (FTP), Directorate General of Foreign Trade (DGFT) regulations, CBIC guidelines, and applicable international trade sanctions. HS Classification & Valuation: Oversee proper Harmonized System (HS) tariff code classification for capital machinery, CKD/SKD assemblies, raw materials, hydraulics, structural fabrications, and electronic components; maintain robust substantiation for customs valuation, related-party transactions (SVB), and transfer pricing rules. Duty Optimization & Government Schemes: Strategize, implement, and administer duty exemption and remission schemes, including Advance Authorizations, Export Promotion Capital Goods (EPCG), RoDTEP, Duty Drawback, and MOOWR (Manufacturing and Other Operations in Warehouse Regulations). Trade Agreements & Rules of Origin: Leverage Free Trade Agreements (FTAs) and Preferential Trade Agreements (PTAs) for preferential tariff benefits while maintaining strict compliance with CAROTAR (Customs Administration of Rules of Origin under Trade Agreements Rules, 2020). AEO Certification: Drive the acquisition, maintenance, and audit readiness of Authorized Economic Operator (AEO-T1/T2) certification for the Pune manufacturing unit to expedite clearance timelines. Customs Liaison & Audit Defense: Serve as the primary plant liaison with Customs authorities, DGFT offices, and port appraisers; coordinate customs audits, reply to show-cause notices (SCNs), and manage internal trade health checks. EXIM Operations & Customs Execution Clearance Operations: Direct and monitor daily import and export clearance via ICEGATE, ensuring timely filing of Bills of Entry and Shipping Bills to maintain fast turnaround and eliminate port/airport demurrage and container detention penalties. Documentation & Banking Compliance: Ensure accuracy of all cross-border documentation (commercial invoices, packing lists, COO, bill of lading, airway bills); manage statutory banking and foreign exchange reconciliation, including RBI/FEMA compliance via IDPMS (Import Data Processing and Monitoring System) and EDPMS (Export Data Processing and Monitoring System). Broker & CHA Governance: Supervise and evaluate the performance of Custom House Agents (CHAs) and international freight forwarders using rigorous SLAs covering document accuracy, clearance velocity, and billing integrity. Plant Logistics, Warehousing & Production Scaling Expansion Logistics Architecture: Optimize plant stores, receiving docks, yard management, and high-density warehouse storage layouts to absorb a threefold surge in manufacturing volume without line stoppages. Material Flow & Inventory Integrity: Drive lean line-side feeding (kitting, Kanban, JIT), cyclic counting, and real-time inventory reconciliation within ERP/WMS systems, minimizing part-shortage risks and material handling delays. Domestic Transport & E-Way Bill Compliance: Manage plant inbound/outbound road logistics, ensuring complete adherence to Central Motor Vehicles Rules, GST e-way billing, and transporter transit safety standards. Cost & Budget Control: Formulate and manage freight and clearance budgets, negotiate annual carrier contracts/Long-Term Agreements (LTAs), and initiate cost-reduction programs across shipping modes, consolidation hubs, and packaging.Qualifications And ExperienceMinimum Qualifications Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, International Trade, Foreign Trade, or related field. (An MBA in International Business/Supply Chain or a Post-Graduate Diploma in Foreign Trade Management is highly desirable). Experience: Minimum of 8–12 years of hands-on experience leading trade compliance, customs clearance, and plant logistics/stores within an engineering, automotive, heavy equipment, or industrial manufacturing environment in India. Compliance Expertise: In-depth knowledge of Indian Customs procedures (Faceless Assessment, ICEGATE, SVB), DGFT foreign trade schemes (MOOWR, EPCG, Advance License), and HSN classification. Warehousing Background: Practical experience in manufacturing plant stores, warehouse operations, and material handling systems.Preferred Qualifications Industry-recognized certifications in trade compliance, customs brokerage, or supply chain (e.g., CITI, FIATA, CSCP, or Indian Customs Rule 6/G-Card exposure). Familiarity with US Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ITAR guidelines, and global sanctions compliance in a US-multinational subsidiary. Proven track record of scaling logistics/EXIM operations through high-growth manufacturing ramp-ups or facility footprint expansions. Exceptional negotiation, analytical, and crisis-management skills; capable of influencing both shop-floor operations and government regulatory officers.

title: Supervisor
description:
**Position Summary**
Husco provides individuals the opportunity to pursue a career within a fast -paced, industry – leading and entrepreneurial organization. The Supervisor I leads one assigned production department, area or value stream and is accountable for safe and reliable daily and weekly execution of the agreed production schedule. The role makes decisions within approved staffing, production, quality and operating standard develops employees, builds labor versatility and owns continuous improvement within the assigned area. Matters outside the assigned area or delegated authority are escalated to the Plant Manager.
  
  
Husco is committed to building an environment for employees to be able:
  
  

* To have the flexibility of their own work and put a personal ‘stamp’ on their output
* Continuously expand and develop their professional skills and knowledge
* Create a product for our customers that serves a greater purpose to communities around the world

**PERFORMANCE OBJECTIVES**
**Own Achievement of Daily Production Metrics.**
Lead one assigned department, area or value stream and achieve the agreed daily and weekly production schedule. Independently assign labor, sequence work within the established production schedule, approve routine overtime within agreed limits, stop work for safety or quality concerns and contain non – conforming product. Escalate schedule constraints and requests to change production orders, production priorities or customer commitments through the established planning process.
  
  
**Manage and Develop Employees.**
Directly supervise production employees and, where applicable, team leaders. Maintain attendance, overtime, holiday, payroll, conduct and performance records. Set clear expectations, coach performance, ensure competence and support individual development. Build departmental skills and labor versatility. Maintain an accurate skills matrix for the assigned area. Identify coverage risks and implement cross -training plans that enable employees to perform multiple approved tasks within the department. Verify competence before independent working and review progress against operational coverage needs.
  
  
**Own Area Improvement.**
Drive improvement within the assigned area, lead root – cause activity, implement approved countermeasures and verify sustained results. Escalate work requiring cross – functional ownership, capital expenditure, changes to plant standards or action outside the assigned area. Contribute to plant – wide projects led by Supervisor II or the Plant Manager. Safety, Quality and Compliance. Act as safety leader for the assigned area, respond to incidents and near misses, complete investigations and corrective actions, and maintain product and process quality standards.
  
  
**Customer Support.**
For routine delivery or quality concerns arising from the assigned area, secure containment, provide verified operational information to the designated customer – facing function and execute the approved recovery plan. Escalate major or multi -department customer -impacting events. The role does not change or recommend changes to customer commitments.
  
  
**Strong Team Player and Contributor.**
Work effectively in a fast-paced environment, maintain clear shift communication and combine attention to detail with a strong orientation toward execution.
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree in a relevant technical discipline or equivalent education and experience.
* Minimum 3 years of manufacturing experience, including at least 1 year in a team leadership or supervisory role in assembly, machining or a comparable environment.
* Experience maintaining skills matrices, identifying training needs and coordinating cross-training within a production team.
* Working knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, structured problem-solving and operational metrics.
* Experience managing day-to-day employee matters and operational priorities.
* Strong communication, organization, conflict-resolution and problem-solving skills.
* Experience with Microsoft Office products.
* Ability to interact with people at all levels of responsibility.

**HUSCO IS PROUD TO BE AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER.**

title: IT Operation Head- Telco
description:
Job description:
  
  
Job Description

**IT Operations Head – Telco**

**Location:  Pune**

**Role Overview**

Sole ownership of IT Operations for one of our largest Tier-1 telecom accounts in Europe, US and APAC , spanning Applications (BSS/OSS), Cloud & Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, Observability/AIOps, ITSM,— a 140+ FTE offshore organization.

We want a builder-operator — someone who will personally lead the service uplift plan, get the team's capability and culture right, and push automation/AIOps hard enough that it actually changes the numbers. Equally, this person needs to be comfortable outside the IT conversation: sitting with the client's business and customer-experience stakeholders, understanding what "good" looks like for their end customers, and shaping IT operations decisions around that — not just SLA compliance, but a client that feels genuinely well served.

If you've done this before — taken over a large, high-visibility telecom account, put your own hands on the recovery, and left it materially better — this is that role again, at a bigger scale.

**Mandatory Requirements**

•     Telecom IT/BSS-OSS depth, not network engineering: hands-on experience running IT operations for telecom BSS/OSS applications, cloud/infra, and ITSM — candidates with a pure telecom network operations  background do not meet this requirement.

•     18–20+ years in IT services / managed services, with at least 8–10 years in a senior operations leadership role (Ops Head / Service Delivery Director level or equivalent), not a mid-level delivery manager.

•     Proven experience leading a large offshore delivery organization of 140+ FTEs across multiple streams (Apps, Infra, SecOps, etc) — must show direct, verifiable ownership of a team at this scale.

•     Multi-geography telecom client exposure — has directly managed or supported telecom operators in at least two of: APAC, Europe, US.

•     Demonstrated track record of service uplift — has personally led performance turnaround on a large telecom account facing challenging SLAs (recovery planning, MIM/RCA overhaul, rebuilding client trust).

•     Comfortable operating beyond IT — can engage the client's business and customer-experience stakeholders directly, not just the CIO/CTO organization.

•     Hands-on AIOps/automation driver — has led (not just endorsed) adoption of AIOps, observability tooling, and automation/self-healing to reduce MTTR, incident volume, and cost.

•     Strong executive presence with proven P&L ownership and Senior director level stakeholder management.

**Key Responsibilities**

•     Own 24x7 IT operations delivery and SLA/KPI/XLA performance across the full stack; be the escalation point for major incidents and drive proactive, prevention-led operations.

•     Lead and execute the service uplift plan where SLAs are under pressure — hands-on, not delegated.

•     Engage directly with client business and customer-experience teams — not just IT — to understand end-customer impact and shape operations priorities accordingly.

•     Build, restructure and upskill the delivery organization (140+ FTEs); strengthen the leadership bench and succession pipeline.

•     Drive AIOps, observability, and automation adoption to modernize operations toward predictive/autonomous operations.

•     Own the client relationship at director level; run governance forums, service reviews, and transformation discussions.

•     Own P&L for the operations portfolio; deliver productivity gains, automation ROI, and support renewals/growth.

•     Represent the organization in audits, CSAT, and governance/compliance forums.

OR

**Skills And Knowledge**

* Customer and Personal Service - Knowledge of principles and processes for providing customer and personal services. This includes customer needs assessment, meeting quality standards for services, and evaluation of customer satisfaction.
* Management of Financial Resources - Determining how money will be spent to get the work done, and accounting for these expenditures.
* Administration and Management - Knowledge of business and management principles involved in strategic planning, resource allocation, human resources modeling, leadership technique, production methods, and coordination of people and resources.
* Applied Business Knowledge - Understanding market dynamics, enterprise level objectives and important aspects of the company’s business to accurately diagnose strengths and weaknesses, anticipate opportunities and risks, identify issues, and develop strategies and plans. Aligning individual and team actions with strategies and plans to drive business results.
* Management of Material Resources - Obtaining and seeing to the appropriate use of equipment, facilities, and materials needed to do certain work.

**CORE WORK ACTIVITIES**
**Developing and Maintaining Food and Beverage/Culinary Goals**

* Sets expectations and holds food and beverage leadership team accountable for demonstrating desired service behaviors.
* Reviews financial reports and statements to determine how Food and Beverage is performing against budget.
* Makes recommendations for CAPEX funding of food and beverage equipment and renovations in accordance with brand business strategy.
* Works with food and beverage leadership team to determine areas of concern and develops strategies to improve the department’s financial performance.
* Establishes challenging, realistic and obtainable goals to guide operation and performance.
* Strives to improve service performance.

**Developing and Maintaining Budgets**

* Develops and manages Food and Beverage budget.
* Monitors the department’s actual and projected sales to ensure revenue goals are met or exceeded and opportunities are identified and addressed.
* Ensures cash control and liquor control policies are in place in food & beverage areas and followed by all related employees.
* Focuses on maintaining profit margins without compromising guest or employee satisfaction.

**Leading Food and Beverage/Culinary Team**

* Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound financial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.

* Achieves and exceeds goals including performance goals, budget goals, team goals, etc.
* Serves as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
* Develops means to improve profit, including estimating cost and benefit, exploring new business opportunities, etc.
* Identifies opportunities to increase profits and create value by challenging existing processes, encouraging innovation and driving necessary change.
* Ensures that regular, on-going communication occurs in all areas of food and beverage (e.g., pre-meal briefings, staff meetings, culinary team).
* Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with direct reports and entire food & beverage team. Ensures direct reports do the same for their team.
* Develops a food and beverage operating strategy that is aligned with the brand’s business strategy and leads its execution.
* Identifies the developmental needs of others and coaches, mentors, or otherwise helps others to improve their knowledge or skills.
* Stays aware of market trends and introduces new food and beverage products to meet or exceed customer expectations, generate increased revenue and ensure a competitive position in the market.

**Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service**

* Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
* Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
* Reviews findings from comment cards and guest satisfaction results with F& B team and ensures appropriate corrective action is taken.
* Reviews comment cards, guest satisfaction results and other data to identify areas of improvement.
* Empowers employees to provide excellent guest service.
* Estimates cost and benefit ratio, maintaining balance between profit and service satisfaction.
* Shares plans to take corrective action based on comment cards and guest satisfaction results with property leadership.

**Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities**

* Provides guidance and direction to subordinates, including setting performance standards and monitoring performance.
* Coaches and supports food & beverage leadership team to effectively manage wages, food & beverage cost and controllable expenses (e.g., restaurant supplies, uniforms, etc.).
* Hires food & beverage leadership team members who demonstrate strong functional expertise, creativity and entrepreneurial leadership to meet the business needs of the operation.
* Sets goals and expectations for direct reports using the performance review process and holds staff accountable for successful performance.
* Ensures that expectations and objectives are clearly communicated to subordinates; subordinates are also open to raise questions and/or concerns.
* Brings issues to the attention of Human Resources as necessary.
* Ensures employees are treated fairly and equitably.
* Coaches team by providing specific feedback to improve performance.

**Additional Responsibilities**

* Informs and/or update the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.
* Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
* Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
* Estimate food, liquor, wine, and other beverage consumption in order to anticipate amounts to be purchased or requisitioned.
* Order and purchase equipment and supplies.

The role will lead teams delivering large Microsoft 365 migration and modernization programs for clients across regions.
  
  
**The opportunity**

The role combines solution leadership, delivery management, stakeholder engagement and team development, with a preference for candidates who have led large-scale migration or modernization programs.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Lead Microsoft 365 migration and modernization projects across SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, workflows and forms.
