* Define the delivery approach, estimates, migration waves, resourcing, governance and quality controls.
* Lead assessments, identify risks and dependencies, and develop practical migration roadmaps.
* Guide migration factory setup, pilots, wave execution, cutover and transition.
* Oversee Nintex workflow and form modernization using Nintex Automation Cloud or Power Platform.
* Review solution designs, migration plans, remediation approaches and deployment documents.
* Lead delivery teams, remove blockers, monitor progress and maintain quality.
* Manage client, security, Microsoft and vendor stakeholders, decisions and dependencies.
* Support proposals, demonstrations, estimates, staffing plans and executive presentations.
* Promote reusable methods, automation and continuous improvement.
* Ensure compliance with security, quality, organizational and commercial requirements.

**Skills And Attributes**

* 9-12 years of relevant technology consulting experience, including substantial experience in Microsoft 365, SharePoint migration or modernization.
* Strong SME-level knowledge of SharePoint Online, SharePoint Server, SPFx, Microsoft Graph, PnP PowerShell and Microsoft 365 architecture.
* Proven experience planning and delivering large Microsoft 365 migration programs involving SharePoint, OneDrive and Teams.
* Experience with migration assessment, remediation, migration factory operations, wave planning, velocity management, cutover and hypercare.
* Hands-on or solution oversight experience with migration tools such as ShareGate, Microsoft Migration Manager, SharePoint Migration Tool or equivalent tools.
* Knowledge of Nintex Workflow, Nintex Forms and Nintex Automation Cloud, with experience in workflow and forms modernization.
* Working knowledge of Power Platform, including Power Apps and Power Automate, and the ability to guide target-platform decisions.
* Experience developing migration and modernization accelerators.

**Good To Have Skills**

* Experience with Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio or AI automation.
* Knowledge of Microsoft 365 governance, permissions, Purview, security and compliance.
* Experience with tenant-to-tenant, acquisition, divestiture or hybrid migrations.
* Knowledge of Azure services, integrations, Azure DevOps and CI/CD.
* Relevant Microsoft, Nintex, project management or agile certifications.

**Soft Skills**

* Ability to lead, motivate and develop high-performing teams across locations.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Ability to balance quality, timelines and cost.
* Sound decision-making and problem-solving in complex situations.
* Ability to manage scope, schedules, risks, quality and competing priorities.
* Collaborative leadership with clear accountability for outcomes.
* Ability to review technical deliverables, challenge assumptions and guide consultants and engineers.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* A bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business or a related discipline.
* A minimum of 8 years of relevant experience, preferably in a professional services or consulting organization.
* Strong Microsoft 365 and SharePoint migration or modernization expertise.
* Proven experience leading teams and delivering complex technology engagements.
* Experience developing estimates, delivery plans, governance and stakeholder communications.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Analytical ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize tasks into manageable work products.
* Can operate independently or with minimum supervision
* Led large-scale Microsoft 365 migration or modernization projects from discovery through transition.
* Managed multidisciplinary teams covering migration, development, workflow modernization, testing and change activities.
* Contributed to proposals, solutioning, capability development and client relationship growth.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:

The role of the Team Lead Engineering Applications is to lead and develop the Engineering / PLM applications team globally and to own the daily operations, support, roadmap and continuous improvement of the Engineering and PLM application landscape (e.g. Teamcenter, NX, Medusa Plant Design System, Engineering Base and related Engineering Systems). The position combines people leadership, service delivery ownership, solution design and stakeholder consulting to ensure a stable, secure, standardised and cost-efficient application landscape that reliably supports the global engineering process chain.
  
  

* Lead, develop and grow the Engineering / PLM applications team, consisting of functional consultants, administrators and development staff, including capacity planning, onboarding, coaching and competence development.

* Define and drive the roadmap and strategy for the Engineering / PLM applications in alignment with Global process owners, Group IT and Enterprise Architecture.
* Act as escalation point for critical incidents and major problems, driving root cause analysis, permanent fixes and preventive measures.
* Collaborate in a global environment along the full Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) process chain, ensuring consistent ways of working between GSC, headquarters and regional sites.
* Identify, design and implement new solutions end-to-end, including requirements analysis, solution evaluation, vendor identification and vendor qualification.

* Establish solid working relationships with key business stakeholders in Engineering and advise them on capabilities, feasible solutions and best practices for their business challenges.
* Represent the Engineering applications competence perspective within the global architecture, business process ecosystem, user community, relevant boards and projects.
* Apply industry best practices around demand management, change management, agile operations and DevOps, and contribute to a group-wide efficient operating model.
* Manage supplier and partner relationships, SLAs, contracts, service monitoring and periodic reviews, and support commercial negotiations for new contracts or renewals.
* Support definition, tracking and reporting of budget and resources, including cost transparency and benefit realisation for the application portfolio.
* Drive standardisation, decommissioning of legacy and exotic applications, and migration towards platform and cloud-based solutions.
* Ensure complete and up-to-date documentation of system configurations, customisations, integrations, support processes and knowledge articles; manage key-person dependency within the team.
* Ensure compliance with IT security, data protection, licensing and internal governance requirements for all engineering applications.
* Support local data cleansing and data quality initiatives together with the business departments.
* Drive cultural change towards user adoption of digital engineering processes and tools.

* Degree in engineering (preferably plant or mechanical design), computer science, information technology or business administration, or equivalent professional qualification.
* Minimum 8-10 years of experience in Engineering / PLM applications, of which at least 3 years in a team lead or people management role.

* Good working knowledge of ERP systems, preferably SAP, and of the integration between PLM and ERP.
* Experience in process management along the engineering process chain and in IT service management (ITIL) practices such as incident, problem and change management.
* In-depth knowledge of application lifecycle management, agile ways of working (SCRUM or comparable) and DevOps principles.
* Affinity to customising and programming; experience with interfaces, scripting and automation is an advantage.
* Experience working with senior leadership and confidence in communication at all levels.
* Experience in project management and in leading globally distributed, cross-functional teams.
* Knowledge of German is an added advantage.

title: Channel Ops Manager
description:
**Job Description**
Honeywell is seeking a highly motivated and analytical
**Channel Operations Manager**
to drive operational excellence across our channel partner ecosystem. This role is responsible for managing channel operations, partner performance governance, sales process optimization, program execution, reporting, and business insights to support revenue growth and customer satisfaction.
  
  
The ideal candidate will collaborate closely with Sales, Finance, Supply Chain, Marketing, and Authorized Channel Partners to ensure efficient execution of channel programs, accurate forecasting, partner compliance, and operational effectiveness.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Channel Operations Management**

* Lead daily channel operations supporting distributors, system integrators, resellers, and strategic partners.
* Ensure smooth execution of channel programs, partner onboarding, and operational processes.
* Monitor compliance with Honeywell channel policies, procedures, and contractual requirements.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance channel efficiency and productivity.

**Channel Expansion**

* Assess channel coverage models and identify gaps.
* Lead new partner identification, evaluation, onboarding, and ramp-up.
* Drive partner capability development and business growth initiatives.
* Champion partner enablement and adoption of tools and programs.

**Sales Operations & Analytics**

* Develop and maintain channel performance dashboards, KPIs, and business reports.
* Analyze sales trends, pipeline health, bookings, and partner productivity metrics.
* Provide actionable insights to leadership teams for business planning and decision-making.
* Support sales forecasting, quota tracking, and territory performance reviews.

**Partner Program Administration**

* Administer channel incentive programs, rebates, MDF (Market Development Funds), and promotional activities.
* Validate partner claims and ensure accurate incentive calculations and processing.
* Manage partner segmentation, certifications, and performance scorecards.
* Support partner engagement initiatives and operational communications.

**Process Excellence**

* Identify process gaps and implement automation opportunities.
* Standardize channel management practices to improve scalability and effectiveness.
* Collaborate with IT and business stakeholders to eCommerce.
* Ensure data integrity across Salesforce, SAP, Oracle, or other business systems.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Sales, Finance, Marketing, Customer Service, and Supply Chain teams.
* Resolve operational issues affecting channel partners and customers.
* Support business reviews, audits, and compliance requirements.
* Participate in strategic planning and channel transformation initiatives.

**Leadership Expectations**

* Serve as a trusted advisor to Sales Leadership and Country Management teams.
* Influence stakeholders without direct authority.
* Lead cross-functional initiatives involving Sales, Finance, Supply Chain, Marketing, and Operations.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Channel revenue growth
* New Partner Contribution
* Forecast accuracy
* Rebate and incentive processing accuracy
* Channel productivity metrics
* Inventory Health & Aging
* Data quality and reporting accuracy
* Program adoption and compliance rates
* Operational process efficiency improvements

**Qualifications**
**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Operations Management, Finance, or related field.
* MBA preferred.

**Experience**

* 10-15 years of experience in Channel Operations, Sales Operations, Business Operations, or Partner Management.
* Experience supporting indirect sales channels in industrial automation, building automation, or industrial products sectors preferred.
* Experience working with global and regional channel partners.
* Demonstrated success in leading business planning and performance governance initiatives.

**Technical Skills**

* Microsoft Power point, Microsoft Excel and Power BI skills.
* Strong knowledge of Salesforce CRM, SAP, Oracle, or equivalent systems.
* Data analysis, forecasting, and reporting expertise.
* Process improvement and project management skills.
* Understanding of channel incentive and rebate programs.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, matrixed organization.
* High attention to detail and operational discipline.
* Customer-focused mindset with strong business acumen.
* Ability to influence without direct authority.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in a multinational organization.
* Experience managing large-scale channel transformation initiatives.
* Knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, or continuous improvement methodologies.

**What Success Looks Like**
Within the first 12 months, the Channel Operations Manager will:
  
  

* Increase revenue from new and existing channels
* Improve channel operational efficiency and process compliance.
* Enhance visibility through robust reporting and analytics.
* Drive higher partner engagement and program adoption.
* Support sustainable channel revenue growth across Honeywell businesses.

**Honeywell Competencies**

* Customer Focus
* Results Orientation
* Innovation & Continuous Improvement
* Collaboration & Teamwork
* Integrity & Accountability

Strategic Thinking
  
  
**About Us**
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

title: Delivery Manager
description:
**About Us**
**PBU Delivery & Agile Operations Manager – OMS**
**Location:**
Pune, India
  
  
**Reports to:**
Product Business Unit Head
  
  
**Experience:**
6+ Years
  
  
**Type:**
Full-time, Work from Office
  
  
**About The Role**
Anchanto is a global enterprise-grade B2B SaaS company. We provide cloud software for brands, retailers, and logistics providers to manage orders, inventory, marketplaces, fulfilment, parcel tracking, and omnichannel commerce.
  
  
As Anchanto evolves toward integrated Product Business Units (PBUs), we need a leader who can run the delivery operating system of a business unit. This role combines multi-pod Scrum leadership, program delivery, resource and capacity planning, financial visibility, operational governance, and PBU administration.
  
  
This is
**not a ceremony-only Scrum Master role**
. The person is expected to independently create structure, maintain a single view of all commitments, challenge unrealistic plans, hold senior stakeholders accountable, and ensure work gets delivered with speed, predictability, and quality.
  
  
**Why This Role Exists**
The PBU model brings Product, Engineering, QA, Architecture, DevOps, Implementation, and Support closer together around a single product outcome. To make this model work, the PBU needs one owner for delivery rhythm, portfolio visibility, resource loading, risk management, operational discipline, and leadership reporting.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Agile Delivery & Scrum Leadership**

* Manage approximately 6-10 active Scrum teams or delivery pods in parallel.
* Ensure effective sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily Scrum, reviews, retrospectives, and Scrum of Scrums.
* Ensure every pod has a clear sprint goal, ready backlog, acceptance criteria, realistic capacity plan, visible dependencies, and agreed Definition of Ready and Definition of Done.
* Monitor and improve commitment reliability, cycle time, lead time, throughput, scope churn, defect leakage, release predictability, and delivery flow.
* Identify recurring blockers, delayed QA, weak Jira hygiene, and process failures, and drive corrective actions.

**Integrated Delivery & Portfolio Planning**

* Maintain one consolidated delivery plan across product roadmap, customer projects, customisations, technical debt, innovation, compliance requirements, production incidents, and L3 support.
* Maintain visibility of milestones, dependencies, delivery confidence, scope changes, customer commitments, and roadmap displacement.
* Support quarterly planning, monthly operating reviews, and major reprioritisation decisions.

**Resource Loading & Capacity Management**

* Maintain a current capacity and allocation view across Product, Engineering, QA, Architecture, DevOps, Design, Implementation, and Support.
* Identify overload, underutilisation, shared-resource conflicts, skill bottlenecks, and single points of failure.
* Recommend pod composition and practical trade-off options when capacity is insufficient.
* Track planned versus actual utilisation and explain material variance.

**Delivery Accountability & Stakeholder Leadership**

* Act as the operating owner for PBU delivery.
* Hold Product Managers, Engineering Managers, QA Leads, Architects, and stakeholders accountable for agreed actions and standards.
* Challenge unrealistic commitments, incomplete requirements, unsupported dates, and unapproved customer promises.
* Escalate unresolved issues with impact, options, recommendations, and decision requirements.

**Financial, Quality & Release Governance**

* Track planned versus actual effort, budget consumption, forecast variance, vendor cost, rework, and support cost.
* Maintain operational cost visibility for major roadmap initiatives and customer projects.
* Create and maintain release-readiness criteria covering functional completion, regression, integration, security, performance, open defects, rollback, monitoring, and support readiness.
* Track defect leakage, production incidents, release failures, and RCA closure.

**PBU Operations & Compliance**

* Coordinate onboarding, role induction, stakeholder introductions, and training for new team members.
* Coordinate employee exits, access revocation, knowledge transfer, and work reassignment.
* Maintain PBU roster, role mapping, allocation view, onboarding status, and knowledge coverage.
* Support ISO, GDPR, information security, customer audits, and compliance obligations.
* Ensure compliance actions, evidence, owners, and due dates are tracked and completed.

**Reporting & Continuous Improvement**

* Create weekly PBU operating reports covering delivery health, milestones, capacity, roadmap progress, quality, risks, and decisions required.
* Run delivery reviews, dependency reviews, release-readiness reviews, and leadership reviews.
* Ensure Jira, Confluence, RAID logs, decision logs, and dashboards serve as trusted systems of record.
* Drive automation, AI-enabled reporting, and continuous process improvement.

**Skills & Experience**

* 6+ years across software delivery, program management, project management, Agile delivery, product operations, or engineering operations.
* At least 5 years managing Agile software delivery teams.
* Experience managing multiple teams or workstreams in parallel.
* Strong experience in delivery planning, resource loading, capacity management, risk management, dependency management, and release governance.
* Experience influencing Product, Engineering, QA, and customer-facing teams without direct reporting authority.
* Strong Jira, Confluence, dashboarding, and executive reporting capability.
* Working knowledge of software development, APIs, CI/CD, testing, production support, and release management.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred Experience**

* Enterprise SaaS, B2B Software, OMS, WMS, E-commerce, Supply Chain, Logistics, or Fulfilment domain exposure.
* Experience with customer implementations, product customisation, and roadmap-versus-customer trade-offs.
* Experience managing large cross-functional teams and delivery pods.
* Exposure to ISO, GDPR, SOC2, information security, and customer audit controls.
* Experience with Power BI, Jira Advanced Roadmaps, portfolio management tools, AI-enabled delivery, and workflow automation.
* PMP, PSM, CSM, SAFe, PRINCE2, or equivalent certification.

**What This Role Is Not**

* A ceremony-only Scrum Master role.
* A Jira administrator or meeting coordinator.
* A passive follow-up or status-chasing role.
* A PMO reporting role that presents problems without recommendations.
* A substitute for Product, Engineering, Finance, or Compliance leadership functions.

**Success Measures**

* Multi-pod delivery predictability
* Delivery flow and throughput
* Quality and release health
* Capacity effectiveness
* Portfolio visibility
* Customer commitment governance
* Financial visibility and forecast accuracy
* Risk and dependency management
* Compliance readiness
* Leadership reporting effectiveness
* Automation and continuous improvement

**Benefits**
****Why Join Anchanto****
At Anchanto, we believe in creating an environment where people can build meaningful careers, continuously develop their capabilities and gain exposure to a truly global business.
  
  

* Global Exposure: Work with diverse teams, customers and stakeholders across international markets and gain experience in a global B2B SaaS environment.
* Learning & Development: We invest in our people through sponsored learning, certifications and development opportunities aligned with your professional growth.
* International & Onsite Opportunities: Client-facing roles may offer opportunities to travel and work onsite with customers across our global markets.
* Medical Insurance: Comprehensive medical insurance coverage to support you & your health and well-being.
* Comprehensive Leave Benefits: Maternity, Paternity, Marriage and Bereavement leave, along with Comp Off and flexibility to support important personal commitments.
* Recognition for Long-Term Contribution: Tenured employees are eligible for additional monetary benefits, extra paid leave and company-sponsored paid vacations as part of our commitment to recognising long-term contribution.
* Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: A supportive and flexible work environment that enables employees to manage professional responsibilities alongside personal priorities.
* Meaningful Career Growth: Take ownership of challenging, high-impact work and contribute to products and solutions that serve global brands, retailers and logistics businesses.

title: AVP / Manager, People Operations
description:
**Company Description**
As a leading global investment management firm, AB fosters diverse perspectives and embraces innovation to help our clients navigate the uncertainty of capital markets. Through high-quality research and diversified investment services, we serve institutions, individuals, and private wealth clients in major markets worldwide. Our ambition is simple: to be our clients’ most valued asset-management partner.
  
  
**Manager, People Operations**
As Manager, People Operations, you will lead a team that delivers timely, accurate, and compliant support across employee inquiries and core People processes. This role will help centralize and streamline global support by assessing current work, driving consistent ways of working, and translating the needs of People teams into scalable day-to-day execution. The ideal candidate is a hands-on HR Operations generalist who has developed within a centralized service environment and brings direct expertise in multiple specialized support areas. You will oversee daily operations, build team capability, strengthen service standards, and lead the team through growth, change, process transitions, and continuous improvement.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Lead, coach, and develop a team that supports both specialized HR administration and generalized employee lifecycle support across U.S., EMEA, and evolving global service needs.
* Provide hands-on operational leadership across benefits administration, global mobility and immigration, time off and leave administration, and vendor management support, while ensuring effective delivery of broader People services.
* Help shape and implement the future-state service delivery model by assessing current work, defining the appropriate scope for centralized support, establishing workflows, clarifying ownership, and reinforcing consistent service standards.
* Oversee day-to-day team operations, including intake, workload balancing, case prioritization, and service continuity across a growing and changing portfolio of work.
* Monitor productivity, service quality, and operational performance; identify trends, gaps, and process issues, and take action to improve outcomes and reduce risk.
* Serve as the primary escalation point for complex or sensitive employee matters, exercising sound judgment to resolve issues independently where appropriate and escalating risk, policy, or stakeholder concerns when needed.
* Ensure accurate and compliant execution through quality reviews, adherence to policies and standard operating procedures, internal controls, audit readiness, and timely corrective action.
* Maintain clear, current process documentation and standard operating procedures, particularly as work transitions into the centralized team or expands across regions.
* Build team capability through ongoing coaching, cross-training, structured knowledge transfers, and day-to-day guidance that reinforces accountability, responsiveness, and consistent service.
* Partner closely with People Business Partners, Payroll, Benefits, Legal and other key stakeholders to resolve cross-functional issues, improve handoffs, and support smooth execution of People processes.
* Use data and operational insights to identify recurring issues, capacity constraints, and service trends, and translate findings into actionable recommendations that improve efficiency, consistency, and service quality.
* Identify opportunities to standardize, streamline, and automate manual processes, improve team tools and documentation, and support the continued centralization of key People functions.
* Lead the team through process transitions, policy or system changes, and service expansion while maintaining continuity, quality, and stakeholder confidence

**What We're Looking For**

* 5+ years of progressive experience in Human Resources Operations, Shared Services, Employee Services, or a similar centralized service environment, including experience executing processes on behalf of internal stakeholders and hands-on responsibility for complex employee lifecycle work in a fast-paced organization.
* Direct experience in at least two of the following specialized areas within the U.S. and/or EMEA: benefits administration, global mobility/immigration, time off and leave of absence administration, or vendor management support. Benefits administration experience is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated leadership experience, including direct supervision, coaching, performance management, cross-training, and development of teams operating in a high-volume service environment supporting high-touch employee populations.
* Working knowledge of compliance, controls, documentation, and risk considerations associated with HR administration across the U.S. and/or EMEA.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build credibility, influence decisions, and work effectively across multiple levels of the organization.
* Sound operational judgment and discretion, with the ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, handle sensitive employee matters and escalations with accuracy and confidentiality, and escalate issues involving risk, policy, or broader stakeholder impact.
* Strong analytical and process improvement skills, including experience using operational data to identify trends, assess capacity, determine root causes, and recommend scalable solutions.
* Experience using HRIS, case management, and workflow tools to support operational effectiveness; advanced familiarity with Workday is strongly preferred.
* Ability to operate effectively in a globally connected, U.S.-based corporate environment, balancing regional requirements with consistent service standards and scalable ways of working.

title: Supervisor, Global Sample Solutions
description:
Position Summary
  
  
The Supervisor, Global Sample Solutions is responsible for overseeing and coordinating the day-to-day activities of the Global Sample Solutions Site Outreach team. The role ensures timely resolution of sample discrepancies, effective site outreach, accurate data investigations and discrepancy resolution.
  
  
The Supervisor provides operational guidance, training, workload prioritization, and escalation support to Global Sample Solutions Specialists. This position monitors key performance indicators (KPIs), turnaround time (TAT), quality, and backlog aging while partnering with cross-functional stakeholders to drive continuous improvement and operational excellence.
  
  
**Essential Functions Of The Job**
Team Leadership & Operational Oversight
  
  

* Lead, mentor, and support Global Sample Solutions Specialists responsible for site outreach, discrepancy resolution, and study support activities.
* This role will provide direct supervisory oversight for assigned team members.
* Coordinate daily workload assignments and priorities to ensure timely follow-up and closure of open discrepancies.
* Monitor team productivity, quality, KPIs, service-level expectations, and backlog aging; communicate risks and recovery plans to leadership.
* Serve as the primary escalation point for complex discrepancy investigations, customer communication challenges, and cross-functional operational issues.
* Provide onboarding, role-specific training, coaching, and ongoing development for team members.
* Conduct routine workload and quality reviews and identify opportunities to improve consistency, efficiency, and compliance.
* Partner with leadership to support resource planning, workload forecasting, and operational readiness.
* Role requires flexibility to support global time zones, including overlap with U.S. business hours as business needs require.

Customer/Site Outreach, Discrepancy Tracking & Resolution
  
  

* Maintain global oversight of unresolved discrepancies identified by internal sample management teams for incoming and outgoing shipments.
* Ensure adherence to project-specific communication plans, established outreach timelines, documentation standards, and escalation procedures.
* Liaise with sites, sponsors, CROs, clients, and internal teams to obtain missing information and facilitate timely discrepancy resolution.
* Review complex or high-impact discrepancies and guide the team on appropriate resolution actions.
* Ensure resolution actions are clearly documented and communicated to meet customer and business deliverables for TAT.
* Monitor first, second, and final outreach activities, including shipment tracking information and response status, to ensure appropriate follow-up.
* Monitor discrepancy aging and trends and implement recovery or corrective action plans when performance is at risk.
* Provide oversight for study close-out activities, including data review, outstanding query resolution, reconciliation support, and sample disposition follow-up.
* Independently prioritizes daily workload, resolves routine operational issues, and escalates high-impact risks to leadership.

Database Troubleshooting & Data Resolution Support
  
  

* Provide oversight for unresolved sample data requests, reconciliation queries, and database-related discrepancies.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders to investigate, document, and implement approved corrections for data modifications or errors.
* Support reconciliation between source documentation, sample inventory systems, clinical databases, EDC systems, and client-provided data, as applicable.
* Ensure sufficient documentation and audit trails are maintained for data corrections and resolution activities.
* Escalate system or process issues that may affect data integrity, operational timelines, or customer deliverables.

Quality Control & Compliance
  
  

* Ensure team activities comply with company SOPs, study-specific requirements, documented procedures, and applicable quality standards.
* Oversee or perform quality control reviews of outreach documentation, discrepancy resolution records, and data updates.
* Review quality findings and coordinate corrective actions, retraining, or process updates as needed.
* Maintain audit-ready documentation and support internal audits, client audits, and regulatory inspections, as required.
* Demonstrate behavior consistent with company values and promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

**Qualifications**
Education
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, clinical research, healthcare administration, business, or a related field preferred.
* An equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.

**Experience**

* Six or more years of relevant experience in sample management, clinical trial operations, laboratory operations, data management, project coordination, or a related environment preferred.
* Two or more years of experience leading people, projects, workflows, or operational initiatives preferred.
* Experience with customer- or site-facing communications, discrepancy management, issue resolution, and cross-functional coordination.
* Experience working with biospecimen inventory systems, clinical databases, reconciliation activities, or operational reporting tools preferred.

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**

* Strong leadership, coaching, workload management, and team development skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to manage sensitive or escalated customer interactions professionally.
* Strong analytical, investigative, and problem-solving capabilities with consistent attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, changing deadlines, and global stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to interpret operational data, identify trends, and translate findings into clear actions.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Office applications, reporting tools, and operational dashboards.
* Strong knowledge of data integrity, documentation, and quality principles.
* Ability to work effectively across global teams and time zones.

title: Head Production - Plant (Polymer Division)
description:
**Position Title:**
Head Production - Plant (Polymer)

**Department:**
Manufacturing / Operations

**Reports To:**
Plant Head

**Location:**
Pune

**Job Purpose:**

To lead and manage the complete production operations of the Polymer Manufacturing Plant by ensuring safe, cost-effective, high-quality, and timely production. The role is responsible for achieving business objectives related to Productivity, Quality, Cost, Delivery, Safety, and Morale (PQCDSM), driving continuous improvement initiatives, optimizing plant resources, managing cross-functional coordination, and ensuring sustainable manufacturing excellence.

Organizational Structure

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Production Planning & Execution**

* Develop and execute monthly, weekly, and daily production plans based on customer demand and business requirements.
* Ensure optimal utilization of manpower, machines, materials, and utilities.
* Monitor production output against targets and take corrective actions to achieve productivity goals.
* Lead manufacturing operations to achieve annual business targets related to volume, quality, and cost.
* Track and improve Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE), capacity utilization, and line efficiencies.
* Ensure adherence to production schedules while maintaining quality standards.

**2. Production Control & Capacity Management**

* Work closely with PPC and Supply Chain teams to ensure smooth material planning.
* Review capacity utilization and identify bottlenecks affecting productivity.
* Develop contingency plans to meet production requirements during equipment breakdowns or material shortages.
* Monitor production loading and balancing across manufacturing lines.
* Optimize changeover times and improve throughout.

**3. Polymer Manufacturing Operations Management**

* Lead all polymer processing activities including compounding, molding, extrusion, blending, finishing, and packaging operations.
* Ensure process stability and adherence to defined process parameters.
* Monitor critical polymer manufacturing parameters affecting product quality and productivity.
* Drive process standardization across production lines.
* Ensure compliance with customer specifications and regulatory requirements.

**4. Continuous Improvement & Operational Excellence**

* Drive Lean Manufacturing, TPM, Kaizen, Six Sigma, and Industry 4.0 initiatives.
* Identify improvement opportunities in cycle time, productivity, yield, and process capability.
* Partner with Manufacturing Engineering for automation and process enhancement projects.
* Lead waste elimination and value stream improvement initiatives.
* Implement digital monitoring systems for real-time production control.

**5. Cost Management & Productivity Improvement**

* Achieve annual cost reduction targets through process optimization and resource efficiency.
* Improve material yield and reduce consumption losses.
* Monitor and control variable manufacturing costs.
* Drive initiatives for:
* Energy conservation
* Consumable cost reduction
* Scrap reduction
* Manpower productivity enhancement
* Support budgeting and production cost planning activities.

**6. Quality Management**

* Ensure adherence to customer quality requirements and internal quality systems.
* Monitor key quality metrics including:
* Customer PPM
* In-House Rejection (IHR)
* Scrap Cost
* Rework Cost
* First Pass Yield
* Lead root cause analysis and corrective actions for process defects.
* Support internal and external quality audits.
* Implement process controls and statistical quality monitoring systems.

**7. Safety, Environment & Compliance**

* Drive a strong safety culture across the plant.
* Ensure compliance with EHS, statutory, and environmental requirements.
* Monitor implementation of safety systems, PPE compliance, permit systems, and risk assessments.
* Lead accident prevention initiatives and near-miss management.
* Ensure zero major safety incidents and regulatory non-compliance.
* Support sustainability and environmental improvement programs.

**8. CAPEX & Project Management**

* Identify and propose CAPEX projects for productivity, automation, quality improvement, and cost optimization.
* Support project planning, execution, commissioning, and stabilization.
* Review project ROI and productivity benefits.
* Participate in new product and process industrialization activities.
* Ensure projects are delivered within budget and timelines.

**9. Cross Functional Coordination**

**10. Team Leadership & Talent Development**

* Lead and develop production teams across shifts and departments.
* Build leadership capability among frontline managers and supervisors.
* Conduct performance reviews and succession planning.
* Identify training and development needs.
* Develop a multi-skilled workforce and improve employee engagement.
* Foster a culture of accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement.

title: Manager - Admissions & Academics
description:
**Job Title:**
Manager – Admissions & Academics

**Institution:**
MIT School of Film & Television (MIT-SFT)

**Experience:**
5 to 8+ years of relevant experience in academic administration, admissions management within higher education institutions

**Location:**
MIT Art, Design and Technology University (MIT-ADT University), Vishwa Rajbaug, Loni Kalbhor, Pune

**Job Summary**

The
**Manager – Admissions & Academics**
at the MIT School of Film & Television (MIT-SFT) plays a crucial leadership and operational role in overseeing the end-to-end academic and administrative lifecycle of the institution. This role spans managing student admissions, driving day-to-day academic administration, coordinating film/television production projects and juries, ensuring institutional compliance, and supporting marketing and student outreach initiatives.

The ideal candidate will bridge administrative rigor with a deep understanding of media and film education workflows, liaising effectively between students, faculty, university departments, and industry leaders.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Admissions & Student Coordination**

* **Admission Management:**
  Coordinate and manage the complete admissions lifecycle for Film and Television programs in direct collaboration with the Central Admissions Department.
* **Eligibility Verification:**
  Liaise with the Eligibility Section to ensure timely document verification, eligibility processing, and compliance for incoming students.
* **Financial & Fee Coordination:**
  Work closely with the Accounts Department regarding student fee payments, installment queries, fee reconciliations, and enrollment formalities.
* **Student & Department Liaison:**
  Serve as a central communication link between students, faculty members, and university departments to resolve academic and administrative queries efficiently.

**2. Academic Administration & Program Implementation**

* **Curriculum Delivery:**
  Coordinate the implementation of the prescribed curriculum and syllabi for Film and Television streams in consultation with respective Heads of Departments (HoDs).
* **Day-to-Day Academic Operations:**
  Manage daily academic administration, including master timetables, class scheduling, faculty allocation coordination, and continuous activity monitoring.
* **Guest Sessions & Masterclasses:**
  Collaborate with HoDs and visiting/guest faculty members to plan and execute guest lectures, industry workshops, masterclasses, and specialized academic sessions.
* **Academic Calendar Adherence:**
  Track the progress of academic activities to ensure strict adherence to the approved academic calendar, curriculum standards, and institutional guidelines.
* **Examination & Evaluation Support:**
  Coordinate with the Controller of Examinations for semester-end examinations, evaluation schedules, result declarations, and convocation activities.

**3. Projects, Juries & Production Coordination**

* **Project & Jury Management:**
  Plan, organize, and coordinate semester-end projects, jury assessments, showcase presentations, and student evaluations.
* **Production Logistics Alignment:**
  Partner with HoDs, faculty members, and the Production Coordinator to plan, schedule, and execute practical academic projects and production workflows.
* **Guidelines & Operational Procedures:**
  Develop and implement project guidelines, submission protocols, assessment schedules, and operational procedures in consultation with HoDs and the Production Coordinator.
* **Progress Tracking & Record Keeping:**
  Track student project progress, maintain accurate academic and production records, and ensure timely completion and submission of projects as per institutional deadlines.

**4. Academic Governance & Institutional Coordination**

* **Statutory & Board of Studies Support:**
  Coordinate with the Office of the Registrar regarding the Board of Studies (BoS), regulatory documentation, statutory compliance, and administrative reporting.
* **Record Management:**
  Maintain meticulous and up-to-date documentation concerning admissions, class schedules, examination results, jury reports, guest faculty sessions, and administrative records.
* **Interdepartmental Synergy:**
  Facilitate seamless cross-functional coordination across departments to ensure efficient academic and operational workflows within MIT-SFT.

**5. Promotion, Marketing & Institutional Outreach**

* **Program Marketing:**
  Collaborate with the Central Promotional and Marketing Department of MIT-ADT University to promote and market the Film and Television programs.
* **Outreach & Admission Campaigns:**
  Support admission-oriented promotional drives, institutional outreach, program publicity, student engagement events, and approved marketing campaigns.
* **Content & Showcase Sharing:**
  Gather and share academic achievements, student project highlights, award wins, and program updates with internal and external communication teams for promotional purposes.

**6. Reporting & Governance**

* **Executive Reporting:**
  Prepare and submit regular progress reports regarding admissions, academic milestones, student project evaluations, and examination outcomes to the Deputy Director and Dean, MIT-SFT.
* **Regulatory Compliance:**
  Ensure strict adherence to university policies, academic regulations, administrative standard operating procedures (SOPs), and directives from competent authorities.
* **Additional Duties:**
  Perform other academic, operational, or administrative tasks assigned by the Deputy Director, Dean, or university officials in the interest of MIT-SFT and MIT-ADT University.

**Candidate Profile & Qualifications**

**Education & Experience**

* **Education:**
  Master’s degree in Management, Business Administration, Mass Communication, Media Management, Film Studies, Education Administration, or a related field from a recognized university.
* **Experience:**
  5 to 8+ years of relevant experience in academic administration, admissions management, or program management within higher education institutions (experience in creative arts, film, design, or media institutes is highly desirable).

**Key Competencies & Skills**

* **Academic & Administrative Management:**
  In-depth knowledge of university governance, examination processes, academic calendars, and Board of Studies frameworks.
* **Production & Project Coordination:**
  Familiarity with the operational workflows of film/television student productions, studio schedules, and jury evaluation procedures.
* **Stakeholder Management:**
  Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to liaise effectively across diverse groups—students, academic staff, university leadership, and visiting industry professionals.
* **Communication & Marketing Skills:**
  Excellent verbal and written communication skills with an aptitude for marketing support and institutional communication.
* **Organization & Attention to Detail:**
  Outstanding organizational, multi-tasking, record-keeping, and problem-solving skills.
* **Technical Proficiency:**
  Proficiency in Education Management Systems / ERPs, Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint), and modern digital workplace tools.

**How to Apply:**

Interested candidates should send their updated CVs to
**hr.resume@mituniversity.edu.in**

description:

* Experience training and maintaining quality standards at scale.

Palmonas is a modern demi-fine jewellery brand redefining everyday luxury through stylish, high-quality, and accessible jewellery. We are committed to delivering exceptional customer experiences

through our products, services, and customer interactions.

Role Overview

We are looking for a proactive and customer-focused
**Team Lead – Customer Service**
to manage daily customer service operations, lead a team of customer service executives, and ensure timely and effective resolution of customer queries. The ideal candidate should have experience in team handling, customer escalations, service quality monitoring, and performance management, preferably in the D2C, e-commerce, retail, or jewellery industry.

* Average Resolution Time

* Quality Scores

* Strong problem-solving, decision-making, and conflict-resolution abilities.

* Good analytical skills and proficiency in preparing reports and tracking KPIs.
* Customer-centric mindset with a focus on service excellence.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced D2C or e-commerce environment.
* Proficiency in MS Excel or Google Sheets and customer support tools or CRM platforms.

Educational Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, or a related field.
* Additional qualifications in customer experience or service management will be an advantage.

Experience Required

* 3–5 years of experience in customer service, customer support, or customer experience.
* At least 1–2 years of experience managing or leading a customer service team.
* Experience in D2C, e-commerce, retail, or consumer brands will be preferred.

Key Success Metrics

* Improvement in customer satisfaction and service quality.
* Achievement of team productivity and resolution targets.
* Reduction in customer complaints and escalations.
* Adherence to response and resolution TATs.
* Improved first-contact resolution and reduced ticket backlog.
* Effective team performance management and employee development.

title: Manager, AI/HPC Infrastructure Technical Delivery — India
description:
Are you a technically seasoned leader with a passion for driving excellence in AI, HPC, and data center infrastructure delivery? Do you thrive in leading technical teams to build and deploy some of the world’s largest and fastest AI/HPC systems across the India region? At NVIDIA, we are revolutionizing deep learning, data analytics, and data center capabilities, and we are seeking a Senior Technical Delivery Manager (People Manager) to oversee a team of technical specialists—with end-to-end technical control over Ethernet, InfiniBand, HPC, and AI cluster delivery across APAC. This role requires a strong technical background in NVIDIA DC products (Networking, InfiniBand, AI orchestration tools), full-stack data center technologies (storage, server, networking, virtualization, GPU), and deep understanding of AI technology, paired with proven people management skills to lead a team of a few to dozens of technical professionals. Additionally, you are expected to have a solid grasp of the the region's business model, as well as experience engaging with the customers closely.
  
  
As a key leader in NVIDIA’s Infrastructure Specialist Team, you will serve as the Senior Technical Delivery Manager, owning people management for a team of Senior Networking (Eth/IB/AI/HPC) Solutions Architects and technical specialists, while providing overall technical control for all InfiniBand, HPC, and AI cluster delivery projects in the India and APAC region. You will balance team leadership, technical oversight, and customer-centric delivery—leveraging your understanding of the APAC business model and Chinese customer needs—to ensure alignment with NVIDIA’s strategic goals and maintain the highest standards of technical excellence and customer satisfaction. Your deep expertise in AI technology and full-stack DC technologies (storage, server, networking, virtualization, GPU) will be critical to guiding the team and delivering successful projects.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing**

* Lead, manage, and develop a high-performing technical team (size: a few to dozens of members) of Senior Networking (ETH/IB) Solutions Architects and technical specialists, overseeing the full people management lifecycle—hiring, onboarding, performance management, career development, coaching, and retention—fostering a collaborative, technically driven team culture. Provide overall technical control for all InfiniBand, HPC, and AI cluster delivery projects in the region, ensuring technical excellence, adherence to NVIDIA DC product standards, and alignment with customer requirements.
* Oversee the design, deployment, and operational reliability of large-scale AI/HPC infrastructure for new and existing customers in India and APAC, with a focus on InfiniBand networking, HPC clusters, and AI orchestration tools (e.g., BCM - Base Command Manager).
* Lead technical decision-making for complex delivery projects, leveraging your deep understanding of AI technology and full-stack DC technologies (storage, server, networking, virtualization, GPU) to resolve critical technical challenges related to InfiniBand networks, data center architecture, network automation, and GPU-accelerated infrastructure.
* Drive continuous improvement in delivery processes, leveraging your deep technical expertise to optimize workflows for network provisioning, system design, automation, and post-deployment support (monitoring, logging, alerting).
* Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams (engineering, sales, product, support) to align technical delivery strategies with NVIDIA’s product roadmap, especially for NVIDIA DC products (networking, InfiniBand, AI orchestration tools).
* Build and maintain trusted relationships with key customers (including Chinese customers) and partners across India and APAC, leveraging your understanding of the India business model and bilingual communication skills to serve as the technical leadership point of contact for large-scale AI/HPC delivery projects and address strategic technical and business needs.
* Ensure the team adheres to technical best practices, compliance standards, and NVIDIA’s quality requirements, while driving accountability for project delivery timelines, budgets, and customer satisfaction.
* Monitor team performance, track project progress, and communicate technical delivery status, challenges, and solutions to senior leadership in a clear, data-driven manner.

**What We Need To See**

* BS/MS/PhD or equivalent professional experience in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or a related technical field.
* 10+ years of progressive technical experience in data center infrastructure, or equivalent experience, and 5+ years of people management experience leading a technical team (size: 10 or more members).
* Strong technical background in NVIDIA DC products (networking solutions, InfiniBand, AI orchestration tools, e.g., BCM - Base Command Manager), GPU-accelerated infrastructure, and full-stack data center technologies including storage, server, networking, virtualization. Additionally, a deep understanding of AI technology and its integration with DC infrastructure is required.
* Deep expertise in networking fundamentals, TCP/IP stack, data center architecture, and InfiniBand networks—with hands-on experience in medium to large-scale HPC/AI environments.
* Demonstrated experience overseeing end-to-end technical delivery of large-scale AI/HPC infrastructure projects, with a focus on performance, reliability, and customer satisfaction.
* Strong people management skills: ability to lead, coach, and develop technical teams, foster collaboration, and drive accountability in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
* Excellent customer-facing and communication skills (verbal and written in both languages), enabling effective engagement with customers (including Chinese customers), partners, and cross-functional teams across the India region.
* A solid understanding of the India business model to address their unique technical and business requirements. Ability to support regional delivery needs and collaborate across time zones.
* Proven track record of resolving complex technical challenges and driving continuous improvement in technical delivery processes.
* Self-motivated, results-driven, and able to balance technical oversight with people management responsibilities.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Linux or Networking Certifications (e.g., CCNP, CCIE, HCIE) or NVIDIA-related certifications.
* Extensive experience with HPC job schedulers (Slurm, PBS) and cluster management technologies (BCM - Base Command Manager is a strong plus).
* Experience leading technical teams in a professional services or tech vendor environment, with a focus on top CSP/Cloud/Hyper-Scale customers in the India.
* Deep understanding of AI/ML workloads, their integration with HPC/InfiniBand infrastructure, and full-stack DC technologies (storage, server, networking, virtualization, GPU)—with hands-on experience optimizing performance for GPU-accelerated systems.

title: SOC Lead
description:
**About the job**

At
**Helius Technologies**
, we help organisations deliver technology outcomes that work in the real world.

Our teams support complex technology initiatives across
**Asia and the Middle East**
, particularly in regulated and enterprise environments where reliability, governance, and execution matter.

Our focus is simple:
**to be a trusted partner in technology transformation — delivering outcomes reliably and built to last.**

We are currently looking for a [
**SOC Lead**
] to join our team in [
**Pune**
].

In this role, you will work with engineering teams, stakeholders, and delivery leads to support the execution of technology initiatives. The role is suited to professionals who combine strong technical capability with a structured and accountable approach to delivery.

If you are interested in opportunities with Helius, you may apply through the relevant job listing or share your profile with us at
**dilip@helius-tech.com**
.

We value individuals who bring depth, accountability, and a strong commitment to quality.

We are looking for a senior security professional to lead our Security Operations Centre. The SOC Lead owns detection quality, incident response outcomes and analyst capability. Depth in SOC operations is non-negotiable, but this role also requires solid breadth — you should be able to read a VAPT report and judge which findings actually matter, discuss network and infrastructure design with the engineering teams, and translate all of it into detection coverage and risk conversations with senior stakeholders. This is a hands-on leadership role, not a purely managerial one.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES – SOC OPERATIONS & LEADERSHIP**

* Own end-to-end 24x7 SOC operations — shift rostering, escalation matrix, workload distribution, quality review and SLA / SLO adherence across enterprise and multi-tenant client environments.
* Act as the final technical escalation point for L1 and L2, and take incident command during major or high-severity incidents.
* Own the incident response process — playbooks, containment and eradication decisions, root cause analysis, post-incident review and lessons-learned tracking.
* Define, track and report SOC KPIs and metrics: MTTD, MTTR, alert volume and disposition, false positive ratio, detection coverage, log source health and analyst productivity.
* Present incident, threat and performance briefings to senior management and client stakeholders; own monthly and quarterly governance reporting.
* Recruit, mentor, train and appraise analysts; define competency matrices, training paths and certification plans; run internal knowledge-sharing and tabletop exercises.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES – DETECTION, THREAT & PLATFORM**

* Own the detection engineering roadmap and use-case lifecycle — requirement gathering, development, testing, tuning, versioning and retirement — across FortiSIEM, Elastic Security and other platforms.
* Review and approve parsers, correlation rules, Sigma rules and log source onboarding designs built by the L2 team.
* Lead the threat hunting programme and purple-team exercises; validate and continuously improve detection coverage against MITRE ATT&CK.
* Own SIEM platform architecture, sizing, EPS and licence management, upgrades, integrations and overall health.
* Drive SOAR adoption and automation to reduce manual analyst effort and shorten response times.
* Consume and operationalise threat intelligence — feeds, IOC management, sector-specific threat briefs and proactive advisories.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES – VAPT, NETWORK & INFRASTRUCTURE INTERFACE**

* Review VAPT and vulnerability assessment output; correlate findings with detection coverage, asset criticality and exploitability to prioritise real risk.
* Advise network and infrastructure teams on segmentation, hardening, logging requirements and control gaps identified during investigations.
* Contribute to security architecture reviews for new applications, infrastructure and cloud workloads.
* Own the vulnerability management governance loop — tracking, escalation, exception management and closure verification.
* Support audits and compliance programmes — ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, SOC 2, RBI / SEBI frameworks — including evidence, control mapping and auditor interaction.

Important Note:

> Please share your resume in word format with dilip@helius-tech.com

> Important Note: If this requirement is not a match for you please refer to your friends.

> Interested professionals can reach out to me for Confidential Discussion @ +65- 9060-4050.

Best Regards,

Dilip Kumar Daga

* Protect committed measures by resolving roadblocks, minimizing measure melting and ensuring high-value opportunities are visible and monitored.
* Partner with key cross-functional teams on sourcing optimization, supplier innovation, standardization, value engineering and make-vs-buy opportunities, with the goal of creating PPC Net and PPC TAC opportunities.
* Ensure accurate, timely and auditable governance across productivity systems and frameworks such as but not limited to PRIMO, PRIONEER, OPW etc; be the controller of Procurement measures across these systems.

* Experience with turbomachinery or related rotating equipment and associated auxiliary systems are beneficial
* Working knowledge of how design, technical, automation, sourcing, and logistics decisions affect cost and/or schedule.
* MS Office Suite proficiency and data analytics
* Solid knowledge within the fields of State-of-the-art Design to Value, Design to Cost Customer Value und Cost-Analysis
* Demonstrated measurable savings delivery and knowledge of strategic sourcing, value engineering, negotiation and Total Cost of Ownership.

Advanced business English; Lean or Six Sigma experience and international travel flexibility are advantageous.
  
  
**Success Measures**
Achievement of CP productivity commitments; sufficient PPC Net and Tactical pipeline coverage; timely financial realization; minimal measure melting; strong governance quality; transparent management reporting; and broader adoption of productivity tools, ownership and continuous value-creation behaviors

 Polo Wealth is a specialized financial services group that partners with clients to manage and strengthen their financial departments. Founded by three partners with a combined 70\+ years of experience, the firm brings deep expertise across multiple wealth management solutions. Core service areas include mutual fund distribution, PMS/AIF distribution, bonds distribution, and private equity. Polo Wealth also provides support in estate planning through wills and trusts, as well as tailored solutions for NRI investments. The team focuses on delivering professional, client\-centric advice and long\-term financial strategies.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Service Manager, Wealth Management will oversee day\-to\-day client service operations, ensuring high\-quality delivery of Polo Wealth’s investment and advisory offerings. This full\-time, on\-site role in the Pune Division includes managing client portfolios in coordination with advisors, responding to client inquiries, and providing timely information on mutual funds, PMS/AIF, bonds, private equity, and NRI investment products. The role involves coordinating account opening and documentation, monitoring transactions, and resolving service issues in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders. The Service Manager will maintain accurate records, prepare periodic reports, and support compliance requirements across all wealth management services. This position requires active engagement with clients, proactive follow\-up, and continuous improvement of service processes.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong client service and relationship management abilities, with experience supporting wealth management or financial services clients.
* Knowledge of investment products such as mutual funds, PMS/AIF, bonds, private equity, and NRI investment solutions.
* Proficiency in operational processes including documentation, transaction processing, and records management.
* Solid analytical and numerical skills, with the ability to interpret investment data and prepare clear client reports.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills, including professional written and verbal communication in English.
* Comfort with financial software, CRM tools, and standard office applications (e.g., Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
* Ability to work on\-site in the Pune Division, manage multiple priorities, and maintain attention to detail under deadlines.
* Bachelor’s degree in finance, commerce, business, or a related field; relevant certifications in wealth management or investments are an advantage.
* Prior experience in a service management, operations, or client\-facing role within wealth management, banking, or financial advisory is preferred.

title: Manager, Product Development - EMV and Payment Technology
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Manager, Product Development \- EMV and Payment Technology
   

  

**Overview**
 Mastercard delivers robust, high quality, and fully approved technology products that enable issuers, acquirers, and partners to bring secure and innovative payment solutions to market.
   

  

 Within the Chip Engineering organization, the Product Approval Team plays a critical role in ensuring that these products—ranging from cardholder and acceptance devices to Wallet UIs, mobile applications, and back end systems—meet Mastercard standards and are delivered on time.
   

  

 This role provides the opportunity to work globally across a wide spectrum of products, including device\-based solutions, wearables, mobile payment applications, cloud based payment systems, transit solutions, and backend services.
   

  

 \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
   

  

 Major Responsibilities
   

  

 Operational Management
   

  

* Lead and manage operations related to Mobile Payment Applications, Wallet UI, Wearables, and Back\-End Server Approvals.
* Ensure full compliance with Mastercard testing, branding, approval processes, and operational rules.
* Oversee the execution of global approval processes and associated requirements for:
* Wallet UI and Wearables
* Merchant Presented QR (MPQR)
* Cloud\-Based Payments (MCBP)
* Token Service Providers (TSP)
* Trusted Service Managers (TSM) for SE/TEE\-based solutions
* Link with MDES, GVCP and PCI teams to ensure all pre\-requisites are met
* As a backup, manage operations related to Tap\-on\-phone Product Approvals


 Vendor, Partner \& Customer Engagement
   

  

* Act as a primary interface with key external partners, vendors, developers, and customers.
* Organize and lead weekly calls with stakeholders to track progress and resolve issues.
* Manage modifications to vendor contracts or agreements, engaging legal when required.


 Accredited Laboratory Management
   

  

* Manage the Global Test Bench Identifier (GTBI) tool and ensure timely delivery to labs.


 Data, Reporting \& Process Automation
   

  

* Maintain product approval databases and tracking files, proposing and implementing continuous improvement ideas.
* Implement AI/Agent in our daily support activities and operations (when possible).
* Visual Basic developments to automate workflows and accelerate approval operations.
* Provide management with quarterly reports covering SLAs, approval volumes, KPIs, and key statistics.
* Manage bi\-weekly internal approved products report
* Manage publications on Mastercard Connect
* Contribute to communiqués outlining process changes and enhancements.


 Regional Support
   

  

* Support Mastercard Regional teams regarding product approval processes and product migration topics.


 \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
   

  

**Required Skills \& Experience**
 Education
   

  

* University degree in Engineering or equivalent practical experience; advanced degree preferred.


 Professional Background
   

  

* 9\+ years’ experience in quality assurance, project management, or business process engineering.
* Industry exposure in one or more of the following: software development, financial services, telecom/mobile, e commerce.


 Technical \& Domain Expertise
   

  

* Strong understanding of digital payment systems.
* In depth knowledge of chip card technology and EMV specifications.
* Familiarity with testing and approval methodologies is essential.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially Access; Visual Basic development experience required.


 Core Skills
   

  

* Excellent analytical and business writing skills.
* Strong project management capabilities with the ability to lead cross\-functional initiatives without direct authority.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and global stakeholder relationships.
* Business acumen and ability to provide solutions while managing customer expectations.
* Strong presentation and communication skills, with clarity in explaining concepts and processes.
* Self motivated with a strong record of success in team\-based environments.
* Excellent command of English (Mandarin if possible), both spoken and written.


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: REGIONAL IS OPERATIONS LEADER - R&D APAC
description:
Hungry for challenges? Join a group with innovation at its heart and contribute to the automotive revolution!
   

  

 OPmobility is a world\-leading provider of innovative solutions for a unique, safer and more sustainable mobility experience. Innovation\-driven since its creation, the Group develops and produces intelligent exterior systems, customized complex modules, lighting systems, clean energy systems and electrification solutions for all mobility companies. With a €11\.4 billion economic revenue in 2023, a global network of 152 plants and 40 R\&D centers, OPmobility relies on its 40,300 employees to meet the challenges of transforming mobility.
   

  

 Our ambition? Provide automakers with cutting\-edge equipment and solutions to develop tomorrow’s clean and connected car.
   

  

 Reporting directly to the Regional IS operations Manager APAC and functionally to the Global IS Operations Manager \- R\&D, the
 **Regional IS Operations Leader APAC** 
 will o versee the IS operation service delivery for his region and communicate regularly in relevant regional instances, especially to deploy Group IS/IT policies, standards, and procedure level to R\&D stakeholders.
   

  

 He/she will a ct as the IS R\&D operations representative for his region in IS operation R\&D committees . For local applications support, he/she will ensure smooth coordination between Global IS Product Operations, Central Services Teams, and AMER regional teams to maintain business continuity, i dentify risks, bottlenecks, and improvement opportunities in operational processes of his region.
   

  

**Main activities**
**Preventive maintenance / Continuous improvement**
* Analyse user survey for his region, identify improvement action, drive some of them
* Analyse usage monitoring of licenses in his region and propose some actions plan to minimize license denials , including but not limited to communication of best practice for usage, change in license mix, purchase of new license


**Incident \& Service request management**
* Critical incident management: mobilize and lead task force until resolution of major IS incidents in his time zone in a timely manner, with appropriate escalation. Communicate status regularly to users and R\&D / D\&IS management. Create Major Breakdown reports after resolution with lesson learnt and action plan to avoid same incident again and/or increase resolution time
* Non\-critical incidents/service requests : manage some non\-critical incidents/service requests directly, as exception in case of peak.
* Continuous improvement: provide monthly analysis of incident and service request service performance in his region, and propose some improvement actions, aligned with AMS partners.


**Standard Change Management**
* Regional changes: manage urgent standard changes for the region, ensuring risk assessment, coordination, and timely execution, following governance and standards.
* All changes: validate operational readiness for his region before change implementation, account for appropriate communication to impacted users and their management.
* Track and report regional change performance, propose some improvement actions / drive some of them


**Project build\-to\-run process**
* Local projects : Ensure regional projects and evolutions handovers are executed following the Build\-to\-Run framework, propose changes to R\&D IS CAB (Change Advisory Boards)
* Global projects : s upport local testing (eg performance testing), acceptance, and onboarding new services into operations, represent his region in R\&D IS CABs\*


**Required Profile And Experience**
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in information systems, Computer Science, or equivalent
* ITIL V3 or 4 certification (Service Operations or Service Management) preferred.
* Project Management or Service Delivery Management certification (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2\) is an advantage.
* At least 6–8 years of IT Operations experience, including 3 years in service delivery management.
* Proven experience managing SLAs and KPIs in a regional or global IS service context.
* Demonstrated success in coordinating Build\-to\-Run transitions and operational readiness


 As a responsible company, OPmobility pays particular attention to diversity and equality within its teams and the Group commits to treat all job applications equally.

 The Sr Lead, Service Delivery \- IT Service Desk is responsible for managing global IT Service Desk operations and ensuring the delivery of high\-quality support services to Northern Trust employees and contractors. title: Service Desk Manager - Pune, India
description:
**Brief Description**
 We're looking for a Service Desk Manager with a strong technical support background to lead the day\-to\-day operations of our Service Desk. You'll drive first line and escalation support performance, keep incident and ticket management sharp, and build a team of technically skilled analysts who deliver excellent customer outcomes, all while acting as the go\-to escalation point when things get critical.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

* Lead and develop a team of technical and non\-technical support analysts, ensuring they're fully trained across all supported systems, platforms, and processes
* Own the team's technical performance call/ticket quality, first\-contact resolution, productivity, and adherence to SLAs
* Manage shift rosters and resourcing to maintain 24/7 coverage, including on\-call and after\-hours support
* Monitor incident and ticket management against defined ITSM processes, identifying technical skill gaps and rolling out targeted training
* Own onboarding and technical readiness for new services and customers transitioning into the Service Desk, ensuring a smooth path to steady state support
* Act as Escalation Manager for incidents and service impacting issues, driving technical triage, coordinating with resolver groups, and keeping stakeholders updated until resolution.
* Lead root cause analysis on recurring issues.
* Manage performance against KPIs, feedback, and monthly 1:1s
* Stay current on the technologies and platforms your team supports, and keep building your own technical depth.


**Requirements**
 What You'll Bring
   

  

* 5\+ years' experience managing a Service Desk or technical support team in an IT Services environment
* Solid hands\-on background in technical/IT support you understand the systems your team troubleshoots, not just the process around them
* Strong knowledge of ITSM ticketing and call management systems (ServiceNow experience)
* Experience in incident management, root cause analysis, and escalation handling
* Proven people management experience leading a large technical team
* Strong stakeholder management and the ability to translate technical issues for non\-technical audiences
* Analytical mindset comfortable deep\-diving into technical/performance data as well as owning the bigger strategic picture
* ITIL Foundation certification (minimum)


 A Few Things to Know
   

  

 This role supports a 24/7 service desk, so flexibility for out\-of\-hours emergencies, escalations, and on\-call rotations is essential. You'll lead from the front line, working hands\-on with your team's technical queue while collaborating with an internationally distributed team across multiple time zones.
