title: General Manager/Assistant General Manager - Resort Management at Manori
description:
Role Overview: The General Manager (GM) is responsible for end\-to\-end management of the resort, including administration, day\-to\-day operations, legal and statutory compliance, guest experience, and business growth. The GM will work closely with the owners/management to execute innovative ideas that enhance revenue, profitability, and brand positioning of the resort. Key Responsibilities: 1\. Overall Resort Administration. Lead and manage all departments: Front Office, Housekeeping, F\&B, Kitchen, Spa/Activities, Security, Engineering, Finance, HR and Stores.
 


* Develop and implement SOPs for all operational areas to ensure consistency, efficiency and high service standards.
* Set annual and monthly operational targets and monitor performance against KPIs (occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, guest satisfaction, costs, etc.).



  





 2\. Day\-to\-Day OperationsOversee daily operations to ensure smooth functioning of the resort across all shifts.
 


* Resolve operational bottlenecks quickly and maintain high standards of cleanliness, safety, and guest service.
* Conduct daily/weekly departmental review meetings and ensure coordination between teams.
* Monitor procurement, inventory and cost control for food, beverages, linens, amenities and other supplies.



  





 3\. Legal, Licensing and Statutory ComplianceEnsure all licenses and registrations (hospitality, FSSAI, liquor, local tourism, pollution control, fire safety, music/entertainment, etc.) are valid, renewed on time and properly documented.
 


* Ensure compliance with local, state and national laws related to labour, wages, ESI, PF, safety and environmental norms.
* Coordinate with legal advisors, chartered accountants and company secretaries to maintain statutory records and filings.
* Handle inspections, audits and visits from government or regulatory authorities, ensuring full cooperation and zero non\-compliance.



  





 4\. Financial Management and ProfitabilityPrepare and manage annual budgets, forecasts and monthly MIS reports in coordination with Finance.
 


* Track revenue streams (rooms, F\&B, banquets, events, activities, spa, ancillary services) and drive strategies to increase yield and profitability.
* Implement cost\-control measures without compromising guest experience and brand standards.
* Review P\&L statements regularly and recommend corrective actions to management.



  





 5\. Revenue Growth, Sales \& Marketing SupportCollaborate with the sales and marketing team/agency on room packages, events, retreats, weddings, conferences and other offerings to boost occupancy and average rates.
 


* Support digital marketing and OTA strategies (website, social media, Google, booking portals) by providing inputs on promotions, guest stories, visual content and campaigns.
* Build and maintain relationships with travel agents, corporates, event planners and local partners to drive business.
* Monitor competitor activity, market trends and guest feedback to refine pricing and positioning.



  





 6\. Innovation, Business Renovation \& Brand BuildingWork with management to identify and execute innovative, creative ideas to upgrade the resort’s product, services and experiences (e.g., themed experiences, wellness retreats, eco\-friendly initiatives, local cultural programs).
 


* Plan and oversee renovation, refurbishment and modernization projects in coordination with architects, vendors and contractors.
* Introduce new revenue streams (activities, curated experiences, memberships, partnerships, merchandise, etc.) aligned with the brand.
* Ensure the resort aligns with a clear brand story and guest value proposition, and that this is reflected in service, décor, communication and guest interactions.



  




* 7\. Guest Experience and Service QualityEnsure a guest\-centric culture in the resort, with consistent, warm and professional service.
* Personally handle VIP guests, important groups and escalated complaints to ensure quick resolution and delight.

title: Demand Planning and Supply Chain Lead
description:
**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. Procurement Management** 



* Take over manufacturer/vendor coordination after NPD finalizes the product, costing, and first product details.
* Release purchase orders and maintain accurate PO trackers.
* Coordinate with vendors for production timelines, dispatch timelines, quantities, and delivery commitments.
* Manage repeat orders and future PO processing based on inventory requirements.
* Coordinate on MOQ, delivery timelines, payment terms, and commercial terms where required.
* Track vendor\-wise lead times, production capacity, and delivery adherence.
* Escalate vendor delays, short supply, quality issues, cost changes, or documentation gaps on time.
* Work with Finance for payment planning and working capital alignment.



**2\. Inventory Planning** 



* Maintain SKU\-wise and platform\-wise inventory plans across brands and channels.
* Track current stock, in\-transit stock, platform stock, 3PL stock, blocked stock, and available stock.
* Monitor inventory days at SKU, brand, platform, and company level.
* Maintain target inventory days around 60 days, adjusted by SKU type, lead time, MOQ, sales velocity, and campaign plans.
* Track 7\-day, 15\-day, and 30\-day average sales velocity for important SKUs.
* Predict expected stockout dates and raise reorder alerts before risk becomes urgent.
* Prepare reorder plans based on sales velocity, lead time, safety stock, vendor timelines, and platform inward timelines.
* Identify excess stock, slow\-moving stock, dead stock, and inventory above 60/90 days.
* Prepare purchase priority lists based on sales, margin, stockout risk, campaign importance, and cash flow.



**3\. Fulfilment \& Platform Delivery** 



* Plan timely pickup of stock from manufacturers/vendors.
* Coordinate with transporters, 3PLs, platform teams, and internal stakeholders.
* Ensure stock reaches the correct warehouse, 3PL, or platform on time.
* Manage Amazon, Flipkart, Quick Commerce, D2C, MT, GT, and other platform replenishment requirements.
* Own appointment booking and appointment follow\-ups for platform deliveries.
* Track dispatch date, delivery date, GRN/inward date, and live stock date.
* Ensure stock is not only dispatched but also inwarded and available for sale.
* Track delayed appointments, rejected shipments, short deliveries, damaged deliveries, and pending GRNs.
* Coordinate inter\-warehouse stock transfers where required.



**4\. NPD to Supply Chain Handover** 




 The Supply Chain Lead must ensure that every new product handover includes: 
 


* Final vendor/manufacturer details, final approved costing, MOQ, lead time, payment terms, and production timeline.
* Final product specifications, packaging specifications, product dimensions, weight, barcode/MRP, and batch details.
* Shelf life and expiry details wherever applicable.
* QC checklist, first PO recommendation, expected launch date, initial inventory requirement, and platform\-wise launch stock plan.
* No PO should be released unless the NPD handover is complete.



  





**Ideal Candidate Profile** 




 The ideal candidate should not be only a procurement person or only a dispatch coordinator. This person should understand the full supply chain cycle and be able to connect vendor timelines, inventory days, platform stock, appointments, cash flow, and sales impact. 
 



**The person should think like a planner, execute like an operator, and follow up like an owner.**

 Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
   

  

 With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

title: RCM Associate Manager - Quality
description:
**Job Description Summary**
 The Associate Manager – Quality, RCM is responsible for leading, monitoring, and continuously improving the quality assurance function within Revenue Cycle Management operations. This is a people\-plus\-process leadership role that combines hands\-on audit governance with team management, client engagement, and strategic quality improvement.
   

  

 You will serve as the primary quality ambassador between operations, clients, and senior leadership — ensuring compliance with payer guidelines, HIPAA regulations, and internal SOPs while driving performance excellence across all QA analysts. You will own the quality scorecard, shape audit strategy, and build a culture of accountability and continuous learning within your team.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Quality Oversight \& Governance**
* Own and enforce quality benchmarks across all RCM functions — coding, billing, AR follow\-up, denial management, and payment posting
* Establish and maintain quality control checkpoints at each stage of the revenue cycle workflow
* Ensure 100% alignment with CMS guidelines, payer\-specific rules, client contractual obligations, and HIPAA/PHI regulations
* Define and manage the monthly/quarterly audit plan, sampling strategies, and QA frameworks


**Audit Management \& Root Cause Analysis**
* Oversee daily, weekly, and monthly transaction audits and calibration sessions across all RCM verticals
* Drive root cause analysis (RCA) for all identified errors and ensure actionable corrective plans are documented and tracked
* Maintain comprehensive audit trails and error logs for regulatory and client review
* Identify recurring defect patterns and escalate critical findings to operations leadership with data\-backed reports


**Team Leadership \& People Management**
* Lead, mentor, coach, and manage a team of 20\+ QA analysts, ensuring equitable workload distribution and professional growth
* Facilitate regular team huddles, one\-on\-one feedback sessions, and calibration meetings to promote a quality\-first culture
* Identify skill gaps through error trend analysis and develop targeted coaching and upskilling plans
* Act as the first point of escalation for QA analysts and provide real\-time guidance and support
* Participate in monthly/quarterly performance reviews for all QA team members in coordination with HR


**Performance Management \& Analytics**
* Track, analyze, and report quality metrics including accuracy rates, defect rates, rework rates, and SLA adherence
* Manage and implement corrective action plans (CAPs) for underperforming analysts and processes
* Align team KPIs with organizational quality goals and report progress to senior leadership
* Monitor Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ) and drive year\-on\-year reduction targets


**Process Improvement \& Innovation**
* Drive continuous improvement (CI) initiatives to reduce defects, rework, and COPQ using Lean/Six Sigma methodologies
* Design and optimize QA workflows, sampling strategies, and feedback loop mechanisms
* Collaborate with operations, IT, and training teams to implement process changes that improve first\-pass accuracy rates
* Evaluate and pilot quality improvement technologies (e.g., AI\-powered auditing tools, automation)


**Client Engagement \& Stakeholder Management**
* Lead and participate in client quality calls, review meetings, and audits — presenting quality metrics, trends, and action plans
* Manage and resolve client escalations related to quality issues within defined SLAs
* Support client\-specific onboarding by documenting payer rules, quality requirements, and SOPs
* Build and maintain strong client relationships by ensuring consistent delivery of quality benchmarks


**Reporting, Documentation \& Compliance**
* Prepare and share daily/weekly/monthly quality MIS reports, scorecards, and dashboards with leadership
* Maintain up\-to\-date QA SOPs, error category definitions, calibration logs, and feedback templates
* Design and deliver quality\-related training modules for new joiners and refresher programs for existing staff
* Stay current with payer policy changes and disseminate relevant updates to the quality and operations teams


**What We’re Looking For**

description:
**About Northern Trust**
 As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
   

  

 Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
   

  

 With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
   

  

**Senior Lead, Anaplan Solutions \& Planning Platforms** 
  

  

*Job Description \| Finance Technology*
**Position Summary** 
  

  

 We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated
 **Senior Lead, Anaplan Solutions \& Planning Platforms** 
 to lead the implementation, support, and strategic expansion of enterprise planning solutions across Finance. This role will own delivery outcomes across Anaplan Staff Planning, Forecasting, CCAR support, Income Statement planning, Data Hub architecture, integrations, UX reporting, and future planning modernization capabilities.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is not only a strong Anaplan expert, but also a capability builder who can establish delivery discipline, mentor a team, strengthen governance, and translate business priorities into scalable, controlled, and user\-friendly planning solutions.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities** 
  

  

* Required Technical Skills \& Experience
* Deep expertise in Anaplan solution architecture, model building, Data Hub design, ALM, UX development, and deployment management, with a proven ability to design scalable, high\-performing enterprise planning solutions.
* Strong functional knowledge of FP\&A, workforce planning, budgeting, forecasting, scenario modeling, and financial data management, with the ability to translate complex business requirements into actionable planning capabilities.
* Experience leading end\-to\-end implementation and enhancement of enterprise planning platforms, including requirements gathering, solution design, development, testing, deployment, governance, and production support.
* Proven ability to design and manage enterprise data integrations, leveraging APIs, SQL, and data analysis techniques to ensure data accuracy, integrity, and timely availability across planning ecosystems.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and troubleshooting skills with expertise in reporting, analytics, controls, access management, documentation, and regulatory compliance requirements.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel and financial modeling, complemented by experience working within Agile delivery frameworks and modern Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) practices.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross\-functional teams, influence stakeholders, establish best practices, and drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance planning efficiency, data quality, and business outcomes.
* Leadership \& Team Development
* Build, mentor, and lead a high\-performing Anaplan delivery team comprising model builders, analysts, engineers, and solution SMEs.
* Establish clear ways of working across backlog management, sprint execution, release planning, quality reviews, documentation, and production support.
* Coach team members on Anaplan best practices, model design, data management, performance optimization, and business engagement.
* Create a sustainable capability model with role clarity, cross\-training, succession planning, and measurable skill maturity.
* Strategy, Roadmap \& Stakeholder Management
* Partner with Finance, FP\&A, HR, Risk, Corporate Functions, and Technology stakeholders to define priorities, business outcomes, and delivery roadmap.
* Translate business needs into scalable Anaplan solutions that improve forecasting, workforce planning, scenario analysis, expense planning, and management reporting.
* Act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders by providing clear options, risks, dependencies, trade\-offs, and recommendations.
* Lead prioritization forums and drive alignment across business value, regulatory needs, capacity, and technical feasibility.
* Solution Architecture \& Delivery Ownership
* Own end\-to\-end design and delivery of enterprise Anaplan capabilities across Staff Planning, Forecasting, CCAR, Income Statement planning, cost center planning, and scenario modeling.
* Design scalable multi\-model architectures using Data Hub, ALM, controlled data flows, modular design principles, and reusable planning components.
* Ensure models are performant, auditable, maintainable, secure, and aligned to Anaplan and enterprise technology standards.
* Oversee requirements, design, build, testing, UAT, deployment, documentation, and post\-production stabilization.
* Platform Operations, Controls \& Data Quality
* Strengthen production support, incident management, release governance, access controls, and operational risk management.
* Establish data validation, reconciliation, completeness checks, and error\-handling processes across inbound and outbound planning data.
* Drive improvements in platform stability, data accuracy, business adoption, user experience, and planning cycle efficiency.
* Maintain strong documentation for model architecture, data lineage, integrations, controls, release records, and support procedures.


  

  

* Innovation \& Continuous Improvement
* Identify opportunities to simplify planning processes, automate manual activities, enhance reporting visibility, and improve self\-service capability.
* Evaluate and apply modern planning practices including predictive planning, advanced analytics, AI\-enabled insights, and integration automation where appropriate.
* Promote a culture of continuous improvement, operational precision, accountability, and business\-value driven delivery.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems
* 10\+ years of experience in enterprise planning, financial systems, EPM platforms, FP\&A technology, or related finance technology domains.
* 8\+ years of hands\-on Anaplan implementation, model building, and solution architecture experience.
* Proven experience leading enterprise\-scale planning implementations from concept through production deployment.
* Strong working knowledge of FP\&A, forecasting, budgeting, workforce planning, management reporting, cost center planning, and financial data structures.
* Anaplan Certified Solution Architect or Master Anaplanner credentials preferred.
* Experience with Hyperion, Oracle EPM, OneStream, SAP BPC, Workday, Power BI, SQL, ETL tools, APIs, or enterprise data platforms is good to have
* Experience in banking, financial services, regulatory planning, risk, CCAR, SOX\-controlled environments, or large global enterprises.
* Strong Agile delivery experience and familiarity with SDLC, DevOps, change management, and release governance.
* Experience designing Data Hub architecture, integrations, validation routines, and controlled data flows.
* Demonstrated experience building, mentoring, and leading technical teams.
* Excellent executive communication, stakeholder management, analytical thinking, and problem\-solving skills.


  

  

**Working with Us**
 As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
   

  

 Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

 Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

description:
**Role Title: VP, IAM Assurance Leader (L13\)**
**Company Overview**
 Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a premier consumer financial services company delivering one of the industry’s most complete digitally enabled product suites. Our experience, expertise and scale encompass a broad spectrum of industries including digital, health and wellness, retail, telecommunications, home, auto, outdoors, pet and more.
   

  

* We have recently been ranked \#2 among India’s Best Companies to Work for by Great Place to Work. We were among the Top 50 India’s Best Workplaces in Building a Culture of Innovation by All by GPTW and Top 25 among Best Workplaces in BFSI by GPTW. We have also been recognized by AmbitionBox Employee Choice Awards among the Top 20 Mid\-Sized Companies, ranked \#3 among Top Rated Companies for Women, and Top\-Rated Financial Services Companies.
* We provide best\-in\-class employee benefits and programs that cater to work\-life integration and overall well\-being.
* We provide career advancement and upskilling opportunities for all to take up leadership roles.


**Organizational Overview**
 The Identity and Access Management (IAM) team at Synchrony oversees key security functions including authentication, authorization, privileged access management, special programs, and federated controls governance. This team ensures comprehensive management of identity and access processes to maintain robust security and compliance across the organization. This role will oversee a team of seven and be a direct report into the VP, IAM Programs Leader.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 We are seeking an innovative and results\-driven leader to serve as VP, IAM Assurance Leader, responsible for leading the IAM Services Assurance function overseeing key controls across all centralized and decentralized IAM services. This role will work closely with IAM product owners and engineering teams to ensure adherence to Synchrony IAM standards and regulatory requirements without disrupting operational delivery.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will possess deep technical expertise and hands\-on experience across IAM controls, assurance operations, and identity/authentication platforms (e.g., Active Directory, LDAP technologies, Beyond Identity, and related IAM services). As a strategic leader, you will guide teams, enable cross\-functional collaboration, and drive continuous improvement in the effectiveness, reporting, and automation of IAM controls—particularly in critical areas such as logical access, authentication assurance, privileged access oversight, and control evidence for SOX/PCI and other regulatory obligations. You will blend technology insight with program management discipline to ensure success in execution and delivery, including the creation and modernization of assurance reporting capabilities and the automation of control remediation where appropriate.
   

  

**Essential Responsibilities**
* Create and Maintain Strategic Roadmaps: Develop and execute multi\-year roadmaps to drive innovation, strengthen security posture, meet regulatory requirements, and streamline IAM operations—specifically for IAM assurance capabilities, control monitoring, and evidence automation.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Build and nurture strong relationships across Security Operations, Technology Teams, Governance, Operational Risk, and Internal Audit, ensuring program alignment, audit readiness, and the ability to clearly demonstrate IAM control effectiveness to stakeholders and regulators.
* Risk and Progress Management: Identify, assess, and mitigate technical and organizational risks while regularly reporting blockers, corrective actions, and program milestones to executive leadership; ensure timely remediation of control gaps and recurring defects.
* Solution Design \& Automation: Lead and contribute to designing technical solutions for complex automation use cases, driving operational efficiency and scalability—especially automation to detect, track, and remediate IAM control defects.
* Program Integrity: Ensure standards, policies, and procedures are accurately documented and officially maintained for audit and compliance requirements; recommend updates to IAM standards based on security threats, regulatory expectations, and industry trends.
* Performance Tracking: Define, implement, and monitor Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to measure program maturity and overall effectiveness, including assurance coverage, control pass rates, remediation SLAs, defect recurrence, and reporting timeliness/accuracy.
* Assurance Operations Leadership: Lead assurance activities to track, validate, and remediate key logical access and authentication controls across centralized IAM services (e.g., Active Directory, Oracle LDAP, Beyond Identity) and decentralized implementations as applicable.
* Assurance Reporting Platform Ownership: Manage and evolve the IAM assurance reporting platform(s) used to monitor adherence to Synchrony standards, control design, and operational effectiveness; ensure reporting is accurate, resilient, and audit\-ready.
* Agile Partnership with Product Owners: Partner with IAM product owners and delivery teams using Agile methodologies to prioritize and implement control improvements, balancing risk reduction with service stability and customer impact.
* Control Evidence \& Audit Support: Ensure the organization can efficiently produce high\-quality evidence for SOX, PCI, and other examinations; proactively address audit issues with root\-cause correction and sustainable control improvements.
* Documentation \& Enablement: Oversee creation, maintenance, and review of operational process documentation and end\-user/training materials needed to support consistent execution of IAM assurance activities.
* Problem Resolution: Independently resolve technical challenges while escalating issues with clarity when necessary.
* Perform other critical duties or special projects as assigned.


**Qualifications/Requirements**
* BS/BA in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Business Management, or equivalent, plus 10\+ years IT experience, OR in lieu of a degree with 12\+ years IT experience demonstrating progressive responsibility.
* Minimum 5 years of experience leading multiple IAM service products (e.g., authentication, privileged access, identity governance) and driving outcomes across both centralized and distributed service models.
* Minimum 5 years of experience developing and improving IAM service processes and reporting on IAM service key controls (design and operating effectiveness).
* Minimum 3 years leading operations or assurance teams, including continuous monitoring, issue management, and control remediation.
* At least 2 years working with Agile methodologies in roles such as Product Owner, Scrum Master, or Technical Lead.
* Minimum 2 years of people management experience, leading teams of 2\+ engineers or contractors.


**Technical Expertise**
* Strong understanding of IAM directory services, such as Active Directory, LDAP, Oracle LDAP, or similar.
* Experience with assurance reporting, control monitoring dashboards, and/or metrics platforms used to track compliance and remediation status.
* Hands\-on experience with Security Control Design and Security Assurance Operations, including defining controls, validating operating effectiveness, and driving remediation.
* Hands\-on experience with Unix/Linux Server Access Administration and access security.
* Experience supporting or integrating IAM platforms and processes such as ServiceNow, SailPoint IdentityIQ, privileged access tooling (e.g., Bomgar/BeyondTrust), and authentication technologies (e.g., RSA Authentication Manager or equivalents).


**Skills**
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills for effective cross\-team collaboration and executive reporting, including the ability to translate technical risk into business impact.
* Strategic thinker able to develop and articulate long\-term program visions and actionable roadmaps.
* Strong organizational and prioritization skills, capable of managing multiple concurrent projects in complex environments.
* Proactive problem solver with the ability to navigate ambiguity and escalate appropriately.
* Strong analytical and clear\-thinking skills; ability to interpret control results, identify root causes, and drive durable corrective actions.
* Customer\-oriented mindset and ability to reduce friction for product teams while improving assurance outcomes.


**Desired Characteristics**
* Proven experience leading large\-scale IAM initiatives, including program design, execution, and cross\-functional collaboration in complex technical environments.
* Exceptional communication and organizational skills, with a track record of creating and executing long\-term strategic roadmaps.
* Strong ability to manage risk and complexity, navigate roadblocks, and drive corrective actions effectively.
* Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and manage teams while building partnerships across business units and fostering alignment to organizational goals.
* Strong commitment to providing outstanding customer experiences; ability to balance control compliance with minimal operational disruption.
* Self\-starter with a strong sense of urgency and flexibility to change directions quickly while maintaining delivery discipline.
* Experience with the process of creating, maintaining and reviewing operations process \& end user training documentation.
* Working knowledge of ServiceNow, SailPoint IdentityIQ, Active Directory, Bomgar/BeyondTrust privileged access, Unix LDAP, and RSA Authentication Manager (or comparable tools).
* Experience working in highly regulated industries (Finance, Healthcare, Government), particularly enterprise\-level security in a financial institution.
* Familiarity with compliance standards such as SOX, PCI, FFIEC, GDPR, HIPAA, or NIST cybersecurity frameworks, including NIST 800\-63 and logical access control expectations.
* Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, PMP, or relevant IAM\-focused certifications.


**Eligibility Criteria**
 BS/BA in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Business Management, or equivalent, plus 10\+ years IT experience, OR in lieu of a degree with 12\+ years IT experience demonstrating progressive responsibility.
   

  

**Work Timings**

title: Manager - Strategic Buyer (L09)
description:
**Job Title:\- Manager \- Strategic Buyer (L09\)**
**Company Overview**
 Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as \#3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the \#1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
   

  

**Organizational Overview**
 This role is in the Procurement within Source to Pay (S2P) organization in Synchrony. Source to Pay team provides centralized supplier procurement, contracting, \& ongoing management support across all Synchrony Functions delivering those products and services needed to be successful in our daily operations.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 The Strategic Buyer plays a critical role in Synchrony’s procurement transformation by owning end\-to\-end buying for assigned categories within the Global Procurement Buy Desk and Source\-to\-Pay (S2P) function. The role ensures purchases are routed through the optimal buying channel—including catalogue, contract, spot buy, and guided buying through Coupa Smart Intake—while driving compliant purchasing, PO lifecycle discipline, tail spend optimization, integration issue resolution, and digital enablement through Coupa, Oracle, analytics, and emerging AI capabilities.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own end\-to\-end buying for assigned categories and route demand through the right buying channel, including catalogue, contract, spot buy, and Coupa Smart Intake guided buying.
* Execute purchase transactions within defined SLAs while ensuring policy compliance, PO accuracy, and Contract\-to\-PO alignment.
* Partner with Source\-to\-Pay, category managers, Bid Desk, Finance, requesters, and suppliers to support buying strategy execution and resolve L1/L2 procurement queries.
* Manage PO lifecycle activities, including requisition workflow tracking, PO modifications, issue triage, and PO hygiene to support audit readiness and reliable reporting.
* Drive spend analytics, including tail spend, buying channel, supplier, category, PO, receipt, and spend cube analysis to identify consolidation, compliance, and optimization opportunities.
* Monitor Coupa–Oracle integration issues, including inactive supplier sites, GL, PAR number, PO, and receipt discrepancies, and coordinate resolution with relevant teams.
* Support dashboards and KPI reporting using Coupa Analytics, Power BI, Excel, and related tools to improve operational visibility and decision\-making.
* Enable AI\-led procurement transformation by leveraging Coupa AI Agents and Coupa Agentic Studio for intake classification, requisition routing, workflow automation, UAT/SIT support, and use\-case development.


**Required Skills/Knowledge**
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Finance, or related discipline 4\-5 years of procurement or supply chain operations experience; Source\-to\-Pay / Procure\-to\-Pay environment strongly preferred or 6\-7 years of procurement or supply chain operations experience; Source\-to\-Pay / Procure\-to\-Pay environment strongly preferred.
* Ability to independently manage end\-to\-end buying activities across assigned categories and route purchases through appropriate buying channels.
* Strong understanding of Source\-to\-Pay, Procure\-to\-Pay, Coupa Smart Intake, catalogue buying, contract buying, spot buying, and guided buying processes.
* Proven capability in PO lifecycle management, requisition workflow tracking, PO modifications, Contract\-to\-PO alignment, catalogue enablement, and PO hygiene.
* Strong analytical skills to conduct tail spend, buying channel, spend cube, PO, and receipt data analysis using Coupa, Oracle, Power BI, Excel, or similar tools.
* Ability to manage L1 and L2 procurement helpdesk queries, coordinate with Bid Desk, Finance, Source\-to\-Pay, and category teams, and escalate critical issues appropriately.


**Desired Skills/Knowledge**
* Experience supporting procurement transformation, channel management, tail spend reduction, and unmanaged spend compliance initiatives.
* Working knowledge of Coupa–Oracle integration touchpoints, including supplier site, GL, PAR number, PO, and receipt\-related issue resolution.
* Comfort using Coupa Analytics, Power BI, dashboards, and reporting tools to monitor operational KPIs and support decision\-making.
* Awareness of AI\-enabled procurement capabilities, including Coupa AI Agents and Coupa Agentic Studio, Process Transformation with willingness to develop practical use cases and assist in Process Intelligence initiatives.
* Experience participating in UAT, SIT, pressure testing, process improvement, automation, and workflow optimization initiatives.


**Eligibility Criteria**
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Finance, or related discipline 4 \- 5 years of procurement or supply chain operations experience; Source\-to\-Pay / Procure\-to\-Pay environment strongly preferred or in lieu of a degree 6 \-7 years of procurement or supply chain operations experience; Source\-to\-Pay / Procure\-to\-Pay environment strongly preferred.


**Work Timings: 04:00 PM – 01:00 AM IST**
 (WORK TIMINGS: This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs) We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs—Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR. Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events.

 Benchmark Marcom Pvt Ltd

 Pune (with extensive travel as required)
 



**Type:** 
 Full\-time

 This role is the backbone of execution.
 



 As the Wedding Operations Manager, you are responsible for translating plans and designs into flawless on\-ground reality. You own logistics, timelines, vendor coordination, manpower, and problem\-solving across all wedding events.
 



 This is not a desk role. It requires presence, decisiveness, and the ability to stay composed while managing complexity, scale, and pressure.
 



 You are the person who ensures that what was promised is delivered—quietly, efficiently, and without drama.

* Coordinate with all vendors: decor, production, lighting, sound, hospitality, logistics, security, artists, and venues
* Share clear timelines, layouts, and expectations with each vendor

* Handle on\-ground negotiations, issue resolution, and last\-minute adjustments

* Ensure execution stays aligned with approved budgets
* Track scope changes and flag cost implications early

**5\. Client \& Internal Coordination** 



* Work closely with Client Service, Planning, and Design teams
* Ensure client\-approved plans are executed accurately
* Shield clients from operational stress during events
* Communicate calmly and clearly during high\-pressure moments



**6\. On\-Ground Crisis Management** 



* Handle unexpected issues decisively (weather, delays, vendor failures, guest\-related challenges)
* Make quick, practical decisions without escalating panic
* Maintain control and clarity in chaotic situations







  





**Ideal Candidate Profile** 




**Must\-Have** 



* 4\-6 years of experience in wedding operations, large\-scale events, or hospitality operations
* Strong understanding of Indian weddings and multi\-day event formats
* Proven ability to manage large teams and multiple vendors
* Excellent logistical and organisational skills
* Comfort working long hours during event periods



**Good to Have** 



* Experience with destination weddings
* Exposure to luxury or high\-end events
* Understanding of production, staging, and technical setups
* Ability to read layouts, drawings, and spatial plans







  





**Skills \& Traits We Value** 



* Calm under pressure
* Decisive and solution\-oriented
* Highly organised
* Strong leadership presence
* Clear communicator
* Physically and mentally resilient







  





**What Success Looks Like in This Role** 



* Events run on time with minimal visible stress
* Vendors perform efficiently and responsibly
* Clients experience smooth, confident execution
* Issues are resolved before they escalate
* Planning and design intent is protected on ground







  





**Working Style \& Culture Fit** 



* This is a high\-ownership role
* Requires authority, accountability, and maturity
* Not reactive firefighting; structured operations are expected
* You will be trusted to make decisions independently







  





**Compensation** 



* Competitive fixed salary based on experience

title: Head Miller
description:
Please note: Prior experience as a miller in a wheat flour mill is a must. It is also mandatory to have a certificate from Indian School of Milling Technology (CFTRI Mysore) or from a similar program demonstrating formal education in milling of wheat.
 



  





**Job Overview** 




  





 As the Head Miller / Plant Head, you will be responsible for leading the entire milling and production process, managing the plant’s operations, workforce, and facility resources. This position requires extensive experience in flour milling, plant management, and production planning, as well as a strong focus on quality control, efficiency, and compliance.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Milling Operations** 




  





 •
 **Oversee Milling Processes** 
 : Supervise and optimize daily milling activities, including grain intake, cleaning, grinding, and blending.
 



 •
 **Product Quality Assurance** 
 : Maintain rigorous quality control for all flour products, conducting regular checks and calibrating processes to ensure consistency.
 



 •
 **Equipment Maintenance** 
 : Establish and manage preventative maintenance schedules, coordinate repairs, and ensure milling equipment operates at peak efficiency.
 



  





**Plant Management** 




  





 •
 **Production Planning and Coordination** 
 : Develop and implement production schedules, balancing demand with plant capacity and resources to achieve production goals.
 



 •
 **Operational Efficiency** 
 : Monitor and improve plant workflows, identifying opportunities for process optimization and cost reduction across all departments.
 



 •
 **Inventory and Supply Chain Management** 
 : Collaborate with procurement to manage raw material inventory, maintain adequate stock levels, and ensure seamless supply chain coordination.
 



 •
 **Health, Safety, and Compliance** 
 : Uphold strict adherence to safety standards and food industry regulations; foster a safe workplace environment through training and inspections.
 



  





**Leadership and Team Management** 




  





 •
 **Workforce Management** 
 : Directly oversee the milling and production teams, including staffing, performance management, and training.
 



 •
 **Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 
 : Liaise with other departments, such as quality control, logistics, and procurement, to ensure smooth production and delivery operations.
 



 •
 **Budget and Resource Management** 
 : Manage the plant’s operational budget, monitor resource allocation, and implement cost\-saving measures where possible.
 



  





**Reporting and Documentation** 




  





 •
 **Data Analysis and Reporting** 
 : Maintain accurate records of production metrics, quality standards, inventory levels, and equipment performance; generate and present reports for senior management.
 



 •
 **Continuous Improvement Initiatives** 
 : Drive process improvement and innovation by implementing best practices, exploring new technologies, and analyzing production data to enhance plant efficiency.
 



  





**Qualifications** 




  





 •
 **Experience** 
 : Minimum of 7\-10 years in flour milling and plant management, with at least 3 years in a leadership role.
 



 •
 **Education** 
 : Degree in Milling Science, Food Technology, Mechanical Engineering, or related field preferred.
 



 •
 **Technical Proficiency** 
 : Knowledge of milling equipment, plant operations, and modern production technology; experience with automated systems is a plus.
 



 •
 **Leadership Ability** 
 : Strong team leadership, decision\-making, and communication skills.
 



 •
 **Analytical Skills** 
 : Competency in analyzing production metrics, troubleshooting, and strategic planning.
 



 •
 **Safety and Compliance Knowledge** 
 : Deep understanding of health and safety standards in food production and plant operations.

 Cafe Coffee Day (CCD) is India’s largest café chain and a popular hangout for people who enjoy relaxed, social spaces centered around great coffee. description:
**About Us**
 TRC, Member of WSP, is a global consulting environmental and engineering firm and one of the top design firms in the energy sector. Together, TRC and WSP’s 83,000 experts create positive, long\-lasting impacts for our communities and our clients in the power and energy, transportation and infrastructure, environmental, and property and buildings sectors. As part of our team, you’ll discover a world of opportunities to connect with innovative thinkers, forge your path, and have fun tackling the world’s most challenging projects. At TRC, Member of WSP, you can have a rewarding career on every level.
   

  

 TRC has long set the bar for clients who require more than just engineering, combining science with the latest technology to devise innovative solutions that stand the test of time. From pipelines to power plants, roadways to reservoirs, schoolyards to security solutions, clients look to TRC for breakthrough thinking backed by the innovative follow\-through of an industry leader.
   

  

 We recognize that the expertise of our staff is our strongest asset, so we generously reward employees for successful performance and invest in their careers through training and the development of new skills and certifications.
   

  

**Overview**
 The Data Migration Lead will oversee and execute the migration of geospatial data from legacy systems such as GE Smallworld and Geometric Network to Esri's Utility Network (UN). This role requires expertise in Esri technologies, Utility Network configuration, and data transformation tools like FME. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in utilities (Gas, Electric, Water, Telecom) and experience managing complex data migration projects.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead end\-to\-end data migration projects from GE Smallworld and Geometric Network to Esri Utility Network.
* Analyze legacy data models and design migration strategies to align with Esri Utility Network schema and best practices.
* Configure and implement Esri Utility Network models, including network rules, topologies, and asset configurations.
* Develop and execute data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) workflows using FME and Python (ArcPy).
* Perform data quality assessments and validations to ensure accuracy, consistency, and completeness during migration.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements, define migration objectives, and ensure alignment with business needs.
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to data compatibility, schema mapping, and network topology during migration.
* Optimize migration processes for performance and scalability, ensuring minimal downtime and data integrity.
* Document migration workflows, methodologies, and lessons learned for future reference.
* Provide training and support to teams on Esri Utility Network and post\-migration processes.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in GIS, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 8\-12 years of experience in GIS, with at least 4\-6 years in data migration projects.
* Strong expertise in Esri technologies, including ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Enterprise, and Utility Network.
* Hands\-on experience with data migration from GE Smallworld and Geometric Network to Esri platforms.
* Proficiency in FME (Feature Manipulation Engine) for data transformation and automation.
* Advanced Python scripting skills (ArcPy) for geoprocessing and data migration tasks.
* In\-depth knowledge of utility network models (Gas, Electric, Water, Telecom) and their operational workflows.
* Experience with spatial databases such as PostgreSQL/PostGIS, Oracle, or SQL Server.
* Strong problem\-solving, analytical, and debugging skills.
* Excellent communication and leadership skills to manage cross\-functional teams and stakeholders.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with Esri Utility Network configuration, including network rules, subnetwork management, and tracing.
* Familiarity with Agile project management methodologies and tools like Jira or Azure DevOps.
* Knowledge of GE Smallworld data structures and migration challenges.
* Experience with large\-scale enterprise GIS implementations and integrations.
* Certification in Esri technologies or FME is a plus.

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. All employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Team Lead, ADM Operations
description:
**Who We Are**
 Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI\-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,400 firms in nearly 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $9 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with nearly 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end\-to\-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, London, Edinburgh, Pune, Dubai, Geneva, Singapore and São Paulo.
   

  

**The Role**
 Addepar has just launched an Alternatives Product offering that gives Addepar clients the option to have their Private Funds data extracted, processed, validated, and ingested directly from Private Fund documents for a more automated end\-to\-end solution for handling Alternatives on the platform. This white\-glove solution combines proprietary machine learning technology that automatically extracts data from Private Funds documents and human\-in\-loop review to validate any documents that fail to pass confidence and data quality checks.
   

  

 As part of the broader Addepar Data organization, the Alternatives Data Ops team is responsible for the human\-in\-loop review of Private Funds documents, ensuring clients' Alternatives data is processed, validated, and available in Addepar in a timely manner. This role will include managing a team and reviewing Private Fund statements, modifying data that has been incorrectly extracted by our machine learning models, and reprocessing the data within SLAs. The Alternatives Data Ops team plays a critical role in the success of Addepar's Alternatives offering and requires daily communications with the Alternatives Product Team, Machine Learning Operations, clients, data providers (GPs and Fund Admins), and additional personnel across the organization.
   

  

 Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Lead and manage a team of Analysts \& Senior Analysts ensuring effective work allocation, timely delivery.
* Act as a Subject matter expert \& support the team on complex document processing
* Guide and oversee the team in troubleshooting complex Private Fund statement processing exceptions
* Perform quality reviews and assist the team in modifying incorrectly extracted data
* Track and drive key team performance metrics, including SLA compliance, processing accuracy, and throughput.
* Act as a primary escalation point for operational and data quality issues.
* Partner with our Machine Learning Operations team to identify and relabel documents for model retraining
* Engage clients, GPs, or Fund Admins on statement data related inquiries
* Support the Maintenance Alternatives Data Operations workflow procedures and play\-books.
* Identify opportunities for automation, process optimization, and standardization.
* Partner with Product and Engineering to implement new processes and tooling features that improve Alternatives Data processing UX and increase operational workflow efficiency.


**Who You Are**
* Minimum 5\+ years of experience in a relevant role and domain
* Minimum 2\+ years of people Team leader experience
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, Commerce, Economics, or a related field
* Experience in Private equity / Alternatives investment process
* Experience in the financial investment/advisory industry with strong knowledge of capital markets, middle/back\-office operations systems, and preferably with experience dealing with Alternatives (Private/Draw\-down) Funds reporting statements and data
* Track record of demonstrating excellent attention to detail, effective problem\-solving skills, and an ability to thrive in a fast paced environment
* Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills for engaging clients, data providers, and internal stakeholders across Sales, Services, and R\&D
* Highly self\-motivated to take on responsibility, forward thinking and pragmatic, and possess a collaborative team\-player mentality
* Technical skills preferred in any or all of the following: Microsoft Excel, Google Suite, Atlassian Jira/Confluence, SQL, Salesforce, or other common financial services systems and applications
* Willing to work in overlapping US/EMEA shifts or flexible hours to align with global stakeholders


**Our Values**
* Act Like an Owner \- Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
* Build Together \- Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value.
* Champion Our Clients \- Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success.
* Drive Innovation \- Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.
* Embrace Learning \- Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.


 In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.
   

  

 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
   

  

 PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta\-operations@addepar.com.

title: Sr. Lead, Alternatives Data Operations
description:
**Who We Are**
 Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI\-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,400 firms in nearly 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $9 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with nearly 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end\-to\-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, London, Edinburgh, Pune, Dubai, Geneva, Singapore and São Paulo.
   

  

**The Role**
 Addepar has just launched an Alternatives Product offering that gives Addepar clients the option to have their Private Funds data extracted, processed, validated, and ingested directly from Private Fund documents for a more automated end\-to\-end solution for handling Alternatives on the platform. This white\-glove solution combines proprietary machine learning technology that automatically extracts data from Private Funds documents and human\-in\-loop review to validate any documents that fail to pass confidence and data quality checks.
   

  

 As a Senior Lead of the Alternatives Data Operations, you will lead the operations function that is responsible for the human\-in\-loop review of Private Funds documents, ensuring clients' Alternatives data is processed, validated, and available in Addepar in a timely manner. You will manage a team of Alternatives Data Ops analysts who review Private Fund statements, modify data that has been incorrectly extracted by our machine learning models, and reprocess data within SLAs. In this role, you'll own the operational strategy, team performance, and continuous improvement of the Alternatives Data Ops function—a critical component of Addepar's Alternatives offering success.
   

  

 Your responsibilities will include building and scaling a high\-performing team, establishing processes and metrics that optimize quality and throughput, managing SLA performance, and serving as the primary liaison between the Alternatives Data Ops team and cross\-functional partners including the Alternatives Product Team, Engineering, Client Delivery, and additional personnel across the organization.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Develop and execute a strategic roadmap for Alternatives and Market data operations, aligning with Addepar's business objectives and corporate growth plans.
* Drive automation and efficiency initiatives, identifying opportunities to reduce manual work, streamline workflows, and scale the team's capacity
* Collaborate with senior leadership to understand the organization's evolving needs and ensure the data operations strategy is closely aligned with these goals.
* Own operational strategy and metrics, establishing KPIs around data quality, processing speed, and client satisfaction—identifying trends, bottlenecks, and opportunities for improvement
* Lead issue resolution and escalation, proactively managing blockers and maintaining alignment with internal stakeholders
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Client Solutions to implement new processes and tooling that improve the data processing experience and increase operational efficiency


**Operational Management**
* Oversee the spectrum of operational workflows for alternatives data and market data feeds, ensuring smooth execution and rapid issue resolution.
* Maintain effective process controls to ensure quality standards, and organizational objectives and deliverables are achieved. Establish, monitor, and report on Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for data delivery, ensuring consistent and timely provision of accurate data to internal and external stakeholders.
* Implement robust KPI tracking, metrics and analytics to measure operational effectiveness, resource utilization, operations scalability, and cost\-effectiveness
* Establish and maintain processes, workflows, and playbooks that ensure consistency, quality, and scalability across the Alternatives Data Ops function


**People Management and Culture**
* Lead and grow the Alternatives Data Ops team, including hiring, onboarding, mentoring, and fostering career development—helping team members understand the business impact of their work and creating opportunities for growth within the function
* Mentor managers/leads and consistently promote knowledge sharing and best practices to all groups.
* Manage a global team, fostering a strong culture alongside achieving results: Balance driving performance with cultivating a high\-performing, inclusive, and growth\-oriented team culture. Lead by example, empowering team members to innovate and collaborate effectively, while ensuring accountability for measurable outcomes
* Oversee recruitment, onboarding, and training of new team members.


**Who You Are**
* 10\+ years of experience in data operations, data management, or a related field within the financial services or wealth tech industry.
* Proven experience in a senior leadership role
* Extensive experience with Alternatives Data (e.g., Private Equity, Hedge Funds, Real Estate, Private Credit) is a must. Experience with Market Data (e.g., equities, fixed income, derivatives, pricing, corporate actions) is a nice to have.
* Proven experience using process automation, operational workflow re\-engineering and continuous improvement to enhance operational efficiency and scalability by using modern tools and technologies.
* Demonstrated track record of improving data quality and operational efficiency.
* Strong project management and analytical skills with experience in leading change management
* Experienced with leading global teams, cross\-functional and cross\-regional projects, and learning and development initiatives.
* Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills for engaging with clients, external data partners, and internal team members and stakeholders.


**Our Values**
* Act Like an Owner \- Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
* Build Together \- Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value.
* Champion Our Clients \- Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success.
* Drive Innovation \- Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.
* Embrace Learning \- Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.


 In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.
   

  

 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
   

  

 PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta\-operations@addepar.com.

* Capacity and Throughput Management: Audit IP pool utilization and SGW/PGW throughput trends to support demand forecasting and capacity planning.
* Enterprise Platform Oversight: Monitor DRA/OCS performance and AAA/APN\-wise KPIs to support enterprise service efficiency and stability.

* Reporting and Audits: Conduct parameter audits for quality compliance and publish weekly Data Core and Cloud KPI trend reports.
* Technology Evolution: Build knowledge across emerging technology areas, including WiFi, DNS, Cloud KPIs, and Packet Core 4G/5G architectures.
* Cloud Infrastructure Monitoring: Monitor infrastructure\-level Cloud KPIs such as CPU load, virtualization latency, VM/container health, and virtual switch packet drops for cloud\-native telecom functions.
* OpenSignal, Customer Complaints and User Experience Monitoring: Monitor OpenSignal KPIs, including download/upload speed, latency, packet loss, discard rate, and TTFB. Analyse customer complaints and experience indicators, correlate them with network KPIs to drive service improvements and corrective actions.


**Technical/ Functional Competencies**
* Packet Core KPI Monitoring: Track performance across MME, SGW, PGW, PCRF, and DNS elements.
* Enterprise Core Performance: Monitor DRA, OCS, PCRF, AAA, and APN performance indicators.

* Network Performance Reporting and Alerting: Prepare KPI dashboards, configure threshold alerts, and support performance reporting.
* Cloud Infrastructure Performance: Understand RHOSP and RHOCP architectures and monitor key cloud performance indicators.
* User Experience KPI Correlation: Correlate OpenSignal, TTFB, latency, throughput, packet loss, and discard\-rate metrics with network performance.


**Behavioural \& Leadership Competencies**
* Analytical Thinking: Strong capability to dissect complex network data and troubleshoot underlying protocol issues.
* First\-Time\-Right Approach: High commitment to quality and accuracy in execution to minimize network downtime.
* Accountability \& Ownership: Demonstrated capability to own network issues from initial detection through to final resolution.
* Digital Mindset: Adaptable to evolving cloud\-native telecom technologies and automated monitoring systems.
* Collaboration: Proven track record of working effectively across cross\-functional engineering and infrastructure teams.

The firm provides end\-to\-end advisory services across luxury residential properties, branded residences, Grade‑A commercial real estate, and investment\-led real estate portfolios for clients in India and overseas.
