description:
Job Title\- Supply Chain Manager
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Manager – Supply Chain Management is responsible for planning, executing, and optimizing end\-to\-end supply chain operations, including procurement, inventory management, logistics, warehousing,
 **Stores** 
 , and
 **Spare Parts Division (SPD)** 
 . The role ensures uninterrupted material availability, cost efficiency, accurate inventory control, and timely support to production, maintenance, and after\-sales/service functions.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Supply Chain Planning \& Control
* Develop and implement supply chain strategies aligned with business goals.
* Plan demand forecasting, material planning, and replenishment cycles.
* Ensure optimal inventory levels while minimizing carrying and obsolescence costs.
* Coordinate with production, maintenance, sales, and service teams.
* Stores Management
* Oversee day\-to\-day operations of stores/warehouses.
* Ensure proper receipt, storage, preservation, and issuance of materials.
* Implement FIFO/FEFO practices and ensure accurate stock records.
* Maintain inventory accuracy through regular cycle counts and audits.
* Ensure compliance with safety, housekeeping, and regulatory standards.
* Spare Parts Division (SPD) Management
* Manage end\-to\-end operations of the Spare Parts Division.
* Ensure availability of critical and fast\-moving spare parts to support maintenance and service requirements.
* Classify and control spare parts (critical, insurance, non\-moving, obsolete).
* Optimize spare parts inventory levels to reduce downtime and excess stock.
* Coordinate with maintenance, service, and engineering teams for forecasting and planning.
* Logistics \& Distribution
* Manage inbound and outbound logistics operations.
* Optimize transportation costs and delivery timelines.
* Coordinate with logistics partners and ensure timely dispatch and receipt of materials and spares.
* Systems, Processes \& Compliance
* Ensure effective use of ERP/MRP systems for inventory and supply chain management.
* Develop and improve SOPs for stores, procurement, and SPD operations.
* Ensure compliance with internal controls, audit requirements, and statutory regulations.
* Team Leadership \& Development
* Lead, mentor, and develop supply chain, stores, and SPD teams.
* Allocate tasks, set performance goals, and conduct regular performance reviews.
* Promote a culture of continuous improvement and accountability.
* Reporting \& Continuous Improvement
* Prepare MIS reports on inventory, procurement, logistics, and spare parts performance.
* Analyze KPIs such as inventory turnover, service level, stock accuracy, and cost savings.
* Identify improvement opportunities and implement best practices.


**Key Skills \& Competencies**
* Strong knowledge of supply chain, inventory, stores, and spare parts management
* Analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Vendor negotiation and cost management
* ERP/MRP system proficiency
* Leadership and team management skills
* Strong communication and coordination abilities


**Qualifications**
* BE \+ MBA in Supply Chain Management, Logistics.


**Experience**
* 15\+ years of experience in supply chain management from Auto Ancillary Companies MNC are preferred.
* Proven experience managing Stores and Spare Parts Division in a manufacturing, industrial, or service environment.
* Experience Must able to handle multiple locations

title: Global Supply Chain Manager
description:
**About Sibros Technologies**
****Who We Are****
 Sibros is accelerating the future of SDV excellence with its Deep Connected Platform™ that orchestrates full vehicle software update management, vehicle analytics, and remote commands in one integrated system. Adaptable to any vehicle architecture, Sibros’ platform meets stringent safety, security, and compliance standards, propelling OEMs to innovate new connected vehicle use cases across fleet management, predictive maintenance, data monetization, and beyond.
   

  

 Learn more at www.sibros.tech.
   

  

****Our Mission****
 Our mission is to help our customers get the most value out of their connected devices.
   

  

 Follow us on
   

  

 LinkedIn \| Youtube \| Instagram
   

  

**About The Role**
****Job Title****
 : Global Supply Chain Manager
   

  

****Experience****
 : 8\+ years
   

  

****Location****
 : Pune
   

  

 We are looking for a Global Supply Chain Manager to own the end to end supply chain for Sibros hardware. This is an ownership role, not a coordination role. You will own supplier relationships and agreements, demand planning against long component lead times, global trade and customs compliance across the United States, the European Union, and India, carrier and third party logistics partnerships, and the inventory system of record. You will set the policies that govern how we forecast, buy, hold, move, and return hardware, and you will be accountable for the cost, timing, and compliance of every unit that moves.
   

  

 The role sits at the point where customer commitments meet supplier capacity. Component lead times run six to twelve months, we order against forecasts ahead of customer purchase orders, and we are building our own telematics control unit alongside our existing supplier portfolio. You will own the risk that sits inside that gap. You will work directly with Finance on inventory exposure, with Sales and Technical Program Management on customer commitments, with Legal on supplier and export compliance, and with Engineering on new product introduction.
   

  

 This role is built for someone who raises problems early, escalates without being asked, and closes them without being chased.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Supplier Management and Procurement\- Own supplier relationships end to end, from qualification and onboarding through agreement execution and ongoing commercial management. Ensure every supplier is onboarded under a signed agreement before we transact. Issue approved purchase orders to suppliers within 24 hours and drive supplier follow through to committed dates.
* Demand Planning and Inventory Strategy\- Build and maintain the rolling demand forecast that long component lead times require. Set and maintain regional buffer stock levels and reorder points. Own the inventory position against both committed and forecast customer demand, and surface working capital exposure to Finance before it is committed rather than after.
* Global Trade and Customs Compliance\- Own import and export compliance across the United States, the European Union, and India. Maintain entity registrations, EORI and VAT numbers, product classifications, Incoterms, and customs broker relationships. Ensure every shipment departs with complete and correct documentation so that clearance is routine rather than an escalation.
* Logistics, Carrier, and 3PL Management\- Own carrier and third party logistics relationships, contracts, and rates. Manage freight and landed cost per unit as a reported metric with a target. Own shipment escalation end to end, including direct escalation into carriers, so that Engineering and Technical Program Management are never asked to execute logistics work.
* Returns, Warranty, and Device Lifecycle\- Own the returns and warranty process from customer intake through supplier claim and closure. Maintain unit level traceability across serial number, IMEI, and SIM for every device from receipt through decommissioning.
* Systems, Reporting, and Process Ownership\- Own the inventory system of record and its accuracy. Maintain the operating procedures and runbooks that govern the hardware process. Publish the weekly open order report, the monthly inventory reconciliation, and the quarterly demand forecast, and hold the numbers to an audit ready standard.
* New Product Introduction Support\- Support the launch of Sibros designed hardware by owning supplier selection, component sourcing strategy, contract manufacturer evaluation, and the supply chain readiness plan from prototype through production.


**What You Should Know**
* Education: Bachelor's / Master's degree in any discipline.
* Professional Experience: 8\+ years in supply chain, procurement, or global logistics, including at least 3 years owning a function rather than executing within one.
* Demand Planning: Demonstrated ownership of a demand forecast against component or finished goods lead times of six months or longer, including buffer stock policy and reorder point setting.
* Trade Compliance: Hands on ownership of import and export documentation and customs clearance in at least two of the United States, the European Union, and India, including direct management of customs brokers.
* Commercial Management: Experience negotiating and managing supplier, carrier, and third party logistics contracts, and managing freight and landed cost as a controlled expense.
* Systems: Ownership of an ERP or inventory management system as the system of record, with advanced Excel and Google Sheets capability for reconciliation and reporting.
* Ownership and Escalation: A proven record of raising risks early, escalating without prompting, and closing issues without follow up. This is the most important requirement of the role.
* Communication: Clear and timely communication across the United States, European Union, and India time zones with internal teams, suppliers, carriers, and customers.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Education: Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Logistics, Engineering, Business, or a related field. APICS CPIM, APICS CSCP, or CIPS certification.
* Industry Context: Experience in hardware enabled, IoT, automotive, or embedded systems environments, including exposure to automotive quality standards such as IATF 16949\.
* New Product Introduction: Experience taking a new hardware product from prototype to volume production, including electronics manufacturing services and contract manufacturer selection.
* Regional Expertise: Established customs broker and freight forwarder relationships in India, and working familiarity with the India to European Union and India to United States shipping lanes.
* ERP Proficiency: Experience with NetSuite, Odoo, Zoho, QuickBooks, or other ERP and inventory tools, and with Jira as an operational workflow system.
* Lifecycle Management: Exposure to returns, reverse logistics, refurbishment, and end of life device disposition.


**What We Offer**
* Competitive Compensation: A package inclusive of performance incentives.
* Growth Environment: A dynamic work environment with a flat hierarchy and rapid career advancement.
* Learning \& Development: Access to continuous learning and professional development opportunities.
* Work\-Life Balance: Flexible working hours and a culture that promotes balance.
* Comprehensive Benefits: Health insurance and wellness programs.
* Modern Policy: Flexible vacation and paid time off, you decide when you need a break.
* Team Culture: Regular team events, off\-sites, and a budget for online courses, books, and conferences.


 Employment Opportunity
   

  

 Sibros is committed to a policy of equal employment opportunity. We recruit, employ, train, compensate, and promote without regard to race, color, age, sex, ancestry, marital status, religion, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status, present or past history of mental disability, genetic information or any other classification protected by state or federal law.

title: Freight Operations Supervisor
description:
**About the Role** 




  





 Title\- Assistant Manager – Ocean Operations
 



 Location: Pune, Magarpatta
 



  





 Position Overview: The Assistant Manager – Ocean Operations will be responsible for managing and overseeing end\-to\-end ocean freight operations, covering both FCL and LCL shipments. The role will involve shipment planning and execution, booking and scheduling, coordination with shipping lines and freight forwarders, documentation, shipment tracking, exception management, and timely delivery follow\-up. The role will also be responsible for ensuring operational accuracy, compliance with applicable shipping and trade requirements, effective stakeholder coordination, and continuous improvement of ocean freight processes. The position will provide operational guidance and support to team members while ensuring smooth and efficient handling of increasing shipment volumes.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* End\-to\-End Ocean Freight Operations:
* Manage the complete lifecycle of FCL and LCL ocean shipments, from shipment planning and booking through documentation, vessel movement, tracking, and final delivery.
* Coordinate with shipping lines, freight forwarders, customs brokers, suppliers, warehouses, and other logistics partners for smooth shipment execution.
* Handle shipment bookings, vessel schedules, cut\-off timelines, cargo readiness, container planning, and documentation requirements.
* Monitor shipment milestones and proactively follow up on delays, rollovers, schedule changes, container\-related issues, and other operational exceptions.
* Ensure timely coordination for cargo pickup, stuffing, container movement, port processes, vessel departure, transshipment, arrival, and delivery.
* Ensure shipments are executed within agreed timelines and operational requirements.
* Handle day\-to\-day operational queries and resolve shipment\-related issues through effective coordination with internal and external stakeholders.



**FCL \& LCL Shipment Management:** 



* Manage FCL export and import shipments, including container booking, equipment availability, shipping line coordination, cut\-off management, and shipment tracking.
* Manage LCL shipments, including coordination with freight forwarders/consolidators, cargo readiness, consolidation schedules, documentation, and shipment tracking.
* Coordinate with relevant parties to ensure timely cargo movement and avoid unnecessary delays, demurrage, detention, storage, and other additional costs.
* Monitor container and cargo movement and ensure timely escalation of operational exceptions.
* Coordinate with warehouses, suppliers, freight forwarders, and transporters to ensure cargo is available and moved as per the planned sailing schedule.



**Documentation \& Trade Compliance:** 



* Ensure accurate and timely preparation, verification, and submission of ocean shipping documentation.
* Handle and review documents such as Bill of Lading, Commercial Invoice, Packing List, Certificate of Origin, Shipping Instructions, and other applicable shipping and trade documents.
* Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to resolve documentation discrepancies.
* Ensure shipping documentation is complete and accurate within defined timelines.
* Handle preferential and non\-preferential Certificates of Origin and coordinate with relevant stakeholders for issuance and submission.
* Ensure compliance with applicable international trade, customs, shipping, and documentation requirements.
* Maintain proper operational records and documentation for audit and compliance purposes.



  





**Shipping Line \& Freight Forwarder Coordination:** 



* Coordinate with shipping lines and freight forwarders for bookings, schedules, rates, equipment availability, documentation, and shipment execution.
* Follow up on vessel schedules, rollovers, delays, transshipments, port congestion, and other operational issues.
* Monitor service levels and operational performance of logistics service providers.
* Escalate recurring service issues and coordinate corrective actions with service providers.
* Support negotiations and discussions related to operational requirements, service quality, and freight\-related issues.



  





**Stakeholder Management:** 



* Act as a key point of contact for internal stakeholders regarding ocean freight shipments and operational matters.
* Coordinate with Procurement, Planning, Finance, Warehouse, Supply Chain, Customs, and other relevant departments to ensure smooth shipment execution.
* Provide timely shipment status updates and highlight potential delays or risks.
* Ensure alignment between shipment requirements, cargo readiness, documentation, and delivery timelines.
* Handle operational escalations and coordinate with relevant stakeholders for timely resolution.



  





**Team Coordination \& Support:** 



* Provide day\-to\-day operational guidance and support to team members handling ocean freight activities.
* Support the team in managing FCL and LCL shipment volumes and operational priorities.
* Review operational activities for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with defined processes.
* Train and guide junior team members on ocean freight processes, documentation, systems, and operational procedures.
* Support the team in resolving complex shipment\-related issues and exceptions.
* Ensure appropriate allocation and prioritization of operational activities within the team.



  





**Cost Control \& Process Improvement:** 



* Identify opportunities to improve ocean freight processes, shipment planning, operational efficiency, and service quality.
* Monitor and minimize avoidable costs such as demurrage, detention, storage, documentation charges, and other operational expenses.
* Support freight and logistics cost optimization through effective shipment planning and coordination.
* Identify recurring operational issues and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Contribute to the development and improvement of SOPs, process controls, and operational best practices.
* Monitor key operational performance indicators and support continuous improvement initiatives.



  





**Qualifications** 




  





 Bachelor’s degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, International Business, Commerce, or a
 



 related field.
 



  





**Experience** 




 • 7–9 years of relevant experience in Ocean Freight Operations.
 



 • Strong hands\-on experience in managing both FCL and LCL shipments.
 



 • Experience in end\-to\-end ocean freight operations, shipment coordination, documentation, and
 



 carrier/freight forwarder management.
 



 • Prior experience in handling or coordinating a team will be preferred.

title: P & M General Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 MD Infra India Pvt. Ltd. (MDI) is an infrastructure development and construction company headquartered in Kolhapur, Maharashtra, with projects across Maharashtra, Karnataka, and Goa. The organization focuses on complex and critical infrastructure projects, including roads, highways, bridges, dams, and water infrastructure. MDI combines engineering expertise, experienced project teams, technology, and strong operational discipline to deliver projects safely and efficiently. The company emphasizes responsible construction that promotes connectivity, opportunities, and long\-term value for clients, communities, and the nation. Guided by the objective to build better, responsibly, and for the future, MDI continues to invest in people, systems, and sustainable practices.
   

**Role Description** 
 The P \& M (Plant \& Machinery) General Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in the Pune Division. This role oversees the planning, deployment, operation, and maintenance of construction equipment and machinery for highway, bridge, and infrastructure projects. The General Manager will manage asset utilization, preventive and corrective maintenance schedules, spare parts planning, and vendor coordination to ensure minimal downtime and optimal productivity. Daily responsibilities include supervising P \& M teams, monitoring equipment performance and costs, implementing safety and compliance standards, and preparing reports and forecasts for senior leadership. The role also involves collaborating with project managers, procurement, and finance to align equipment resources with project timelines and budgets, and driving continuous improvement in P \& M processes and systems.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong experience in plant and machinery management within infrastructure, roads, highways, or heavy construction projects.
* Proficiency in equipment planning, preventive and predictive maintenance, and asset lifecycle management.
* Ability to lead and develop multidisciplinary teams, with skills in people management, delegation, and performance monitoring.
* Competence in budgeting, cost control, and analytical reporting related to equipment utilization and operating expenses.
* Knowledge of safety regulations, statutory compliances, and best practices for operating heavy construction equipment.
* Experience in vendor management, negotiation, and coordination for equipment procurement, rentals, and spare parts.
* Familiarity with maintenance management systems, ERP tools, or digital platforms for tracking equipment and workflows.
* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, or a related field; a postgraduate qualification in management is an added advantage.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work collaboratively across project and corporate teams.
* Proven ability to work on\-site in dynamic project environments and travel to project locations as required.

 Join our team, and develop your career in an encouraging, forward\-thinking environment!
   

  

**Role: Transformation Programme Manager, Procurement**
 Procurement at bp is going through its biggest digital and process transformation in a generation. The vision and purpose of this transformation is to make procurement at bp a ‘best\-in\-class’ function, achieving ‘top quartile’ status across efficiency and effectiveness.
   

  

 Reporting into the Procurement Transformation PMO, you will take ownership of one or more projects within a portfolio of 15\+ initiatives that span all of bp's operating businesses, as part of a 5\+ year transformation roadmap that started in 2024\.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
* You will be hands\-on in the day\-to\-day management and delivery of your projects — driving plans, supervising progress, handling risks and keeping stakeholders aligned — while applying the programme and project management standards set by the PMO.
* You will handle the end\-to\-end delivery of assigned projects within the Procurement Transformation programme, ensuring they are delivered to plan, budget and agreed outcomes.

* You will coordinate and empower project squads, delivery partners and third\-party contractors — leading through influence rather than direct line management — while fostering an inclusive working culture.
* You will liaise with vendors and colleagues across different time zones, requiring careful coordination between teams.

* You will ensure your projects are delivered to the scope signed off by the relevant Project Management \& Governance groups.

* You will identify and highlight risks and issues, working with the PMO and relevant teams to manage and mitigate them, and contributing to a strong risk culture within the teams.

title: South Indian Head chef
description:
**About us** 




 Gatti Chutney is a premium South Indian QSR specialising in Bangalore\-style dosas, with three outlets in Pune (Koregaon Park, Baner, Kharadi). Every batter, chutney and base is made in our Central Kitchen and sent to the outlets daily, so the CK is the heart of the brand. We're open 365 days a year.
 



**The role** 




 You'll own the Central Kitchen end to end: what gets made, how it tastes, what it costs, and how it reaches the outlets. You'll also lead menu R\&D and launch one new dish every month.
 



**Key responsibilities** 




*Production \& consistency* 



* Run daily production of dosa and idli batters, chutneys, sambar, palya and other prep strictly as per company SOPs and standard recipes
* Plan production against outlet indents and ensure on\-time, complete dispatch
* Control batter fermentation and chutney consistency across batches and seasons
* Maintain standard recipes with defined yields and portion specs



*Quality \& food safety* 



* Check incoming raw material for quality, weight and expiry; reject non\-conforming stock
* QC every batch before dispatch (taste, texture, temperature, labelling with batch/prep date/use\-by)
* Enforce FIFO/FEFO, shelf\-life rules and cold chain from CK to outlet
* Keep the CK FSSAI\-compliant and audit\-ready: hygiene, pest control, water testing, periodic lab testing
* Investigate outlet quality complaints and fix the root cause



*Food cost \& wastage* 



* Keep food cost within company target; track yields and variances
* Record, analyse and reduce CK wastage
* Conduct stock counts and reconcile consumption against production
* Work with purchase on raw material specs, vendor quality and pricing



*R\&D \& menu* 



* Launch one new dish every month: develop, cost, trial, write the SOP and train outlet teams
* Create seasonal and festive specials
* Improve existing recipes for taste, cost and shelf life



*Team* 



* Lead the CK team: rostering for 365\-day operations, training, hygiene discipline, performance
* Train outlet kitchen teams on new dishes and SOP updates; do regular outlet taste audits
* Develop a second\-in\-command



*Equipment \& reporting* 



* Ensure upkeep of grinders, kettles and cold storage with a preventive maintenance schedule
* Share daily production, dispatch and wastage reports; monthly food cost and R\&D update to founders



**What we're looking for** 



* 5\+ years in South Indian kitchen
* Hands\-on mastery For South Indian dishes
* Strong in recipe costing, yield control and inventory management
* FSSAI FoSTaC (Food Safety Supervisor) certified, or willing to get certified
* Comfortable with Excel and POS/inventory software (we use Petpooja)
* A floor leader, not a desk chef



**How you'll be measured** 




 Food cost %, CK wastage %, on\-time dispatch and fill rate, outlet quality complaints, audit scores, one new dish launched every month.
 



**What we offer** 



* ₹65k–90k/month based on experience
* Annual bonus
* 30 paid leaves a year, plus weekly off
* Accommodation
* 3 meals a day
* PF and gratuity as per law
* The chance to build the kitchen behind a growing premium brand

title: Infrastructure Engineer - Network operations
description:
Join us as an “ Infrastructure Engineer \- Network operations" at Barclays, where you'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You'll harness cutting\-edge technology to revolutionise our digital offerings, ensuring unapparelled customer experiences.
   

  

 You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as experience with, skills to meet business requirement as well as job\-specific skillsets.
   

  

 To be successful as an Infrastructure Engineer \- Network operations ”, you should have experience with:
   

  

**Basic/ Essential Qualifications**
* Strong network fundamentals and troubleshooting: Confident diagnosis across routing/switching, WAN, SD\-WAN, wireless, and edge services; packet\-level analysis; effective decision\-making under pressure.
* Production operations and reliability: Incident and problem management execution, post\-incident reviews, and implementation of controls to prevent recurrence.
* Network technology breadth: Capability across Cisco ACI/Nexus/Catalyst, SD\-WAN, F5 (or equivalent), Fortinet (or equivalent), Infoblox (DNS/DHCP/IPAM), proxy/remote access services, and associated tooling.
* Change governance and risk: Ability to execute production change safely within regulated environments, with strong awareness of audit, risk, and control requirements.
* Automation and scripting: Practical experience using Python and/or Ansible (and related tooling) to automate operational tasks, reduce toil, validate configurations, and improve reliability at scale.


**Desirable Skillsets/ Good To Have**
* Reliability engineering and observability: Experience improving monitoring, alert quality, operational KPIs, and proactive issue prevention.
* Advanced automation and IaC: Exposure to CI/CD patterns for network change, configuration management, testing/validation, and infrastructure\-as\-code (e.g., Terraform) where applicable.
* Hybrid and cloud networking: Working knowledge of cloud connectivity and hybrid patterns (AWS/Azure), including operational troubleshooting across on\-prem and cloud.
* Vendor and service integration: Experience working with vendor\-delivered services under defined operational controls, knowledge transfer, and measurable outcomes.
* Operational excellence: Recognised escalation SME who drives sustained operational improvement through data, controls, and disciplined execution.


 This role is based out of Pune.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To build and maintain infrastructure platforms and products that support applications and data systems, using hardware, software, networks, and cloud computing platforms as required with the aim of ensuring that the infrastructure is reliable, scalable, and secure. Ensure the reliability, availability, and scalability of the systems, platforms, and technology through the application of software engineering techniques, automation, and best practices in incident response.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Build Engineering: Development, delivery, and maintenance of high\-quality infrastructure solutions to fulfil business requirements ensuring measurable reliability, performance, availability, and ease of use. Including the identification of the appropriate technologies and solutions to meet business, optimisation, and resourcing requirements.
* Incident Management: Monitoring of IT infrastructure and system performance to measure, identify, address, and resolve any potential issues, vulnerabilities, or outages. Use of data to drive down mean time to resolution.
* Automation: Development and implementation of automated tasks and processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual intervention, utilising software scripting/coding disciplines.
* Security: Implementation of a secure configuration and measures to protect infrastructure against cyber\-attacks, vulnerabilities, and other security threats, including protection of hardware, software, and data from unauthorised access.
* Teamwork: Cross\-functional collaboration with product managers, architects, and other engineers to define IT Infrastructure requirements, devise solutions, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives via a data driven approach.
* Learning: Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations, and actively contribute to the organization's technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.


**Assistant Vice President Expectations**
* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

description:

We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Director, Technical Program Management’
   

  

**Overview**
 Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
   

  

 Mastercard’s Business \& Market Insights (B\&MI) group empowers organizations to achieve growth \& innovation goals by providing unparalleled data\-driven insights and advanced analytics. By leveraging proprietary data and global expertise, B\&MI helps businesses make smarter, more informed decisions that drive profitability and success. We turn complex data into actionable strategies that lead to better outcomes and sustained competitive advantage.
   

  

 We are currently looking for a ‘Director, Technical Program Management’ for Payment Reconciliation Intelligence program within B\&MI, to provide program management leadership, cutting across different product areas.
   

  

**Roles And Responsibilities**
* Successfully lead major projects and complex assignments with broad scope and long\-term business implications. Collaborate with business and technical partners to scope the opportunities, outline potential value and ROI, and identify risks, benefits and constraints.
* Be the owner for all Program\-level initiatives while also ensuring success of individual delivery teams. Provide people leadership to technical program managers across the program.
* Assist in examining commercially available and forthcoming industry technologies related to area of expertise. Research on current and upcoming technologies and application frameworks and provide recommendations. Proactively create and maintain solution and technology roadmaps.

Identify Program quality methodologies, define and track quality metrics and ensure continued process quality improvement within the program.
* Manage multiple scrum teams and be responsible to organize and lead all Agile/SAFe ceremonies. Be accountable for overall progress of the committed projects and enhance processes to streamline deliveries. Champion in tracking initiatives progress/reports using Agile project management tools such as Jira, Rally.
* Develop good technical understanding of product architecture \& flows and be able to propose technical solutions. Possess hands\-on technical capabilities to track, analyse or resolve critical issues and customer queries.
* Effectively manage internal and external stakeholders and participate in technical discussions as a program representative.
* Help customers and the product/engineering teams make trade\-off decisions by considering all the data including business goals, technical platform strategy, customer experience and maintainability. You identify blocking issues and manage their resolution.


  
   

  

**All About You**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or engineering or equivalent work experience, with a proven track\-record of successfully leading and managing complex programs/projects/products.
* Advanced level understanding of Agile/SAFe methodologies with a demonstrated experience in organizing Agile/SAFe ceremonies, planning program \& iteration deliverables, leading scrum meetings, managing cost \& effort estimation and driving prioritization discussions.
* A solid foundation in Computer Science, with prior hands\-on experience on .Net stack and/or Java stack (preferably on web applications and microservices\-based software architecture and with an exposure to cloud technologies). Strong SQL skills would be a huge plus.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities, with quick adaptation to new technologies, methodologies, and systems.
* Excellent English communication skills (both written and verbal) and experience with managing internal and external stakeholders at all management levels.
* High\-energy, detail\-oriented and proactive, with ability to function under pressure in an independent environment along with a high degree of initiative and self\-motivation to drive results.


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

**Manager – Accounts \& Finance**




**Job Location: Pune (Camp)** 




**Industry: Real Estate / Construction / Promoter \& Developer** 




**Reporting to: Head – Finance / CFO** 




  





**Position Overview** 




 We are looking for an experienced and technology\-savvy Manager – Accounts \& Finance to lead the Accounting, Financial Reporting, FP\&A and Tax Compliance functions for a leading promoter, developer and construction group in Pune.
 



 The role will be responsible for ensuring accurate and timely financial reporting, smooth monthly closing, effective tax compliance, robust MIS and FP\&A support, and efficient utilisation of the organisation’s ERP system. The position will also lead and mentor the accounting team and drive process discipline, automation and continuous improvement.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities**




  





**Accounting \& Financial Reporting** 




 Lead day\-to\-day accounting operations across the group and ensure accuracy, completeness and timely recording of financial transactions.
 



 Drive the monthly, quarterly and annual financial close process.
 



 Review general ledger, reconciliations, provisions, accruals, revenue, costs, receivables, payables and other accounting schedules.
 



 Ensure appropriate accounting treatment for construction projects, development activities, land transactions, project costs and related\-party transactions.
 



 Prepare and review financial statements and management reporting in accordance with applicable accounting standards.
 



  





**MIS, FP\&A \& Business Support** 




 Lead preparation of monthly MIS, project\-wise profitability reports, budgets, forecasts, cash\-flow projections and variance analysis.
 



 Provide meaningful financial insights to management on project performance, costs, margins, working capital and cash flows.
 



 Develop and improve management dashboards and analytical reports to support business decision\-making.
 



 Work closely with project, commercial, procurement and business teams to ensure timely and accurate financial information.
 



  





**Tax \& Statutory Compliance** 




 Oversee direct and indirect tax compliance, including GST, TDS, Income Tax and other applicable statutory requirements.
 



 Ensure timely filing of returns, payments, reconciliations and responses to tax/statutory queries.
 



 Coordinate with external tax advisors, auditors and consultants wherever required.
 



 Monitor changes in tax laws and assess their impact on the business.
 



  





**ERP \& Process Management** 




 Take ownership of the ERP system from a finance and accounting perspective and ensure smooth and effective utilisation by the accounting and business teams.
 



 Work with ERP teams/consultants to configure processes, improve controls and develop MIS reports.
 



 Should have the ability to understand business requirements and design/define ERP\-based MIS and reporting solutions.
 



 Experience with ERP platforms such as Highrise, SAP or equivalent will be an advantage.
 



 Drive standardisation, automation, internal controls and continuous improvement of finance processes.
 



  





**Audit \& Compliance** 




 Coordinate statutory, tax and internal audits and ensure timely closure of audit observations.
 



 Maintain appropriate documentation and supporting schedules for audit and management review.
 



 Strengthen financial controls and ensure compliance with internal policies and procedures.
 



  





**Team Leadership** 




 Lead, guide and motivate the accounting team to deliver accurate, timely and reliable financial information.
 



 Allocate responsibilities, monitor performance and develop team capabilities.
 



 Establish a process\-oriented and accountability\-driven culture within the finance function.
 



  





**Required Skills \& Competencies**




 In\-depth knowledge of accounting, financial reporting and month\-end/year\-end close processes.
 



 Strong understanding of the real estate, construction, promoter and developer business, including project accounting and project\-wise financial analysis.
 



 Strong knowledge of FP\&A, MIS, budgeting, forecasting and variance analysis.
 



 Good understanding of GST, TDS, Income Tax and other statutory compliances relevant to the business.
 



 Strong ERP knowledge with the ability to use technology for process improvement and MIS development.
 



 Experience with Highrise, SAP or similar ERP systems will be preferred.
 



 Technology\-savvy and comfortable working with ERP, reporting tools, Excel and data\-driven financial analysis.
 



 Strong process orientation, attention to detail and analytical ability.
 



 Excellent people\-management, communication and stakeholder\-management skills.
 



 Ability to work independently and take ownership of deliverables in a fast\-paced business environment.
 



  





**Qualification \& Experience**




 Chartered Accountant (CA) with 5 years of post qualification experience or completion of CA article ship with 10 years of experience in leading the accounting/finance function.
 



 Candidates with substantial experience in a real estate, construction, promoter or developer organization will be strongly preferred.
 



 Proven experience in managing accounting teams and delivering monthly MIS, financial close, statutory compliance and management reporting.
 



  





**Key Success Measures**




 Timely and accurate monthly financial close.
 



 Quality and timeliness of MIS and management reporting.
 



 Effective project\-wise financial and cost reporting.
 



 Timely statutory and tax compliance.
 



 Smooth and effective ERP operations.
 



 Strong financial controls and audit readiness.
 



 Improved finance processes, automation and reporting.
 



 Effective leadership and development of the accounting team.

description:
**Brief Description**
 Head of Partner Performance Management
   

  

**Pune, India**
**Reporting to: Chief Operating Officer**
**Salary: 38,00,000 – 45,00,000 per annum \+ benefits**
 Lead a Global Partner Engineering Workforce
   

  

 ESP Global Services is a leading provider of End User Computing, Field Engineering and Infrastructure Support services to enterprise customers across the globe.
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced Head of Partner Performance Management to lead the operational performance of our global partner engineering network, ensuring that hundreds of third\-party engineers consistently deliver exceptional service to our customers.
   

  

**This is not a traditional procurement or vendor management role.**
 You will be responsible for ensuring that partner\-employed engineers perform as an extension of ESP's own workforce, meeting customer expectations, contractual service levels and commercial objectives across multiple international regions.
   

  

 Working closely with Operations, Customer Success, Service Delivery, Procurement and Executive Leadership, you will drive accountability, operational excellence and continuous improvement across our global partner ecosystem.
   

  

 The Role
   

  

 You will lead the governance and operational performance of approximately 200 third\-party engineers delivering:
   

  

* End User Computing (EUC)
* Field Engineering
* Deskside Support
* Infrastructure Support
* Engineer Augmentation Services
* Smart Hands and Technical Onsite Services


 Your focus is ensuring the right engineers are deployed, performing effectively, meeting service commitments and representing ESP professionally within customer environments.
   

  

 Success will be measured by operational performance, customer satisfaction, partner accountability and commercial performance.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Own the operational performance of ESP's global partner\-delivered engineering workforce.
* Lead the governance framework across multiple engineering partners and suppliers.
* Ensure partner engineers consistently achieve agreed SLAs, KPIs and customer service standards.
* Drive engineer utilisation, workforce planning, attendance, availability and capacity management.
* Manage operational escalations relating to engineer performance, service delivery and customer experience.
* Hold partners accountable through structured governance, service reviews, corrective action plans and Quarterly Business Reviews.
* Drive continuous improvement across partner performance, engineer quality and operational consistency.
* Work closely with Service Delivery, Customer Success and Operations teams to ensure customer commitments are consistently achieved.
* Own the commercial performance of partner\-delivered services, including budgets, forecasting, billing accuracy and cost optimisation.
* Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through automation, tooling and process standardisation.


 What We're Looking For
   

  

 This role will suit someone who has managed large operational teams of third\-party engineers delivering IT support services.
   

  

**You Will Bring** 
  

  

* 10\+ years' experience leading partner\-delivered IT service operations, supplier performance or field engineering organisations.
* Demonstrable experience managing third\-party engineers delivering End User Computing, Infrastructure Support, Field Services or Engineer Augmentation.
* Experience managing multiple global partner organisations simultaneously.
* Proven success improving partner operational performance through structured governance and performance management.
* Strong experience managing:
+ SLA and KPI performance
+ Workforce planning and engineer utilisation
+ Operational reporting and analytics
+ Service governance
+ Customer escalations
+ Supplier accountability

* Commercial experience managing budgets, forecasting, supplier costs and financial performance.
* Experience leading cross\-functional teams across Operations, Service Delivery, Customer Success and Procurement.
* Strong analytical capability with the confidence to challenge poor performance using operational data.


**Essential Experience**
**We are particularly interested in candidates who have operational responsibility for partner\-employed engineers delivering services such as:**
* End User Computing (EUC)
* Field Engineering
* Desktop Support
* Infrastructure Support
* Smart Hands
* IMAC Services
* Break/Fix Services
* Data Centre Support
* Managed Services


 Candidates whose experience is primarily within procurement, sourcing, contract administration or general vendor management, without operational accountability for technical service delivery, are unlikely to be suitable for this role.
   

  

 Why Join ESP?
   

  

 This is a highly visible leadership role reporting directly to the COO.
   

  

 You will shape how ESP manages and develops a global network of engineering partners supporting enterprise customers across multiple continents. Your work will directly influence customer satisfaction, operational excellence, service quality and commercial performance.
   

  

 If you enjoy leading through influence, improving operational performance, holding partners accountable and building world\-class engineering services, we'd like to hear from you.
   

  

 Before You Apply
   

  

**To help us identify the right experience, please ensure your CV clearly demonstrates:**
* The number of third\-party engineers you have managed.
* The types of IT support services those engineers delivered.
* The countries or regions you were responsible for.
* Examples of how you improved partner performance or service delivery.
* The operational KPIs, SLAs or commercial outcomes you were accountable for.

* promise.

* and Varun, realized that the home services industry was predominantly unorganized,
* fragmented, and offline. Customers found it challenging to avail quality services conveniently,
* and service professionals were struggling to make ends meet, having to rely upon several
* middlemen, contractors, and local aggregators. The founders felt that the industry was ripe
* for disruption, and launched Urban Company, with three key principles in mind \-
* 1\. Customer love: Build a platform that offers truly delightful and differentiated services
* 2\. Partner empowerment: Build a deep, full\-stack partnership with service partners,
* helping improve their earnings and overall livelihood
* 3\. Technology first: Bring innovation and technology to an age\-old industry
* 
* **What You’ll Do:**
* The most common question asked is, 'What does a typical day in the life of an SCM look like?'
* To answer that in brevity, no two days will be the same for you in this role:
* ● First focus is operational excellence for your set of cities \- this involves selection and
* training of new partners and improving current partners' quality. This is the crux and
* main focus of the role. It is an operations\-heavy role

* ○ Projects focused on improving quality and service excellence

* operational excellence

* Sustainable and profitable growth
* Building customer and partner love at scale
* Leading a team from the front and empowering them to win based on UC's values
* Collaboration with cross\-functional teams to ensure swift and robust execution.



 You are the owner of the business entrusted to you, and you have a direct influence on how the business shapes up. If you're an entrepreneur/intrapreneur at heart, then this is an opportunity for you to grab with both hands
 



  





**What We Need:** 



* Minimum 2\-4 years experience in an ops\-related/consulting/strategy role.
* Demonstrated leadership of teams and projects – the ability to influence and lead.
* Someone who can deliver under tight timelines
* Super energetic, loves challenges and solving them.



**What can you expect:** 



* A great work environment with massive ownership and growth opportunities \- we hire folks for a career opportunity, not just the role.
* Energy and hustle of a startup with processes and depth of a big organization
* Expect to work with people you can learn from and are invested in your growth
* Opportunity to be part of the mission to transform customer and partner experience

title: Manager - IT Office Operations
description:
Etraveli Group is a leading global flight technology provider, specializing in flight sales and offering flight content delivery and fintech products. We are here to solve complexity, by connecting millions of flights and travelers across the globe, from search and selection to trip and beyond.
   

  

 We partner with major global platforms such as Booking.com, Google Flights, Skyscanner, and Kayak, providing seamless flight booking and related services. Our B2B portfolio includes Precision, our specialist in travel fintech; Tripstack, our B2B Flights as a Service Provider and world leader in virtual interlining, serving as the gateway to Etraveli Group’s flight content and fulfillment services; Wenrix, the AI Infrastructure for profitable growth in air; and Flygresor.se, Sweden’s leading flight comparison site. We also operate our own online travel agency brands including Gotogate, Mytrip, and Flightnetwork.
   

  

 Every day we strive to make the world smaller for our customers and bigger for our people. Our diverse team of more than 3200 passionate professionals is what makes us the industry’s tech wonder and the best in the world at what we do.
   

  

 Major offices in Sweden (HQ), Greece, India, Canada, Israel, Poland, UK, and Uruguay.
   

  

 The Role
   

  

 We're excited to be expanding our leadership team in India and are looking for an IT Manager to oversee our IT Office Operations across our Pune and Mumbai offices.
   

  

 Reporting directly to the Senior Manager IT Office Operations (based in Gothenburg), you will lead and empower a dynamic team of 14 IT Engineers who are responsible for our global service desk, client security, user access management, and 24/7 on\-call support for Etraveli Group. The global ITOO team extends with an additional 12 IT Engineers in Sweden and Greece collaborating together on operations and continuous improvement.
   

  

 As a people\-centric leader, you will balance line management with tactical execution, ensuring high service quality, operational efficiency, and a supportive team environment.
   

  

 Job Responsibility
   

  

* Line management for a team of 14 IT Engineers, handling yearly performance reviews cycle, driving personal development, and managing scheduling/rotas for global support and on\-call coverage.
* Manage, prioritize, and monitor team workload and IT ticketing progress (Jira and JSM) to ensure timely resolution and high service standards across the global service desk.
* Serve as a key escalation path for complex IT issues, major incidents, and operational bottlenecks.
* Lead incident management, coordinating rapid response and mitigation when critical systems or operations are impacted.
* Oversee key functional domains within the team, including Client Security, User Access Management, and equipment lifecycle management.
* Manage local vendor relationships, service contracts, and IT asset procurement for the Pune and Mumbai offices.
* Continuously improve ways of working, operational routines, and technical documentation across global and local IT operations.
* Participate actively in global IT Office Operations meetings, different SME team meetings, and align local execution with global strategy.
* Ensure local office infrastructure (computers Win11, printers, meeting room AV/conferencing gear, mobile devices) is fully supported and operational.
* Coordination with the network and server infrastructure team for business continuity and uptime.
* Coordinate with the local operations team for the feedback, local/global deliveries and service improvements.


 Job Requirement
   

  

* 8\-14 years of overall experience in IT Office Operations.
* Global experience preferred
* 3\+ years of proven experience in line management/leadership roles within IT (mandatory).
* Broad background in IT, ideally with significant experience in IT support or service desk management.
* Demonstrated experience tracking IT support metrics, managing ticketing workflows, and monitoring team progress.
* Strong business acumen to understand business impact and appropriately prioritize major incidents and problems.
* Solid conceptual understanding of IT server and network infrastructure principles (valuable).
* Fluent written and spoken English with excellent communication skills.


 Thorough On Boarding Process
   

  

 We are building a stellar onboarding adventure just for you, spanning your first 120 days, including access to learning resources, Q\&A sessions with our CEO and a buddy program.
   

  

 Competitive Benefits
   

  

 We pay fairly and align compensation with your role's impact on the company. Referral bonus, pension and insurances are also applicable, with some variations across our locations.
   

  

 Wellbeing \& Community
   

  

 In order to be the best version of you every day, you need an environment that provides for your wellbeing. From breakfast \& good coffee to start your day to healthcare, employee assistance plans and team bonding events we've got you covered!
   

  

 Opportunities for Development
   

  

 You will find extensive learning opportunities, team training and workshops connected to your role as well as guidance from renown leaders, all provided in a fast pace environment with flat hierarchies.
   

  

 Hybrid Work
   

  

 We want you to enjoy the best of all worlds and we know that doesn't always mean working at the office. We have a hybrid policy, including working from anywhere 2 weeks every year.
   

  

 Diversity disclaimer
   

  

*At Etraveli Group we value diversity; we pride ourselves on being a company represented by people of all different backgrounds.* 
*During hiring, we are committed to ensure equality and promote diversity in the workplace at every selection stage. As such, we provide the same opportunities for all candidates regardless of race, religion or belief, gender, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other characteristic protected under any anti\-discrimination law or regulation.*

description:
Hello,
 



  





 Please share your updated resume if interested. Thank you !
 



  





 The Team Lead is responsible for overseeing the daily operations of the audit team, ensuring efficiency, accuracy, and compliance in claim reviews. This role builds upon the Team Coach position by adding leadership responsibilities such as performance management, workflow oversight, and team engagement. The Team Lead is a critical link between auditors and management, ensuring audit targets are met while fostering a culture of continuous improvement and professional development
 



  





**Requirements:** 




  




* Bachelor’s degree mandatory.
* Overall 7\+ years of experience of which 1 \+ year as Team Lead or equivalent
* Proficiency of MS Office (Word, Excel) required.
* Must be detail\-oriented and flexible to work in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.
* Strong analytical, critical thinking and problem solving skills.
* Team player with strong desire to assist others and share knowledge
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Open to work in any shift including night shift



  





  





**Principal Responsibilities and Essential Duties:** 



* Team Leadership: Supervise and manage a team of Payment Accuracy Specialists and Senior Specialists, ensuring productivity and quality targets are met. Address and resolve team challenges, escalations, and process bottlenecks to ensure smooth operations.
* Ensure Team Performance: Monitor team performance, track key performance indicators (KPIs), and implement corrective actions when necessary.
* Audit Oversight: Ensure audit workflows are executed efficiently and maintain high accuracy levels in claim reviews. Review and approve audit findings for high\-value or complex claims before submission.
* Data Analysis: Utilize internal tools and databases to assess claim accuracy and detect patterns of incorrect billing. Utilize data analytics tools to detect payment trends, anomalies, and fraud indicators. Develop and refine audit methodologies to improve accuracy and efficiency. Assist in process improvement initiatives by identifying workflow enhancements.
* Quality Control: Work closely with quality audit teams to identify trends, errors, and areas for improvement. Enforce compliance with payer policies, regulatory guidelines, and internal audit standards.
* People Management: Maintain efficient workflow by holding direct reports accountable for the quality and efficiency of their work. Build and maintain positive internal working relationships with all department employees by communicating in a professional manner. Provides visual and verbal support to the team by remaining accessible.
* Performance Management: Provide guidance and effectively coach employees to achieve desired results and overall performance, encourage discussions to achieve long\-term growth. Ensure all direct reports execute objectives using a developmental plan/ninety (90\) day plan and regular performance reviews, posting productivity, quality and deadline results. Maintain consistency in applying company and departmental policy decisions by accurately and timely documenting employee files, including attendance, performance information, documented warnings, time off requests, coaching information, training information.
* Performance Review: Conduct regular performance reviews, coaching sessions, and feedback discussions to drive individual and team development.
* Process Optimization \& Strategic Initiatives: Identify process inefficiencies and workflow gaps, recommending improvements to enhance accuracy and efficiency. Assist in developing and implementing best practices, SOPs, and automation initiatives to improve audit performance. Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including IT, data analytics, and compliance, to refine auditing methodologies.
* Stakeholder Management \& Communication: Serve as the primary point of contact between team members, senior management, and other departments. Provide regular reports, data insights, and performance updates to leadership on audit trends, challenges, and results. Address client queries, payer feedback, or escalated disputes related to claim audit outcomes.
* Training \& Development: Support onboarding, mentoring, and upskilling initiatives for new and existing team members. Foster a collaborative learning environment, encouraging team members to stay updated on industry trends and coding changes. Organize knowledge\-sharing sessions and skill development programs in coordination with the SME/Team Coach.
* Escalations: Review escalated claims/appeals, guiding the team on complex claim adjudication and reimbursement policies.
* Reports \& Presentations: Prepare and deliver reports, presentations, and audit insights to management for continuous improvement.
* Critical Thinker: Demonstrates adeptness in identifying errors and exceptions that result in valid claims. Has an eye for irregularities. Ability to analyze data, identify inconsistencies and formulate workable solutions. Makes logical, well\-reasoned and timely decisions.
* Initiative Taker: Shows initiative and a willingness to engage in all areas of the audit. Reaches beyond current tasks to add value to audit team. Goes the extra step to solving problems instead of waiting for someone else to solve them. Successfully integrates and multi\-tasks new assignments.
* Technically Capable: Demonstrates competency with tools of the job including but not limited to computers, word processing \& spreadsheet applications, web systems, Cotiviti and Client systems, and data file structures. Can efficiently download and format common file types.
* Policy Compliance: Ensure compliance with payer policies, contractual agreements, and industry regulations.
* Delivers Results: Delivers results consistently with high level of integrity. Meets or exceed goals at expected levels of quality and productivity. Demonstrates willingness and readiness to take on more responsibility in support of the audit.
* Performance Improvement and Feedback Implementation: Improve performance based on the feedback provided by the reporting manager.
* Time Management: Ensures timely completion of audit reports. Exhibit's an understanding of audit planning activities and uses a structured and dependable approach to accomplishing assigned work.
* Hire, develop, coach, lead and retain top\-tier talent, with a focus on building and improving a team and culture that is able to assist in employing best in class practices to support and drive high levels of internal and external customer satisfaction.



  





 Regards
 



 Talent Acquisition Team \| COTIVITI
